items.summary: Position SummaryThe Project Monitor operates the performance, data, and compliance monitoring system for project.
items.description: Position Summary The Project Monitor operates the performance, data, and compliance monitoring system for project. This individual translates the QASP and PWS into measurable definitions, reliable data-collection processes, dashboards, quarterly reports, and corrective-action workflows. The Project Monitor provides an objective view of whether TTA, pilots, products, and deliverables are timely, high quality, useful, and likely to produce sustainable results. Core Responsibilities Develop and maintain the performance-measure dictionary, data-collection plan, reporting calendar, source documentation, quality checks, and dashboard required by the QASP. Track the number, type, frequency, duration, level of effort, recipients, outputs, and status of TTA and program-support activities by quarter. Measure recipient roles, knowledge gain, use of rapid-cycle evaluation and learning, satisfaction, implementation progress, product use, and sustainability indicators. Monitor the PWS requirement that at least 85 percent satisfaction be achieved for sponsored training and technical assistance activities and flag emerging performance gaps. Compile quarterly performance and outcomes reports and provide validated monitoring inputs for monthly status reports, the annual report, briefings, and pilot learning products. Track deliverable schedules, review cycles, Government comments, acceptance status, quality findings, risks, corrective actions, and evidence of closure. Support pilot-site data planning, baseline and monitoring data, data dictionaries, data-use controls, privacy protections, missing-data rules, and cross-site synthesis. Conduct data-quality checks, reconcile source records, document limitations, and prevent unsupported causal claims or overstatement of results. Coordinate with the Project Leader and SME and Content Manager on logic models, measures, analytic questions, promising-practice evidence, and product performance. Required Qualifications At least five years of experience in program monitoring, performance measurement, evaluation, data analysis, quality assurance, or federal contract compliance. Demonstrated ability to define measures, design data-collection tools, validate data, develop dashboards, and produce clear performance reports. Experience with qualitative and quantitative data, surveys or feedback instruments, data dictionaries, documentation, and data-quality controls. Working knowledge of privacy, confidentiality, secure data handling, Section 508, and responsible reporting of limitations. Strong analytical writing and ability to explain performance findings to project leaders, technical staff, pilot sites, and nontechnical client audiences. Preferred Qualifications Graduate training in program evaluation, public policy, statistics, economics, sociology, public administration, or a related field. Experience with TANF, HMRF, means-tested programs, rapid-cycle learning, multi-site pilots, or human-services administrative data. Proficiency with Power BI, Tableau, Excel, R, Stata, SPSS, SAS, Qualtrics, or comparable analytics and survey tools. Education and Experience Bachelor's degree in evaluation, statistics, economics, public policy, social science, public administration, or a related field required; master's degree preferred. Five or more years of directly relevant experience is preferred. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Data Liaison (Business Analytics & Insights)- 6 Month Contract
items.summary: OGC is a boutique research and consulting agency specializing in data-driven strategy, quantitative analytics, and Customer Experience (CX) program design and optimization.
items.description: OGC is a boutique research and consulting agency specializing in data-driven strategy, quantitative analytics, and Customer Experience (CX) program design and optimization. We work with some of the world's largest organizations across a variety of industries, including Financial Services, Specialty Retail, Telecommunications, Hospitality, and Software, helping them gain a deep understanding of their customers, develop actionable insights, and improve business processes. Our client is a global leader in the Consumer Packaged Goods industry, with a focus on delivering data-driven insights that support commercial decision-making and business growth. Their Growth Analytics team develops dashboards and reporting solutions used by senior leadership across the organization. They are seeking a Data Liaison to bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical development teams, ensuring reporting solutions accurately reflect business needs and industry metrics. This is a 6-month remote contract with the potential for extension. About the Role The ideal candidate is analytical, commercially minded, and an exceptional communicator who enjoys translating business needs into actionable data requirements. You will work closely with business stakeholders, insights teams, and analytics developers to ensure dashboards and reporting solutions are built using the correct business logic, calculations, and data sources. This role is ideal for someone with experience in business analytics, commercial insights, or consumer insights who understands both the language of the business and the language of data. should be comfortable working closely with technical teams, translating business requirements into technical specifications, and validating data before it reaches senior leadership. You'll also play an important role in helping the analytics team build a stronger understanding of the business, enabling them to become increasingly self-sufficient over time. Responsibilities Include Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, insights teams, and analytics developers, translating executive requests into clear business requirements, data specifications, and analytical approaches. Review dashboards, calculations, and reporting logic before release, ensuring the correct business logic, methodologies, metrics, and data sources (including syndicated datasets such as Nielsen) are used while proactively identifying and resolving reporting inaccuracies. Participate in business and executive reporting discussions to understand business priorities, reporting requirements, and how data is used to support decision-making. Document business metrics, calculation methodologies, and data source guidance to establish consistent reporting standards and best practices. Coach and mentor analytics developers to strengthen their understanding of business metrics, commercial context, and reporting expectations, with the goal of enabling greater independence over time. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve reporting processes, strengthen communication between business and technical functions, and develop scalable documentation and best practices that enhance the long-term capability of the analytics team. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Statistics, Data Analytics, Marketing, or a related field. 4+ years of experience in Business Analytics, Commercial Analytics, Consumer Insights, Market Research, Strategy, or a related analytical role. Experience within Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), Retail, or a similar commercial environment is strongly preferred. Experience working with syndicated data sources, particularly Nielsen, with the ability to determine the most appropriate data source for different business questions. Strong understanding of retail and commercial performance metrics, including velocity, points of distribution, market share, merchandising, pricing, and related KPIs. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to validate data, calculations, business logic, and reporting accuracy. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into clear guidance for technical and analytics teams. Experience collaborating with analytics, BI, engineering, or dashboard development teams in a cross-functional environment. Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Experience with business intelligence platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting tools is advantageous. Technical coding or dashboard development experience is not required; however, the ability to engage credibly with technical teams is essential. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Payments Analyst
items.summary: Payments AnalystStellarTech is a rapidly growing company at the forefront of innovation in the EdTech industry.
items.description: Payments Analyst StellarTech is a rapidly growing company at the forefront of innovation in the EdTech industry. We build and scale educational apps for users around the world, combining data, technology, and an x1000 mindset to create meaningful products and sustainable business models. We are looking for a Payments Analyst to join our Payments Division. Payments sit at one of the most critical points in the customer journey: the moment user intent turns into revenue. As our product portfolio and global presence continue to grow, we need an analyst who will help us keep payment reporting accurate, monitor performance, identify anomalies, and support data-driven improvements across our payment flows. You will gradually take ownership of day-to-day payment analytics while developing deep expertise in transactional data, monetization, and subscription products. What You’ll Do Maintain and improve recurring payment reports and dashboards. Adapt existing reporting for new applications, markets, and business needs. Create analytical reports and data extracts independently. Add new filters and dimensions to existing dashboards. Monitor payment performance, alerts, and week-over-week changes in key metrics. Identify anomalies in payment data and conduct first-line investigations into possible causes. Perform data quality checks and help maintain consistency across multiple data sources. Work with large product and transactional datasets. Support the Payments team with clear conclusions and actionable insights, not just raw data. Collaborate with Payments, Product, Finance, and other cross-functional teams. Identify opportunities to automate recurring reports and analytical workflows. Gradually contribute to more advanced payment analytics, experiments, and business hypotheses. What We’re Looking For 1-3 years of hands-on experience in Data Analytics, Product Analytics, or a similar analytical role. Strong SQL skills and the ability to write queries independently. Practical Python skills for data analysis and automation. Working knowledge of statistics and analytical methods. Experience working with large datasets and real product or business data. Experience creating or maintaining reports and BI dashboards. Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills. Ability to validate data, identify inconsistencies, and investigate anomalies. Ability to clearly explain what you did, what problem you solved, and how the result was useful. Strong attention to detail and respect for data accuracy. An ownership mindset: you do not simply complete tasks but take responsibility for the result. High learning agility and genuine interest in developing within the payments domain. Clear, structured communication and willingness to raise questions or blockers early. Nice to Have Experience working with payment, transactional, billing, or financial data. Experience in subscription-based, web-to-app, fintech, e-commerce, gaming, or other high-volume B2C products. Understanding of monetization models and online payment flows. Experience with AWS Athena or Amazon S3. Experience with Tableau, Apache Superset, Looker, or similar BI tools. Experience automating reports or recurring analytical processes. Personal, academic, or professional projects involving automation, AI tools, or real-world datasets. Previous payments experience is an advantage, but it is not a requirement. Strong analytical fundamentals, ownership, and the ability to learn quickly matter more. What Success Looks Like During your first months, you will learn the Payments Division’s data, reporting logic, and key processes. You will gradually take ownership of recurring dashboards, reports, filters, data extracts, monitoring, and alerting. You will be able to identify issues, explain what is happening in the data, and escalate anomalies with the necessary context. Why You’ll Love Working With Us Direct business impact: Work with data at the point where customer intent becomes revenue. Global scale: Analyze payment flows across multiple products, markets, and payment methods. Valuable expertise: Build your career in payments, transactions, subscriptions, and monetization. Professional growth: Learn directly from an experienced Senior Analyst and gradually take ownership of your analytical area. Modern tools: Work with SQL, Python, AWS Athena/S3, Tableau/Superset, and AI-powered solutions. Innovative environment: Experiment, improve processes, and bring your own ideas. Global remote: Work remotely as part of an international product company. Health support: Company-provided medical expense compensation. AI tools: Company-covered AI subscriptions and other tools. Balance: 21 days of annual leave plus 10 bank holidays. Collaborative culture: Work with ambitious professionals who value reliable evidence, extreme ownership, energy, and speed. Hiring Process Recruiter Screening Technical Interview Final Interview Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Blockchain Data Analyst & Researcher
items.summary: Why This Role As a Blockchain Data Analyst & Researcher, you will be a pivotal force in our data intelligence efforts, serving primarily as a blockchain data protocol researcher.
items.description: Why This Role As a Blockchain Data Analyst & Researcher, you will be a pivotal force in our data intelligence efforts, serving primarily as a blockchain data protocol researcher. Your core mission will involve a deep dive into the complex internals and mechanics of various blockchain networks, reverse engineering of sophisticated Decentralized Finance (DeFi) protocols, and translating these complex systems into actionable, structured data. Develop new derivative data models and datasets for client insights and competitive advantages. Map, cleanse, and normalize raw, disparate blockchain data (transaction logs, smart contract events, state changes) into consistent, structured relational and non-relational schemes for consumption by analytics, machine learning, and AI tools. This role requires a unique blend of expertise in distributed systems, data engineering best practices, and a profound understanding of the crypto and decentralized ecosystem. What You’ll Do Maintain an AI-native and blockchain-forward mindset, proactively leveraging emerging trends and generative technologies to stay at the vanguard of the crypto revolution while maximizing work efficiency and uncovering novel, high-alpha data opportunities. Architect Intuitive Data Models: Turn the messiness of on-chain data into elegant, unified abstractions. You'll build the models that provide our users with granular, high-integrity insights across various protocols. Deconstruct DeFi Mechanics: Get under the hood of DeFi protocols. You'll reverse-engineer smart contracts and on-chain events, translating complex interactions into clean, production-grade SQL/dbt models. Scale Our Ecosystem Coverage: Lead the charge in indexing new blockchains. You’ll design the schemas that transform raw chain data into our internal "source of truth," ensuring every block is captured with 100% accuracy. Engineer Signal from Noise: Define the metrics that matter (TVL, Volume, Fees). You’ll be the gatekeeper of data quality, proactively identifying and filtering out wash trading, bot activity, and Sybil attacks. What You'll Need: Experience 3+ years hands-on in Data Science, Data Engineering, or a hybrid role; Blockchain or crypto analytics background strongly preferred, familiarity with on-chain data structures, transaction semantics, and asset classification; Streaming & Lakehouse Apache Flink or Spark Streaming building and operating real-time data pipelines; Apache Iceberg or Apache Hudi managing large-scale Data Lakehouses with schema evolution, time travel, and ACID guarantees over petabytes of raw blockchain data; AWS Data Platform S3 for scalable data lake storage; RDS for structured relational workloads; Spark SQL and PySpark for interactive querying and ad-hoc analysis; Caching & Distribution Familiarity with Data Grid technologies (e.g. Hazelcast, Apache Ignite, Redis) for high-throughput, low-latency data access patterns; Languages & Tooling SQL advanced query writing, window functions, query plan analysis, performance tuning at scale; Python Pandas, Polars for data wrangling; Scikit-learn for model development; Proficient in architecting high-throughput ingestion pipelines that leverage external data sources REST/WebSocket APIs, JSON-RPC node queries; Strong grasp of ETL fundamentals (extract, transform, load), including managing schema mismatches between heterogeneous sources and destinations; Engineering Mindset Systematic approach to debugging: reproducing issues, isolating root cause, validating fixes; Comfortable working with large, semi-structured, or undocumented data sources. Why Join Lukka ? Are you looking for a challenge? Lukka solves the most complex data and technology challenges for an industry that is at the forefront of innovation. At Lukka , we strive to anticipate and respond to the needs of this new and ever-changing ecosystem of digital assets. That was true in 2014, while everyone was focused on trading & buying this new asset class, we were thinking about the tax implications of crypto. That innovative foresight continues today as we evolve and iterate on our product suite to address the regulations and educate our customers. We are looking for passionate, collaborative, and strategic individuals who want to help shape the future of, well, everything – starting with making crypto more accountable. We invest in our teammates, promote from within & are responsible to each other by fostering an inclusive space for curious minds to thrive and innovate. What’s life @ Lukka like? We move fast and continue to be ahead of the curve. You could be part of a growing company bridging the gap between business and blockchain. Here’s some insight into why our team members have joined: Ability to own the projects they work on; Less red tape to take ideas from inception to delivery; Being at the forefront of an industry; Small team, big dreams. Of course, let’s discuss some perks: Opportunity to work directly on data for digital assets, an industry-leading product with well-known clients. Working with multiple AI solutions daily. Exposure to both technical problem-solving and customer-facing challenges. A growing Poland-based team with direct collaboration across US and global stakeholders. A startup-style culture where your impact is visible every day. So you’ve scrolled, your interest is piqued and hopefully read all of the important things...now what? This is an exciting time to join a team that’s at the forefront of this rapidly growing industry. We are looking for people who constantly push themselves to think differently, are ready to face new challenges and chart exciting new paths. If this sounds like you, apply! items.summary: You’re more valuable than ever – And that’s just how we’ll make you feel.
items.description: You’re more valuable than ever – And that’s just how we’ll make you feel. Job Summary The LMS Administrator serves as the primary system administrator and subject matter expert for the organization's Workday Learning platform. This role is responsible for the configuration, administration, governance, optimization, reporting, and ongoing support of enterprise learning technologies. The LMS Administrator partners closely with Learning, Talent Management, IT, Operations and business stakeholders to deliver effective learning solutions, maintain data integrity, support compliance requirements, and drive an exceptional learner experience. This position provides advanced Workday Learning administration, reporting and analytics, troubleshooting, learning program deployment, and support for system enhancements, integrations, and continuous improvement initiatives. The role requires extensive knowledge of Workday Learning functionality, learning operations, data management, business processes, and enterprise learning best practices. Qualifications Education Required: Bachelor’s degree in Informatics, Information Technology, Instructional Design, Education, Business Administration, Human Resources or related fields. • Direct work experience will be considered in lieu of a degree. Work Experience Required: 3+ years of direct experience in Learning Management System (LMS) administration. Significant experience or certification in using Workday Learning LMS. Preferred Qualifications, Education, Licenses, Certifications, Experience, etc.: Workday Learning certifications highly desired. Experience with Workday HRIS and API integrations. Experience with Docuware and Sigma to store and analyze data. Troubleshooting skills and knowledge of deeper LMS functionalities. Preferred certifications are desired and include, but are not limited to: Instructional Design, eLearning development, or print design (e.g., ATD, Articulate, Adobe Captivate), Information Technology (e.g., CompTIA, SQL) Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Advanced knowledge of Workday Learning administration, including learning assignments, certifications, learning campaigns/engagements, course management, learner audiences, security roles, and learning compliance processes. Demonstrated experience administering and optimizing enterprise Learning Management Systems (LMS), including system configuration, user support, reporting, governance, and continuous improvement initiatives. Strong understanding of learning technologies and standards, including SCORM, xAPI, online learning content deployment, learning pathways, certifications, and compliance based training programs. Experience supporting Workday Learning implementations, system enhancements, tenant testing, release management, data migration, and post-implementation optimization activities. Working knowledge of Workday Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB), data imports, mass uploads, integrations, and related data management processes. Ability to build, analyze, and maintain reports, dashboards, and learning analytics to support business decisions, compliance requirements, and learning effectiveness measurement. Knowledge of HRIS and learning system integrations, with an understanding of APIs, data exchanges, and enterprise system architecture. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify root causes, resolve complex technical issues, and recommend scalable system solutions. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly, develop system documentation, and effectively collaborate with stakeholders at all organizational levels. Proven ability to establish and maintain LMS governance standards, administrative procedures, documentation, and quality controls that ensure data integrity and system consistency. Experience managing multiple priorities, projects, and system-related initiatives while maintaining accuracy, organization, and attention to detail. Self-motivated and highly accountable, with the ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and take ownership of system performance and user experience. Demonstrated ability to build strong partnerships across Learning & Development, Talent Management, IT, Operations, and business stakeholder groups. Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, as well as reporting and data analysis tools such as Workday Reporting, Sigma, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms. Experience with instructional design and eLearning authoring tools such as Articulate Storyline, Rise, Vyond, Adobe Captivate, or similar solutions is preferred. Commitment to continuous learning and staying current on Workday functionality, learning technology trends, industry best practices, and emerging workforce development solutions. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Workday Learning Administration & Governance Serve as the primary system administrator and subject matter expert for the Workday Learning platform. Configure, maintain, and optimize Workday Learning functionality, including learning assignments, certifications, learning campaigns, learner audiences, security roles, business processes, and system settings. Establish and maintain LMS governance standards, system documentation, administrative procedures, and quality controls to ensure data integrity, security, compliance, and consistency. Evaluate, test, and implement Workday releases, new functionality, and system enhancements to improve organizational learning capabilities and user experience. Ensure compliance with organizational, regulatory, and audit requirements related to learning records and training documentation. Learning Operations & Content Administration Administer enterprise learning programs, compliance training, certifications, curricula, learning pathways, and other learning initiatives within Workday Learning. Create, publish, update, archive, and maintain instructor-led, virtual, blended, and eLearning content while ensuring accurate course data, metadata, version control, and user accessibility. Partner with Learning & Development, Talent Management, IT, Operations and other business stakeholders to deploy and support learning solutions that align with organizational goals and enhance learner engagement. Reporting, Analytics, & Data Management Develop, maintain, and distribute reports, dashboards, and analytics to monitor learning participation, compliance, completion rates, certifications, adoption, and program effectiveness. Analyze learning and system data, perform audits, and manage data maintenance activities to ensure accuracy, compliance, and actionable business insights. System Enhancements, Integrations, & Technical Support Identify opportunities to improve learning operations through automation, process improvements, workflow optimization, and system enhancements. Support integrations, data exchanges, imports, and maintenance activities between Workday Learning and other enterprise systems, including Workday HCM. items.summary: GENERAL JOB DESCRIPTION & RESPONSIBILITIESWe are looking for an experienced, results-driven Marketing Campaign Analyst to transform raw marketing and patient engagement data into structured insights that support better decision-making.
items.description: GENERAL JOB DESCRIPTION & RESPONSIBILITIES We are looking for an experienced, results-driven Marketing Campaign Analyst to transform raw marketing and patient engagement data into structured insights that support better decision-making. This includes identifying trends, evaluating campaign effectiveness, and highlighting opportunities to improve marketing efficiency and return on investment. This role is responsible for analyzing, measuring, and reporting on the performance of marketing campaigns across Keplr Vision practices, and plays a critical part in helping the organization understand what is driving patient acquisition, conversion, and retention across multiple marketing channels and locations. In addition to analysis and reporting, this role is responsible for building and maintaining consistent marketing performance reporting frameworks. The analyst will ensure that marketing metrics are clearly defined, consistently applied, and reliably tracked across campaigns, channels, and practice locations. The Marketing Campaign Analyst will also support the development and execution of testing and measurement approaches, including campaign performance comparisons, A/B testing, and incremental impact analysis where applicable. Over time, this role will help mature the organization’s marketing measurement capabilities by improving consistency, transparency, and scalability of reporting processes. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Marketing Campaign Performance & Insights Analyze marketing campaign performance across multiple channels (e.g., paid and owned digital, CRM, email) Identify trends in patient acquisition, conversion, and retention performance Develop insights and recommendations to improve campaign effectiveness and ROI Segment patient and prospect populations to support targeting and messaging optimization Support forecasting and performance tracking for ongoing campaigns Present clear, concise performance summaries to Marketing and cross-functional stakeholders Reporting, Measurement, & Analytics Execution Build and maintain marketing performance dashboards and reporting Support development of KPIs, measurement frameworks, and reporting standards Conduct campaign analysis including A/B testing and basic lift/impact measurement Ensure consistency and accuracy of marketing performance data across sources Standardize recurring reporting across campaigns, channels, and practices EXPERIENCE & SKILLS Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Economics, Statistics or related field. Experience: 3–6+ years of experience in marketing analytics, campaign analytics, or related role Experience in healthcare, optical, or multi-location retail environments preferred Strong SQL skills for data extraction and analysis Experience with Power BI or similar data visualization tools Familiarity with marketing platforms (CRM, email marketing tools, digital advertising platforms) Experience with Google Analytics or similar web analytics tools Understanding of marketing KPIs, campaign performance metrics, and testing concepts Skills: Strong attention to detail and data accuracy Ability to communicate insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders Strong cross-functional collaboration skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills Results-oriented, analytical mindset with ability to drive continuous improvement REPORTING Reports to: Senior Director, Market Insights Supervises: TBD Interacts with: Marketing, Merchandising and Business Insights Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the teammate for this job. items.description: What do we do? Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better. We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 6000 software sellers in 245 territories globally. The Role: We are seeking a Senior Analytics Engineer to drive significant business impact by shaping our data infrastructure, developing robust data models, and promoting best practices in analytics engineering (e.g., data quality, documentation, and scalable data architectures). You will collaborate closely with the Marketing team in order to ensure that funnels are being tracked and surfaced in our data models and that Marketing campaigns can be evaluated using accurate data. What you'll do: Create trusted, self-serve datasets and reporting layers in Omni that power Marketing performance reviews, campaign reporting, attribution analysis, funnel health monitoring, and investment decision-making. Proactively identify and resolve data quality issues across Marketing and GTM systems, including source tracking, campaign metadata, funnel stage completeness, attribution coverage, and spend data. Add comprehensive metadata to datasets, including documentation, lineage, ownership, definitions, data quality checks, and sensitive data masking. Partner with Marketing stakeholders to translate business questions into robust data products, dashboards, analyses, and decision-ready insights. Enable Marketing teams to confidently use Omni and core GTM datasets through documentation, training, office hours, and self-serve resources. Activate data from Snowflake into operational tools where needed, supporting audience segmentation, lifecycle programmes, campaign optimisation, or GTM workflows. We'd love to hear from you: Extensive experience in analytics engineering or related data roles, with demonstrated expertise in advanced SQL, dbt, and Snowflake. Proficient in using BI tools (e.g. Tableau, Looker, PowerBI, Snowsight) to deliver clear, actionable insights for business stakeholders. Skilled in performing data ingestion and activation using no-code tools (e.g. Fivetran, Stitch), ensuring efficient data integration into operational systems. Knowledgeable in managing metadata, documentation, data quality checks, and sensitive data masking effectively. Effective at collaborating closely with diverse stakeholders, understanding their data needs, and delivering impactful solutions. Experienced in conducting training sessions and providing informal mentorship to junior analytics team members, fostering a collaborative and knowledge-sharing environment. Familiar with Marketing and GTM data concepts such as campaign tracking, attribution, funnel stages, lead/account lifecycle, pipeline generation, paid media, web analytics, CRM data, and marketing automation data. Experienced with common GTM tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, Google Analytics, ad platforms, enrichment tools, or similar. The exact stack is less important than the ability to understand how GTM data is created, transformed, and used. Comfortable working across Marketing, RevOps, Sales, Finance, and Data to align definitions, reporting logic, and ownership. Everyone is welcome at Paddle At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group. Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together. Our Values Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us” Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple” Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs” Why you’ll love working at Paddle We are a diverse, growing group of Paddlers across the globe who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture. We are a ‘digital-first’ company, which means you can work remotely, from one of our stylish hubs, or even a bit of both! We offer all team members unlimited holidays and 4 months paid family leave regardless of gender. We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

items.title: Lead Product Analyst, B2C Financial Services
items.summary: Tabby is on a mission to give people power over their money.
items.description: Tabby is on a mission to give people power over their money. For too long, financial systems have worked for the institutions that built them, not the people using them. Runaway interest, fine print and limited access have left many behind, feeling shut out of a system that wasn't setting them up for success. We're building a different kind of system, in a complete money app to send, spend and save. One that's clear, flexible and puts people and businesses in control. Founded in 2019, we serve customers and businesses across Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and Kuwait. Millions of customers and 65,000 global brands, government services and small businesses rely on us today. What began as a better way to pay at checkout has grown into a financial system working the way it should have all along. About the roleThis role focuses on Tabby Cash , and the growing ecosystem of our debit financial products. You will lead a team of analysts that work on activation, engagement, and profitability , helping shape how the product grows from 1 → 100. The role requires balancing user growth with sustainable economics , working across Product, Risk, and Growth teams. You will play a key role in defining how users adopt and use our cards, and how we optimize the products for long-term value. What you will be doing Lead a team of product analysts to provide support to the product and business teams across all aspects of their work. Generate hypotheses, conduct research and A/B tests, and present your findings clearly and compellingly, which highlights the importance of your insights. Regularly work with several stakeholders, including product and marketing teams, on fundamental research as well as on one-time requests. Support and monitor existing metrics for the Financial Products, identify areas for improvement, and develop new metrics that inform decision-making across the organization. Develop data visualizations and reports that are both informative and easily understood by business and product teams. Assist in the planning of necessary data structures and data quality improvements. What you will need Minimum of 4 years of work experience as a data/product analyst. Experience in leading a team of data analysts of any size. Proficiency in SQL and relational databases. Proficiency in data visualization and BI tools. Experience in planning data structures for new products and features. Strong knowledge of Python (Pandas, Numpy, Statsmodels, Matplotlib, etc.) Experience in product analytics in fintech is a plus. Experience in leveraging LLM/AI for analytical purposes is a plus. Strong quantitative skills and a structured approach to problem-solving. Ability to analyze issues, identify root causes, and recommend solutions. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact with business and product teams. At least an upper-intermediate level of English proficiency is required. What we offer: Full-time B2B contract Fully remote setup Up to 20% tax allowance 22 paid leave days annually Stock options (ESOP) in a fast-scaling, pre-IPO company Flexi benefits you can use for wellness, travel, or learning Work alongside a high-performing, international engineering team in a global fintech unicorn Relocation support is available to our hubs in Armenia, Georgia, Serbia, Portugal, and Spain, including flights, temporary accommodation, and legal setup (if needed) What you can expect We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team. A working environment that gives you autonomy and responsibility from day one. You should be comfortable with the idea that the quality of your work will influence the shape of your career. We are passionate about creating an inclusive, high-performing workplace that gives people from all backgrounds the support they need to thrive, grow, and meet their goals. items.title: Senior UX Research and Design Specialist
items.summary: Cambium Learning® Group is an award-winning educational technology solutions leader dedicated to helping all students reach their potential through individualized and differentiated instruction.
items.description: Cambium Learning® Group is an award-winning educational technology solutions leader dedicated to helping all students reach their potential through individualized and differentiated instruction. Using a research-based, personalized approach, Cambium Learning Group delivers SaaS resources and instructional products that engage students and support teachers in fun, positive, safe and scalable environments. These solutions are provided through Learning A-Z® (online differentiated instruction for elementary school reading, writing and science), ExploreLearning® (online interactive math and science simulations, a math fact fluency solution, and a K–2 science solution), Voyager Sopris Learning® (blended solutions that accelerate struggling learners to achieve in literacy and math and professional development for teachers), and VKidz Learning (online comprehensive homeschool education and programs for literacy and science). We believe that every student has unlimited potential, that teachers matter, and that data, instruction, and practice are the keys to success in the classroom and beyond. Job Overview: We are seeking a highly skilled Senior UX Research & Design Specialist with a dual passion for user advocacy and tangible web design. In this role, you will lead end-to-end qualitative and quantitative research cycles within our K-12 educational data and assessment platforms. Beyond traditional data synthesis, you possess a strong sense of visual and layout design, allowing you to translate raw researcher findings directly into clean, interactive, and tangible UI prototypes. You will act as a critical bridge between educator insights and production-ready web design. Job Responsibilities: Advanced User Research & Methodology Execute End-to-End Research: Lead qualitative and quantitative research initiatives (focus groups, structured interviews, surveys, and usability testing) involving teachers, instructional coaches, and school administrators. Conduct Market & Competitive Analysis: Perform targeted market and competitive research to evaluate industry trends, benchmark rival EdTech solutions, and identify strategic positioning opportunities for our platform features. Drive Feedback Syntheses: Design and facilitate educator panels to capture nuanced workflows, translating feedback into clear product design opportunities. Iterate and Track Perceptions: Build systematic, iterative research loops to measure shifts in user perception and long-term platform adoption. Manage Diverse Recruitment: Orchestrate participant recruitment strategies across varied K-12 demographics (elementary, middle, and high school tenures). Tangible Web Design & Interactive Prototyping Translate Insights into Mockups: Convert user pain points and research metrics into high-fidelity web designs, intuitive screen flows, and interactive layouts. Bridge Design and Engineering: Collaborate directly with front-end web designers by delivering design specifications that map closely to web structure realities. Refine Interface Hierarchy: Evaluate and rapidly iterate on layout sequences, visual hierarchies, UI text labeling, and main navigation structures. K-12 Assessment & Data Literacy Demystify Student Data: Apply deep knowledge of K-12 grading architectures and standards-based reporting to build accessible teacher dashboards. Align with Classroom Realities: Design specifically for time-constrained educators who need immediate visual data displays for student remediation and administrative groupings. Data Visualization & Web Usability Apply Visualization Best Practices: Craft clean, visual progress bars, color-coded matrices, and grouping indicators tailored for non-technical users. Enforce Digital Accessibility: Ensure all generated data visualizations and interface layouts meet inclusive, accessible design guidelines. Job Requirements: Experience: 7+ years of dedicated professional experience in UX research, interface design, or digital analytics architectures. Preferred Degrees: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Interaction Design, Human Factors, Cognitive Psychology, Computer Science, or a related behavioral/technology-focused discipline. Design Stack Literacy: Mastery of contemporary UI wireframing and prototyping ecosystems (e.g., Figma). Cross-Functional Communication: Proven ability to present research artifacts (personas, journey maps, insight decks) to technical development squads and leadership. Preferred & Technical Qualifications: Classroom & Instructional Experience: Prior experience as a K-12 classroom teacher, instructional coach, or school-level educator, providing firsthand empathy for school schedules, administrative burdens, and classroom data usage. Front-End Development Frameworks: Functional technical understanding of front-end development, specifically the ability to read, interpret, and write HTML5 and CSS3 code to facilitate seamless developer handoffs. AI Tooling Efficiency: Demonstrated proficiency leveraging AI productivity systems and predictive tools to generate user scripts, synthesize large datasets, and build rapid UI prototypes. EdTech Domain Experience: Direct familiarity with standards-based grading metrics, formative assessment patterns, and large-scale district or state educational technology rollouts. Compliance Standards: Working familiarity with compliance rules governing K-12 web ecosystems, including WCAG accessibility benchmarks and FERPA privacy guardrails. To apply for this opportunity, simply click on the “Apply” button and submit a cover letter and resume. An Equal Opportunity Employer We are dedicated to fostering a culture that celebrates unique backgrounds, ideas, and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability. items.description: Data and Analytics Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet. The Team Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers. The Role As a Lead AI Consultant (Field) (known internally - Lead Deployment Engineer) of the Iberia & LATAM region, you are the backbone of Celonis delivery. You lead the hands-on implementation of Celonis solutions for enterprise customers, combining platform expertise with AI-augmented workflows to deliver high-quality outcomes, fast. You use Celonis’s AI deployment tools as your primary instruments - directing agents to build data models, generate analyses, and configure operational solutions, while applying your own judgment to validate outputs, adapt to customer context, and ensure business relevance. You will lead the team of junior Consultants and team with experts (AI, Product, Functional) to make sure the customer achieves value and adoption. As a strategic driver in the pre-sales stage, you will partner closely with Account Teams to shape and position our Services solutions. You won't just present offerings—you will architect the foundation for long-term customer success, ensuring rapid adoption and value realization. This is not a traditional consulting role where you build everything manually. You are Product expert and an AI-augmented delivery professional: you specify what needs to be built, direct AI agents to execute wherever possible, validate the results, and iterate with the customer. You generate value by understanding the customer’s business, translating their needs into technical specifications and solutions, to ensure the platform delivers measurable impact and adoption. The Work You’ll Do Pre-Sales: Designing tailored deployment roadmaps and implementation strategies aligned with the customer's maturity. Estimating project timelines, team structures, and overall professional services effort to support commercial proposals. Partnering with Account Executives and Value Engineers to translate business cases into actionable deployment plans. Drafting clear Statements of Work (SOW), defining project scope, deliverables, assumptions, and acceptance criteria. Aligning client expectations with operational feasibility to prevent post-sale scope creep. Post-Sales: Initiate and Connect Define the strategy and oversee junior Consultants covering - Conduct business discovery workshops to translate customers’ strategic objectives into high-impact Celonis use cases Collaborate with the customer’s IT and business stakeholders to define project scope, data requirements, and success criteria Ensure data connectivity and extraction pipelines are properly configured, working with specialist resources if required Build & Value Direct AI deployment agents to build data models, process analyses, KPIs, and dashboards - writing clear specifications and validating agent outputs against business requirements – do we make this less of a must have? Build and configure Celonis solutions across the platform: Process Intelligence Graph, data transformations, process analysis, operational solutions, and AI-powered insights Identify process inefficiencies and root causes using Celonis technology, always in close collaboration with the customer Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, business relevance, and alignment with customer context - applying domain knowledge where the AI cannot Lead value creation workshops and define measures to improve process inefficiencies Define and build KPIs measuring the customer’s success and quantify business impact Design and build operational solutions to drive value, adoption and improve process conformance Rollout, Adoption, and Handover Enable key customer users to use and extend the solution independently, setting the foundation for long-term adoption Manage project outcomes against timelines, scope, and customer expectations Train and demonstrate to customer users, guiding them on the path to sustained value Document solution design decisions and configurations for future reference and handoff Domain & Industry Depth Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage Proactively identify and standardize high-value use cases within your domain, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap What Makes This Role Different in the AI Era You work with AI agents as your primary tools - your job is to direct, validate, and refine their output, not to write every line of code or build every analysis manually – still hands on technical? You need strong specification and context engineering skills - the ability to translate a customer’s ambiguous business need into a precise instruction that an AI agent can execute correctly You are expected to continuously learn and adapt as AI capabilities evolve, experimenting with new approaches and sharing what works with your peers You balance speed with quality - AI accelerates execution, but you own the judgment calls on whether the output is right for this customer You think in sustainable software solutions. While AI agents will generate first results quickly, you need to ensure that the operational solutions you build in Celonis are robust, user friendly, maintainable, and scalable The Qualifications You Need Experience: 7+ years in Management or IT consulting, data/solution consulting, or process improvement consulting within software vendors, consulting firms, or system integrators. Consulting pre-sales experience Platform skills: Track record in complex IT/SAP transformations, process optimization, and PQL/SQL/Python technical capability AI fluency: Comfort working with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). Ability to write clear specifications, evaluate AI-generated outputs, and iterate effectively. Experience with prompt engineering or context engineering is a strong plus. Business and process domain expertise : Strong understanding /deep expertise (based on seniority level) of enterprise business processes and financial metrics. Knowledge of standard ERPs (SAP, Oracle) and process areas (Inventory Management, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Accounts Payable) is a strong plus. Consulting skills: Ability to steer customer workshops, present findings to management, manage stakeholder expectations, and deliver outcomes in the face of adversity and ambiguity. Comfortable working with both technical and business audiences. Analytical mindset: Excellent problem-solving skills with a value-driven orientation. Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and quantify business impact. Learning agility: Willingness to continuously develop expertise through experimentation. Comfort with ambiguity and evolving tools. Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Technology Management, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a comparable field. Languages: Fluency in English and Spanish required. Portuguese beneficial. Travel : Willingness to travel to customer location up to 50%, according to customer requirement and project delivery phases. What Celonis can offer you: Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations. Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants. Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment. Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration. Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform. Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance. Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually. Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued. Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision. About Us: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide. Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video . Celonis Inclusion Statement: At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen. Your Privacy: Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process . Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here .

items.summary: Who are we and why should you join us? BetterHelp is on a mission to remove the traditional barriers to therapy and make mental health care more accessible to everyone. Founded in 2013, we are now the world’s largest online therapy service, providing affordable and convenient therapy across the globe. Our network of over 30,000…
items.description: Who are we and why should you join us? BetterHelp is on a mission to remove the traditional barriers to therapy and make mental health care more accessible to everyone. Founded in 2013, we are now the world’s largest online therapy service, providing affordable and convenient therapy across the globe. Our network of over 30,000 licensed therapists has helped millions of people take ownership of their mental health and change their lives forever. And we’re not stopping there – as the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution. As a Data Scientist at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of licensed clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. And as a mental health company, we take employee mental health just as seriously as we do our mission. We deeply invest in our team’s well-being and professional development, because we know that business and individual growth go hand-in-hand. At BetterHelp, you’ll carve your own path, make an immediate impact, and be challenged every day – with a supportive community behind you the whole way. What are we looking for? BetterHelp is looking for a Data Scientist to help us scale and increase our impact. You will use cutting-edge methods to optimize our marketing efforts. The ideal candidate would have experience analyzing large and complex data sets related to web products. You'll be contributing to efforts in marketing inference, including our Marketing Mix Model and Attribution. What will you do? Get insight from an enormous amount of data, and take a proactive role partnering with the marketing team in finding and testing data-driven ideas for improving our efficiency. Contribute to the development, implementation, and maintenance of our marketing models, including a Bayesian Marketing Mix Model and a Multi-Touch Attribution model. Monitor and analyze marketing uplift tests with statistical rigor, present the data and insights to the team, and drive marketing decisions. Look at complex problems and come up with testable models and algorithms that have measurable business impact. Enjoy great teamwork, have lots of fun, and take pride in building a world-class product that makes a difference in people's lives. What will you NOT do? You will NOT worry about "runway", "cash left", or "how much time we have until the next round". We have the startup DNA but we're fully backed and funded, all the way to success. You will NOT be confined to your "job". You will get involved in product, marketing, business strategy, and almost everything we do. You will NOT be bogged down by office politics, ego, or bad attitude. Only positive, pleasure-to-work-with people are allowed here! You will NOT get yourself burned out. We work hard but we believe in maintaining a sustainable work/life balance. Really. Can I work remotely? Yes. We operate on PST and candidates in any time zone are welcome to apply. We ask employees to travel to our San Jose, CA office up to three times per year plus one company-wide offsite to collaborate in person and strengthen working relationships. Travel expenses are covered and reasonable accommodations are made for those under unique circumstances who cannot travel. Requirements BSc/MA in a quantitative discipline such as Statistics, Math, Economics, Computer Science, Operations Research, or Engineering 3+ years of experience in a quantitative data analysis role involving user behavior (e.g. marketing, product, UI/UX) and large data sets Expertise in statistics, especially as it relates to hypothesis testing and experiment design Experience analyzing A/B tests as well as experiments with more advanced statistical methods like difference-in-difference, regression discontinuity, or other methods that deal with network effects or panel data Experience building predictive models and causal inference models Experience analyzing large and complex data sets to drive business insights and decisions Expertise in using tools like R and Python for data analysis Proven success supporting or making business decisions based on your data analysis Excellent communication skills, with experience simplifying complex topics and communicating technical ideas with non-technical audiences. Advanced experience with SQL Bonus (Great to have but not required) Experience with Bayesian modeling methods Experience with Marketing Mix Models and Multi-Touch Attribution models Experience analyzing two-sided marketplaces Experience with B2C, marketplace products Experience with BI tools like Tableau and Looker Benefits Remote work with regular in-person bonding experiences sponsored by the company Competitive compensation Holistic perks program (including free therapy, employee wellness, and more) Excellent health, dental, and vision coverage 401k benefits with employer matching contribution The chance to build something that changes lives – and that people love Any piece of hardware or software that will make you happy and productive An awesome community of co-workers The base salary range for this position is $130,000 - $160,000. In addition to the base salary, this position is eligible for a performance bonus and the extensive benefits listed here (subject to eligibility requirements): Teladoc Health Benefits 2026 . Total compensation is based on several factors – including, but not limited to, type of position, location, education level, work experience, and certifications. This information is applicable to all full-time positions. At BetterHelp we thrive on difference and individuality, and as part of the Teladoc Health family, we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We never have and never will discriminate against any job candidate or employee due to age, race, ethnicity, religion, sex, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, medical condition, marital status, parental status, disability, or Veteran status. Notice to Candidates: BetterHelp has been made aware of fraudulent job postings and unaffiliated third parties posing as our recruiting team – please know that we have no affiliation or connection to these situations. We only post open roles on our career page ( betterhelp.com/careers ) or reputable job boards like our official LinkedIn or Indeed pages, and all official BetterHelp recruitment emails will come from the domain @ betterhelp.com . Our commitment is to ensure a safe and transparent hiring experience for all candidates. We will never ask you for money, gift cards, or any form of payment during our hiring process, and we will never send money or checks to candidates. If you experience this, it is a scam.

items.description: Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role. Consensys is the leading blockchain and web3 software company. Founded by Joe Lubin, CEO of Consensys and Co-Founder of Ethereum in 2014, Consensys has been at the forefront of innovation, pioneering technological developments within the web3 ecosystem. The financial system is being rebuilt on open, programmable infrastructure, and Consensys is helping power that transition. From MetaMask, the platform trusted by tens of millions of users worldwide, to Linea, the only 100% proven zkEVM rollup and an emerging home for institutional ETH capital, Consensys builds products and infrastructure that enable users, developers, and institutions to participate in the next generation of the internet. Our mission is to unlock the collaborative power of communities by making the decentralized web universally easy to access, use, and build on. Joining Consensys means working with a fully remote, globally distributed team of technologists, designers, cryptographers, product thinkers, and researchers who are building the next layer of the internet. You'll be exposed to new ideas, emerging technologies, and complex challenges that push you to stay at the top of your game while helping scale products and infrastructure used by tens of millions of users and thousands of developers across the web3 ecosystem. You'll join a network of builders that reaches the edge of our ecosystem. Consensys alumni have moved on to become tech entrepreneurs, CEOs, and team leads at tech companies. About PODS Team People and Talent support the members of our Consensys community. We strive to be the destination employer of choice for our ecosystem. That goal is embedded in all the work we do to attract, retain and support our incredible talent. PODS — People Operations, Data & Systems — is the infrastructure layer behind everything our People team does — the systems, data, and operational processes that make it possible to hire, pay, onboard, develop, and support people at scale. When this function works well, it's invisible. When it doesn't, everyone notices. We're looking for someone to take ownership of our core People systems. In this role, you will be the primary subject matter expert on ADP Workforce Now and the broader HR technology ecosystem, the person Finance calls when People data doesn't match, the person Legal calls when they need audit evidence, and the person the People & Talent team relies on for system builds, enhancements, and troubleshooting. What you’ll do HRIS administration and system integrity You are the technical owner of ADP Workforce Now and the PODS technology ecosystem. System health, configuration, data integrity, and day-to-day administration are yours — not tasks you contribute to, but outcomes you own. Platform ownership — Manage day-to-day ADP WFN configuration, security roles, workflows, custom fields, and system health. You know where everything is, why it's set up the way it is, and what breaks if it changes. Business process design — Take business needs from requirements through configuration, testing, and post-launch validation — end to end, without handing off. When a stakeholder brings you a problem, you translate it into a working system solution and own it through to adoption. Product releases — Own configuration, testing, and rollout of new ADP product releases and system enhancements. Proactively flag opportunities to simplify or automate existing processes before problems surface. Integration management — Own all system integrations across payroll entities, benefits carriers, finance tools, and core HR platforms — both automated API connections and manual data flows. Monitor, troubleshoot, and escalate when things break. Security and access — Manage role-based access across HR systems, enforce least-privilege standards, and maintain SOX-ready access review evidence on a defined cadence. Vendor management — Own day-to-day vendor relationships across the stack — performance accountability, escalation paths, SLA tracking, and contract awareness. Not just ticket submission. Technical project ownership and process automation You lead technical workstreams from intake through completion — representing the People Operations perspective on systems, data, and integration projects across the organization. Technical project ownership — Own HR systems and data projects end to end — scoping, configuration, testing, rollout, and documentation. You represent PODS interests in cross-functional projects and ensure the People Operations perspective is built into technical decisions, not bolted on afterward. Process automation — Systematically replace manual, error-prone workflows with automated processes. Use AI-assisted tools to rapidly prototype and build People Operations automations — turning process ideas into working solutions on fast, business-critical timelines. Measure the reduction in manual effort and error rates over time. SOX and compliance — Maintain documented controls, gather and organize audit evidence, and partner with Legal and Finance to ensure People systems meet compliance requirements at every stage. Change management — Test before deploying. Document after deploying. Communicate to stakeholders before either. Every system change has a testing plan, a rollout plan, and a runbook. Data management and stakeholder enablement You are the check-and-balance for People data across the organization — and the person who makes that data accessible and understandable to the people who depend on it. Data governance — Establish and maintain data definitions, quality standards, field ownership, and retention policies. When two stakeholders get different answers to the same question, you are the reason that stops happening. Reporting and analysis — Prepare, review, and analyze People data and reports. Build custom reports and executive-facing dashboards in ADP and connected tools. Translate outputs into clear, actionable information for Finance, FP&A, Legal, and People leadership. Audits — Run recurring data audits, maintain audit logs, and ensure evidence is organized and retrievable. Catch discrepancies before they reach stakeholders. Documentation and training — Maintain up-to-date process documentation and deliver training materials for new system enhancements. Build genuine self-service capability in the HR team — reducing the ad hoc support load over time. Operational support You provide timely, effective support for daily system needs and cyclical operations — and you use patterns in that support to build lasting fixes rather than repeat the same interventions. Employee and manager support — Provide responsive support for system questions, access issues, and ad hoc requests. Identify recurring patterns and build runbooks or automations to address root causes. Cyclical operations — Own the systems side of open enrollment, compensation cycles, re-orgs, payroll close, and year-end processes. These run on a schedule — they need to run without heroics. Vendor relationships — Hold vendors accountable to SLAs, manage escalations above the support queue, and keep contract renewal dates on the radar. Would be great if you brought this to the role Deep functional expertise in ADP Workforce Now — you have configured workflows, built reports, managed security roles, and troubleshot integration failures as a hands-on administrator, not as an end user 5+ years of progressive experience in HR systems administration, HRIS configuration, or HR technology operations A track record of business process design end to end — you've taken requirements from a stakeholder conversation through configuration, testing, launch, and post-launch validation without handing off Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business needs into working system solutions — you ask the right questions, design the right solution, and build it Experience with process automation and AI-assisted tooling — you've used modern tools to prototype and build automations that eliminated meaningful manual effort, and you can point to the results Strong data management instincts — you've built custom reports, run data audits, caught data quality issues before they became business problems, and you understand what governance actually means in practice SOX or audit compliance experience — you understand what controls mean, what evidence looks like, and what an auditor will ask for Project management capability — you've managed a high volume of requests and shifting priorities without losing track of what matters most, and you communicate status without being asked Intellectual curiosity and sound judgment — you ask why something works the way it does, and you know when to move fast and when to slow down and think A bias for action paired with resilience in ambiguity — you've operated in fast-moving environments where requirements changed mid-project and you didn't wait for perfect information to make progress Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role. It is a requirement of employment in this position that applicants will be required to submit to background checks including but not limited to employment, education and criminal record checks. Further details will be provided to applicants that successfully meet the criteria for the position as determined by the company in its sole discretion. By submitting an application for employment, you are acknowledging and consenting to this requirement. The salary range listed for this role applies to US-based candidates only. Compensation for candidates based outside the US (including Canada, EMEA, and LATAM) will be determined based on location, experience, and skills during the interview process, and may differ from the listed US range. US pay range (not including bonus, equity or other benefits) $122,000—$183,000 USD In the rapidly evolving Web3 space, we believe that everyone is a builder. This expansive paradigm requires a range of backgrounds, talents, skills, and experiences to influence and shape the future. At Consensys, this diversity fuels our ability to shift control and redefine the realm of possibility. We are committed to ensuring that our technology empowers people and communities with economic and political agency through decentralized technologies. We welcome the range of perspectives and differences and celebrate them. We're excited to see how your unique skills as a builder can contribute to our vision, drive innovation, and help us shape a more inclusive Web3. Consensys is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Consensys is aware of fraudulent recruitment practices and we encourage all applicants to review our best practices to protect yourself which can be found ( https://consensys.io/careers/best-practices-to-avoid-recruitment-fraud/) .

items.summary: About UsAt Digital Forms, we help companies grow through digital transformation — from process optimization and automation to AI and custom software development.
items.description: About Us At Digital Forms , we help companies grow through digital transformation — from process optimization and automation to AI and custom software development. Our technology team designs and builds the solutions that drive this change: scalable systems, data platforms, integrations, and products that make a real business impact. We work with international clients across industries, focusing on long-term, high-quality engineering that supports business growth. Every line of code we write serves a clear purpose — to make technology practical, efficient, and ready for scale. The Role As a Senior Back-End Engineer , you’ll play a key role in designing and building the systems that power our clients’ transformations. You’ll work on challenging, large-scale projects — from custom SaaS platforms to complex integrations — with modern technologies and high autonomy. You’ll collaborate closely with our technical leads, contributing to system architecture, implementing best practices, and delivering robust, maintainable back-end solutions. This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who wants to deepen their expertise, take ownership of key parts of a system, and work in an environment that values quality and thoughtful engineering. Requirements Key Responsibilities Build & Deliver: Design, develop, and maintain scalable back-end systems and APIs in Python (Django, FastAPI), ensuring high performance and reliability. Collaborate: Work closely with front-end developers, DevOps engineers, and business analysts to deliver complete, production-ready solutions. Contribute to Architecture: Participate in architectural discussions and propose improvements that enhance scalability, maintainability, and security. Ensure Quality: Write clean, well-documented code, contribute to code reviews, and promote engineering best practices. Optimize Performance: Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, ensuring stability and efficiency at scale. Deploy & Monitor: Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure (AWS), and observability improvements. Learn & Grow: Continuously improve your skills, exploring new technologies and patterns that make our solutions better. Must-Have Qualifications Strong Python Experience: Solid hands-on experience with Python and modern frameworks (Django, FastAPI).
