Overview We are seeking a Principal Product Analyst to own ZoomInfo's PLG measurement system - the framework that defines how the company evaluates customer adoption, monetization, retention, and growth across its product portfolio. This is not a traditional reporting or dashboarding role. It is a strategic leadership role responsible for defining how the organization measures PLG success, identifying the behaviors that drive business outcomes, and generating the insights that shape product investments and growth strategy. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical depth with operational rigor and a builder mentality. They are comfortable operating in ambiguity, leading investigations from scratch, and influencing decisions across Product, Engineering, Go-To-Market, and Leadership teams. They also embrace AI-native ways of working, leveraging automation and emerging technologies to fundamentally improve how analytics is performed and scaled. PLG experience is a plus but not required. What You'll Do Product Growth Measurement & Operating System Define and own the measurement framework for ZoomInfo’s PLG motion, including acquisition, activation, engagement, monetization, retention, and expansion. Establish the company’s source of truth for PLG performance, including KPI definitions, scorecards, executive reporting, and performance benchmarks. Define leading indicators that predict customer activation, product adoption, conversion, retention, and expansion outcomes. Identify behavioral patterns, friction points, and conversion barriers that impact activation, adoption, retention, and expansion. Build analytical frameworks that help teams prioritize investments across onboarding, activation, engagement, monetization, retention, and expansion. AI-Native Analytics & Operational Excellence Redesign analytics workflows around AI-first operating principles rather than traditional manual processes. Establish scalable reporting and monitoring infrastructure that minimizes manual effort while maintaining analytical rigor. items.description: Product Headquarters: Argentina URL: http://solvd.com Solvd Inc. is a rapidly growing AI-native consulting and technology services firm delivering enterprise transformation across cloud, data, software engineering, and artificial intelligence . We work with industry-leading organizations to design, build, and operationalize technology solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. Our capability centers combine deep technical expertise, proven delivery methodologies, and sector-specific knowledge to address complex business challenges quickly and effectively. We are looking for a Mid-Tier Security Engineer specializing in Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Data Governance to join our Cyber Security team. In this role, you won't just be managing user tickets; you will be the engineer designing, implementing, and securing our identity perimeter and SaaS ecosystem. You will own our Okta environment and drive data governance strategies across our core SaaS applications (e.g., Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Salesforce, GitHub). Your goal is to ensure seamless user lifecycle management while aggressively enforcing the principle of least privilege and monitoring data exposure. What you'll do Identity & Access Management (IAM) Engineering Okta Architecture & Admin: Act as the primary engineer for Okta, managing advanced configurations including custom authorization servers, adaptive MFA, and conditional access policies. Lifecycle Automation: Design and maintain automated joiner-mover-leaver (JML) workflows using Okta Workflows, SCIM, or custom API scripts to eliminate manual provisioning errors. Federation & Protocols: Standardize and implement SSO integrations utilizing SAML 2.0, OIDC, and OAuth 2.0, ensuring secure token exchange and scoping. Data Governance & SaaS Security Least Privilege Enforcement: Design, audit, and refine Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) models across all enterprise SaaS platforms. Data Exposure Mitigation: Monitor and remediate unauthorized data sharing, public file exposure, and "shadow IT" API integrations within our SaaS ecosystem. Access Reviews & Compliance: Lead quarterly user access reviews (UARs) and provide evidentiary support for security frameworks such as SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR. SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM): Leverage SSPM tools or native security centers to continuously audit and harden SaaS application configurations. Monitoring & Incident Response Threat Detection: Analyze Okta System Logs and SaaS audit logs to detect anomalous behavior (e.g., impossible travel, credential stuffing, unauthorized data exfiltration). SIEM Integration: Collaborate with the SOC team to ensure critical IAM and SaaS logs are correctly ingested into our SIEM for real-time alerting. What you bring Experience: 3–5 years of dedicated experience in a Security Engineering, IAM, or Systems Engineering role with a heavy security focus. Okta Mastery: Strong engineering-level knowledge of Okta (Okta Certified Administrator or Certified Consultant preferred). Security Mindset: Proven track record of implementing data governance principles, data loss prevention (DLP), and zero-trust access models. Core Protocols: Deep understanding of networking and identity protocols: TCP/IP, HTTP, SAML, OAuth, OIDC, and SCIM. Scripting: Proficiency in Python, PowerShell, or Bash to interact with REST APIs for custom security tooling and automation. Log Analysis: Experience querying logs (Splunk, ELK, SQL, or cloud-native SIEMs) to investigate identity-related security incidents. If you're excited to build things that matter, champion responsible AI, and grow with some of the industry’s sharpest minds. Apply today and let’s innovate together. items.description: Our Talent Science team ensures that we follow an objective, scientifically rigorous and efficient process to select the very best new colleagues regardless of location, culture or background. With a data centric approach, we examine hiring data to create talent analytics and business intelligence to fuel our decision making on hiring. We leverage data to enable evidence-based decisions, weaving behavioural science throughout our selection process. Working closely with our Hiring Leadership team, who ultimately lead on hiring, our team ensures that hiring decisions are being made in the right way and that our hiring model supports the selection of world class talent. We are looking for a set of leaders to support our team growth and to help drive our strategic objective outcomes. This role will report directly to the Global Head of Talent Science. To be successful you will bring: Analytical tooling to coach and lead the team Experience of leading roadmaps and projects Experience of leading others to achieve exceptional results Location: These are remote based positions that are available across the globe. The role entails Leading a team to deliver against a set of strategic objectives, with focus on product design and implementation of our roadmap. Cracking the code on hiring, connecting performance outcomes back to selection methods to ensure we identify and progress exceptional talent. Designing professional processes and frameworks, allowing efficient delivery of our agenda. Coaching and mentoring team members to grow and develop skill sets specifically around analytical capabilities and thought leadership, developing training materials and documentation to support team members. Driving and representing the team in the absence of the Head of, acting as a credible and trusted adviser and an inspiring leader. Working closely with company leaders to understand, appreciate and communicate our vision for talent at Canonical. What we are looking for in you Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university, with an undergraduate degree in a people based subject. 7+ years experience in a Talent function, with a deep appreciation of recruitment and selection and analytics that drive decision making. Proven analytical ability to dissect and analyse data using SQL. Alternatively use Python, R, SPSS, or, possess the ability to run lookups, indexing, matching formulae with an appetite to learn SQL. Exposure to BI tools (Superset is our platform). Exemplary ability to lead and drive others to deliver, including exceptional project management and coaching to lead roadmap execution and delivery. Exceptional written and spoken English with strong presentation skills for a senior audience. Sincere personal motivation aligned with our mission. International travel 2-4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long. In addition we expect that you will match our values, by being: Precise, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity. Reliable, delivering high quality work that builds trust and confidence. Accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable. Adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character. Nice-to-have skills Advanced psychometric skills. A deep understanding of human behaviour, in particular intrinsic motivation. Experience of using Superset and/or Greenhouse What we offer colleagues We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We assess performance and revisit compensation twice annually to ensure we recognize outstanding colleagues. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally. Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per year Bi-annual compensation review Company recognition rewards 40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods Maternity and paternity leave Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access About Canonical Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing. Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2024, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

items.summary: About the RoleThis company is building an AI executive assistant that operates across email, calendars, meetings, and business software.
items.description: About the Role This company is building an AI executive assistant that operates across email, calendars, meetings, and business software. As a Data Scientist — Agent Evaluations & Quality , you will own the measurement system that determines whether the assistant is genuinely improving in ambiguous, real-world environments. You'll partner directly with AI Agent Capabilities engineers to generate the evidence that shapes product decisions, model choices, and release quality. This is a high-ownership, deeply technical role at the intersection of applied data science, LLM evaluation, and product quality — ideal for someone who thrives on turning hard, open-ended quality questions into rigorous, actionable answers. What You'll Do Architect and maintain automated evaluation pipelines that measure agent quality across product surfaces. Translate agent capabilities into explicit pass, partial-pass, and failure criteria for complex multi-step tasks. Build representative gold datasets and regression suites covering real workflows, edge cases, and adversarial scenarios. Define meaningful metrics — task success, tool-selection accuracy, instruction adherence, factual consistency, latency, cost, and reliability. Design deterministic and model-based graders, calibrate LLM-as-a-judge systems, and track grader agreement. Compare models, prompts, and implementations using rigorous offline experiments and production evidence. Analyze traces and production outcomes to identify root causes and build a practical failure taxonomy. Turn production failures into regression cases and continuously close gaps in evaluation coverage. Build dashboards and release-quality signals that make results actionable for engineering, product, and leadership. Recommend improvements to capability engineers and verify that fixes raise quality without unacceptable regressions. What We're Looking For Required 4+ years in Applied Data Science or Machine Learning roles, with a track record of building and delivering evaluation systems, automated data pipelines, or production ML infrastructure. Experience designing and implementing automated evaluation frameworks, success criteria, and regression suites for complex AI/ML or agentic systems. Production-grade proficiency in Python and SQL , with experience building and maintaining automated analytical pipelines on large datasets. Applied statistical and experimental skills: significance testing, variance analysis, and sampling to evaluate non-deterministic AI/ML systems. Experience developing labeled datasets, annotation guidelines, and quality-control processes for ground-truth data in dynamic product environments. Solid understanding of LLM agent behaviors: tool use, multi-step execution, retrieval, and practical failure modes. Demonstrated ability to analyze model traces, tool calls, and outputs to identify root causes across model, prompt, tool, and data layers. Experience using production telemetry and observability data to monitor system quality, build dashboards, and analyze real-world user outcomes. Nice to Have Hands-on experience with LLM-as-a-judge systems, model-based grading, or AI benchmarking platforms. Experience shipping or operating production ML products, agentic systems, or customer-facing consumer software. Experience reviewing and adapting public research benchmarks or academic evaluation methodologies to real-world product problems. What makes you a great fit You're product-oriented — you prioritize metrics tied to real user outcomes, not just convenient measurements. You drive ambiguous quality questions from evaluation design all the way into product decisions. You write maintainable, production-quality code — not just ad-hoc notebooks. You collaborate naturally with engineers and are comfortable digging into traces and system internals. Location This role is on-site . Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. Compensation & Benefits Compensation details were not provided for this listing. A competitive package commensurate with experience is expected at this stage of company growth. items.description: Employee Benefits is the core of our business and at our heart we are a people-focused organization. Every day, we help over 100,000 employers give their employees peace of mind by providing health, pharmacy, long and short-term disability, vision, dental and other insurance solutions. What makes us unique is that we can surround our clients with more services and more technology-based tools and a team of advisors that simply cares more than anyone else. If you want a career giving people the reassurance that they can have access to the health care they need for themselves and their loved ones, join OneDigital . Our Newest Opportunity: The Employee Benefits Operations Lead serves as a strategic partner to the National Practice Leader, playing a pivotal role in driving a high-performance, growth-oriented Employee Benefits practice. The role is responsible for supporting and optimizing day-to-day operations, collaborating with Marketing, engaging with carriers and partners, and coordinating events and programs that advance key strategic initiatives. By maximizing field support, identifying efficiencies across markets, and implementing innovative solutions, this role ensures seamless execution of business processes and continuous improvement in service delivery. The Lead works cross-functionally to coordinate efforts among teams, enhance client retention, and enable cross-sale opportunities, ultimately benefiting both organizations and their employees and fostering a collaborative, results-driven environment. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Growth, Retention & Cross‑Sale Enablement Develop and manage programs that support sales and client management teams with resources, reporting, and coordination to drive new business, renewals, and client retention. Track and coordinate cross‑sale initiatives with other practices (e.g., Retirement, HR Consulting, Property & Casualty), including collateral organization, meeting preparation, and follow‑up on outcomes. Analyze client and portfolio data to identify vulnerable clients, recommend targeted retention actions, and monitor effectiveness, surfacing insights and recommendations for leadership. Marketing, Campaigns & Communications Partner with Marketing to design and execute national campaigns, manage content calendars, and develop EB‑specific messaging and materials aligned with practice strategy. Review and interpret engagement metrics and qualitative feedback to inform future initiatives and optimize communication strategies. Regional & Local Market Support Coordinate regional initiatives, visits, and events, ensuring alignment with national standards and strategic priorities and ensuring timely follow‑up on action items. Serve as a connector between national leadership and local teams, facilitating best‑practice sharing and feedback loops to inform national planning. Carrier & Partner Engagement Collect, analyze, and organize carrier performance data; prepare materials and recommendations for advisory meetings and track action items to completion. Coordinate and help shape initiatives with carrier and vendor partners to align with practice strategy and performance goals. Training & Learning Oversee scheduling, logistics, and resource planning for EB training programs and field development curricula. Maintain and organize training resources for ongoing team reference and recommend enhancements based on participation, feedback, and evolving business needs. Analytics & Performance Management Use Power BI and other tools to extract, organize, and report on key metrics (e.g., revenue, pipeline, retention, cross‑sales). Develop standard reporting templates and dashboards and surface insights and recommendations to leadership to inform decision‑making and performance improvement. Product & Technology Support Support rollout, adoption, and optimization of EB‑specific products and technology solutions, serving as an operational point of contact for the practice. Coordinate user communications, training, and feedback collection, and recommend enhancements to improve utilization and user experience. Practice Communications & Knowledge Management Assist with planning, content development, and execution for town halls, newsletters, and internal communications that support practice priorities. Maintain the Employee Benefits Practice page and related repositories to ensure resources are current, well‑organized, and easily accessible for field and leadership teams. Event Support Plan and execute EB‑related events, including agenda development, content collection, speaker coordination, and logistics. Manage post‑event follow‑up, evaluation, and feedback; translate learnings into recommendations for future events and initiatives. Qualifications, Skills, and Requirements Strong organizational and project management skills; able to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast‑paced, matrixed environment. Demonstrated adaptability and learning agility to respond quickly to shifting needs, evolving products, and changing business goals. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint); Power BI experience preferred. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including preparation of executive‑ready materials and effective cross‑functional collaboration. Proven ability to build relationships and collaborate with Sales, Client Management, Marketing, Product/Technology, L&D, and Carrier/Vendor partners. High attention to detail, strong time management, and consistent follow‑through. Comfort working with performance metrics, reports, and analytics to inform recommendations and decisions. Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism. Education and Experience Bachelor’s degree preferred; professional certifications a plus. 5+ years’ experience in employee benefits, insurance brokerage/consulting, or a related field involving operational support, analytics, or program coordination. Your base pay is dependent upon your skills, education, qualifications, professional experience, and location. In addition to base pay, some roles are eligible for variable compensation, commission, and/or annual bonus based on your individual performance and/or the company’s performance. We also offer eligible employees health, wellbeing, retirement, and other financial benefits, paid time off, overtime pay for non-exempt employees, and robust learning and development programs. You will receive reimbursement of job-related expenses per the company policy and may receive employee perks and discounts. To learn more, visit: OneDigital is an equal opportunity employer. Not only as a matter of standard, but to honor and celebrate our differences. We believe that the power of ONE starts with you. We are committed to cultivating and preserving a culture that celebrates diversity, insists on equity and inclusion, and connects us. Ensuring our people feel seen, valued, respected, and supported is fundamental to our core values and business goals. OneDigital provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment regardless of their: veteran status, uniformed servicemember status, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age (40 and over), pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), national origin or ancestry, citizenship or immigration status, physical or mental disability, genetic information (including testing and characteristics) or any other category protected by federal, state or local law (collectively, “protected characteristics”). A copy of the Federal EEO poster is linked here. Pursuant to local Fair Chance Ordinances, we will consider qualified applications with arrest or conviction records for employment. For applicable candidates, the following ordinances are linked here to inform you of your rights as an applicant: City and County of San Francsico City of Los Angeles County of Los Angeles Employment decisions shall comply with all other applicable federal, state and city/county laws prohibiting discrimination in employment. OneDigital complies with all criminal history inquiry [or ‘ban the box’] laws in California, Connecticut, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New Mexico, Oregon, Rhode Island, Vermont and Washington. In short, we believe in hiring the most qualified applicant for the position, regardless of background. If you have questions about our hiring policies and practices, we would be happy to discuss upon receiving your application. We hope to welcome you to OneDigital and look forward to hearing from you. Our AI systems help us efficiently identify the best fit for our open positions, ensuring a streamlined and effective hiring experience. However, AI does not replace the humans in our process. items.summary: Data Analyst Role OverviewThe Data Analyst is responsible for overseeing and managing data licensing processes, ensuring clients receive accurate and timely data exports.
items.description: Data Analyst Role Overview The Data Analyst is responsible for overseeing and managing data licensing processes, ensuring clients receive accurate and timely data exports. This role also involves developing and maintaining industry reports, conducting data-driven analysis, and supporting research and consultation projects. Reports To: Director, Data Responsibilities Data Licensing & Reporting Manage the data licensing process, ensuring data accuracy and timely client deliveries. Oversee the creation, updating, and distribution of key industry reports. Identify and propose new reports and insights that can be packaged and shared regularly. Collaborate with clients purchasing data-related consultation services and custom reporting. Support ad-hoc data projects by providing research and analytical insights. Day-to-Day Tasks Process data exports for licensed clients and internal reporting. Compile, analyze, and format industry metrics and metadata. Conduct research to gather and validate additional data for reporting purposes. Provide data support for commercial initiatives, including sales proposals and client requests. Develop tools and templates to streamline data processing and report generation. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work with Commercial teams to support client licensing, sales efforts, and data requests. Collaborate with Product teams to identify data gaps and improve collection and automation processes. Tools & Platforms Used Data Management & Analysis: Airtable, Google Sheets, Mixpanel Communication & Workflow: Slack, Framer, Figma Required Skills & Qualifications Technical Skills Proficiency in managing and analyzing structured datasets. Experience with database management and querying tools (e.g., SQL). Advanced skills in Google Sheets or Excel (formulas, pivot tables, data visualization). Familiarity with data scraping tools or APIs is a plus. Ability to create clear and visually appealing reports. Soft Skills Strong organizational and time management skills. Excellent written and verbal communication. High attention to detail and accuracy. Ability to work independently while managing multiple projects. Strong problem-solving mindset with curiosity about data trends. Experience & Qualifications 3+ years of experience in data analysis or reporting, preferably in media, technology, or entertainment. Certifications in data analysis or visualization (preferred but not required). English proficiency (Native or equivalent level). Ideal Candidate Profile Key Attributes A proactive, self-starter with a strategic approach to data opportunities. Strong visual and analytical storytelling skills. Highly curious about industry trends and data insights. Preferred Backgrounds Experience in media, entertainment, or technology-related industries. Familiarity with research and data analysis within creative fields. Bonus Experience (Not Required) Prior experience working with licensed data products. Client-facing experience in data management or consultation roles. Why Join Us? 🚀 Impact: You’ll work on high-impact projects that shape the future of music industry tech. 🌎 Remote Flexibility: Fully remote role within the LATAM time zones. 💡 Growth: Opportunity to expand your skills across product, design, and engineering. 🎧 Industry: Work at the intersection of music, media, and technology. About our client: Our client is a media and technology company helping make the music industry more transparent and connected. We build innovative products that provide music industry professionals with the tools and insights they need to thrive. Products include: OUR CLIENT Jobs Stack New Industry Friday Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Global / Taipei / Kuala Lumpur / Penang Responsibilities: 1. Cloud Infrastructure Design & Operations: Design, build, and optimize highly available and secure cloud architectures on AWS. 2. CI/CD Pipeline Development: Design and maintain end-to-end pipelines from code commit to deployment — including build, test, artifact management, release, and rollback — to improve release frequency and quality. 3. Operations Automation: Reduce manual toil through programming and automation tools (e.g., Ansible, Terraform, custom scripts/platforms) to automate configuration management, change execution, and incident response. 4. Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Manage AWS cloud resources and network configurations using Terraform to ensure environment consistency, auditability, and reproducibility. 5. CDN Operations: Configure, monitor, tune, and troubleshoot AWS CDN services to ensure acceleration and availability of static assets and streaming media. 6. Monitoring, Alerting & Observability: Build and maintain monitoring, logging, and distributed tracing systems to enable rapid issue identification and drive capacity and performance optimization. Requirements: 1. Education & Experience: - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field. - 3+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, Cloud Operations, or Infrastructure Engineering. 2. Cloud Platform: - Proficient with AWS: hands-on experience with core services including EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, Lambda, EKS/ECS. - Solid understanding of cloud-native principles; familiar with containers (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes or AWS EKS managed service), service mesh, and serverless technologies. 3. CI/CD: - Proficient in designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD). - Familiar with pipeline design principles: multi-environment management, branching strategies, artifact management, blue-green/canary deployments, and rollback mechanisms. 4. Observability: - Experience building and optimizing monitoring stacks such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki. 5. Operations Automation & Programming: - Strong automation programming skills: proficient in at least one scripting/programming language (e.g., Shell, Python, Go) for writing automation scripts and tools. - Able to design automation solutions for operational scenarios and integrate with existing monitoring, ticketing, and configuration management systems. 6. Infrastructure as Code (IaC): - Proficient with Terraform: able to manage AWS resources with modular design and proven hands-on experience. - Familiarity with Ansible for configuration management and batch operations (e.g., system initialization, application deployment, configuration distribution). 7. CDN Operations: - Hands-on CDN operations experience: familiar with AWS CloudFront configuration, caching strategies, domain and certificate management. - Able to perform bandwidth/traffic and cost analysis, origin optimization, troubleshooting, and SLA assurance. 8. Soft Skills: - Strong documentation habits, communication, collaboration, and ability to drive initiatives across teams. - Solid problem analysis and post-mortem skills; able to participate in or lead root cause analysis and drive improvement actions. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/coin-market-cap-devops-engineer-contractor

items.description: Company Description It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We’re building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we’re just getting started. Join us to put AI to work for people. Job Description The Opportunity ServiceNow is looking for a Senior Manager, Partner Strategy & Operations to own the operational rhythm and execution quality of AMS Global Partner & Channels. Your job is ensuring that forecasting, deal reviews, pipeline health, and performance management practices are executed consistently, work together seamlessly, and give leadership real-time visibility into the business. You’ll be on point as the operational lead for our largest hub, ensuring consolidated forecasting and hub-level coordination run with precision. What You’ll Own Operations Strategy & Support (60%) Your Role: You oversee the consistent execution of AMS GPC’s forecasting, deal management, and performance management practices. The Center of Excellence (COE) Practice Lead designs and rolls out these practices across the organization. Your job is ensuring all teams execute them consistently, all pieces work together within a unified rhythm, and leadership has real-time visibility into the business. Forecast execution & quality: Coordinate weekly forecast submission, validation, and rollup. Ensure forecasts are clean, submitted on time, and accurate. Audit data integrity and flag risks or discrepancies, including pre-buy burndown forecasting. Deal review execution: Ensure deal review sessions happen consistently across all teams, follow the agreed-upon standards, and surface the right insights. Audit execution consistency and recommend adjustments. Pipeline health monitoring: Roll up of pipeline composition, stage velocity, and sourced vs. sell-through metrics across all teams. Identify risks, stalled opportunities, and pull-in candidates. Surface early-warning signals to leadership. Performance management cadence: Coordinate rhythm of quarterly and annual performance management—MBO setting, attainment tracking, and rollup reporting across all teams. Systems & data coordination: Work with the Data & Systems team to ensure operational requirements are met—dashboards are accurate, planning tools reflect reality, and data flows correctly. Audit technical delivery and flag issues. Practice execution oversight: Monitor how forecasting and deal review practices are being executed across all teams. Work with the COE Practice Lead to identify execution gaps, coach teams, and ensure consistency. You’re the quality auditor, not the practice designer. Operational audits & escalation: Weekly validation of operational health (forecasts submitted? Data clean? Processes followed?). Catch errors before they hit leadership. Escalate issues and drive corrective action. Global & Regional Hub Operations Support (40%) Consolidated forecasting: Collect, validate, and consolidate forecasts from sub-leaders within the hub into a unified hub forecast. Identify risks and discrepancies before they escalate. Hub-level dashboards: Own the consolidated operational view—pipeline health, deal velocity, performance tracking, partner attainment. Provide hub leadership with real-time visibility. Weekly operational rhythm: Run weekly operational check-in with hub leadership to review consolidated forecast, flag issues, and maintain discipline. Pre-buy burndown forecasting: Track pre-buy inventory and forecast burndown velocity across the hub. Identify early if the hub is on pace to meet targets or at risk. Partner attribution & audit: Ensure consistent deal coding across all teams within the hub. Audit sourced vs. sell-through classification and catch errors before they affect forecasting. Hub attainment tracking: Consolidate monthly and quarterly attainment. Flag risks and celebrate wins. Key Relationships Head of AMS GPC Business Operations: Weekly sync on operational health, risks, and improvements. Data & Systems Manager: Define operational requirements; they execute systems/data delivery. Center of Excellence (COE) Practice Lead: Collaborate on practice rollout and execution consistency. They design and roll out practices; you audit execution and ensure consistency. Hub Leadership: Weekly operational partner managing consolidated forecasts, hub dashboards, and risk escalation. Field Business Partners: Support them with operational infrastructure, answer questions, escalate systems issues. AMS GPC Leadership: Provide operational visibility—forecasts, pipeline health, performance metrics. Qualifications What You Bring Required Experience 8+ years in sales operations, revenue operations, or similar operational roles at scale. 3+ years overseeing execution of forecasting processes, deal management cadences, or performance management infrastructure across multiple teams and geographies. Deep expertise in sales forecasting, deal review processes, and pipeline health. You know what ‘clean’ means and how to enforce it. Experience with complex, multi-route-to-market go-to-market models. Partner channels or hub-and-spoke organizations are a plus. Strong analytical mindset. You can pull data, spot patterns, identify root causes, and recommend process improvements. Advanced proficiency in Excel, data analysis, and BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar). Experience with planning/forecasting tools or ability to learn quickly. Proven ability to influence without direct authority and drive adoption of processes across teams. Cross-functional collaboration skills. You’ve worked with Finance, IT, Sales Leadership, and other teams. Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry. Preferred Qualifications SaaS enterprise sales operations experience. Familiarity with enterprise software platforms and CRM systems. Track record scaling processes from manual to systematic and automated. Experience with partner/channel sales teams and multi-geography dynamics. Demonstrated ability to design and audit operational quality. Experience presenting operational insights to senior leadership. Character Traits Obsessed with clarity. You communicate complexity simply and make standards easy to follow. Relentlessly detail-oriented. You care about accuracy—data must be trustworthy, processes must be followed, and errors caught early. Systems thinker. You understand how forecasting, pipeline health, deal reviews, and performance management all connect. Execution-oriented. You implement, audit, and iterate. You own outcomes. Collaborative and curious. You ask great questions, listen to feedback, and build strong relationships. Resilient and adaptable. You handle changing priorities without losing momentum. Additional Information Work Personas We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service. Equal Opportunity Employer ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements. Accommodations We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact [email protected] for assistance. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities. From Fortune. ©2026 Fortune Media IP Limited. items.description: Software Engineering Job Requisition ID # 25WD93193 English posting follows 25WD93193 Architecte logiciel, Plateforme de données AEC Aperçu du poste Chez Autodesk, nous sommes des pionniers dans le domaine des logiciels de conception 3D, d'ingénierie et de divertissement. Nous développons des outils qui permettent à certains des esprits les plus créatifs de la planète de résoudre des problèmes concrets. Reconnus par Fortune, Forbes, Glassdoor et d'autres comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs, nous nous engageons à créer un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif où l'innovation et la créativité s'épanouissent. L'organisation Autodesk chargée des données en architecture, ingénierie et construction (AEC) est à la recherche d'un architecte logiciel expérimenté pour se joindre à l'équipe AEC Data et définir les services natifs du nuage ainsi que l'architecture des systèmes distribués qui sous-tendent le modèle de données AEC (AECDM) et les nombreux services qui l'entourent. Bien que le domaine soit celui des données, ce poste relève fondamentalement de l'architecture du nuage et des services - API, contrats de service, intégrations, conception de systèmes distribués et modèle de données connecté qui les relie entre eux - et s'étend à plusieurs équipes. Il ne s'agit pas d'un poste de spécialiste en entrepôt de données ou en analyse de données. L'organisation AEC Data met en place l'infrastructure de données fondamentale qui sous-tend la vision d'Autodesk en matière de construction connectée : les plateformes, les services et les modèles de données unifiés qui couvrent l'ensemble du cycle de vie des actifs bâtis, de la conception et de la construction jusqu'à l'exploitation et à l'entretien. Ce travail permet la circulation continue des données AEC (modèles 3D, dessins 2D, suivi des problèmes, coûts, flux de capteurs, etc.) entre les produits Autodesk et les intégrations tierces. L'architecte contribuera à façonner la prochaine génération de fonctionnalités pour le nuage industriel Autodesk Forma, en collaborant avec des architectes logiciels, des experts du domaine et les équipes de produit de Revit, Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Autodesk Construction Cloud et Autodesk Forma. Il s'agit d'un poste de contributeur senior dans un parcours d'architecture bien établi, relevant de l'architecte émérite de l'équipe AEC Data, qui occupe également le poste d'architecte logiciel principal. La responsabilité principale consiste à définir la manière dont plusieurs équipes conçoivent et développent - par le biais de normes, d'architectures de référence, d'ADR et de la gouvernance de la révision de conception - plutôt que de gérer un service unique. L'orientation précise du poste s'adapte aux points forts du candidat et aux besoins de l'organisation. Responsabilités Conception et évolution des API : Concevoir et faire évoluer les interfaces API des services AEC Data - modélisation des ressources, adressage, gestion des versions et évolution rétrocompatible, API de requête, et unification des interfaces qui se chevauchent en un seul contrat cohérent Architecture système : Définir et faire évoluer une architecture inter-équipes et native du nuage pour l'ensemble des services AEC Data; concevoir des systèmes distribués, y compris les contrats de service et les flux pilotés par les événements Conception et évolution des schémas : Concevoir, documenter et faire évoluer les schémas de données pour les entités du domaine AEC (bâtiments, infrastructures, espaces, systèmes, composantes, relations) - y compris les modèles sémantiques, les ensembles de propriétés, les systèmes de classification et les hiérarchies de relations. Assurer la gestion des versions, de la compatibilité ascendante et descendante, de la dépréciation et de la migration; maintenir le registre des schémas, les règles de validation et les contrôles de qualité Normes et gouvernance : Établir des normes, des architectures de référence et des composantes réutilisables; rédiger des propositions d'architecture et des comptes rendus de décision (ADR) pour examen par un conseil d'architecture interorganisationnel, et mener des revues de conception interéquipes Prototypage et faisabilité : Évaluer différentes orientations architecturales par la modélisation et le prototypage, afin de réduire les risques liés aux décisions clés avant leur adoption à grande échelle Mentorat et leadership technique : Encadrer les développeurs et les autres architectes sur les technologies émergentes et établies ainsi que sur les pratiques architecturales; approfondir les compétences techniques au sein des équipes Fiabilité et performance : Assurer la fiabilité, la sécurité et la performance des systèmes; définir les SLO et favoriser l'observabilité (métriques, traçage, journalisation) Communication : Communiquer sur l'architecture à l'aide de vues et de diagrammes clairs (p. ex., C4) ainsi que de présentations adaptées à la haute direction; produire une documentation exhaustive et du matériel d'intégration Qualifications Minimales Baccalauréat en informatique, ou expérience équivalente Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans la conception de systèmes distribués natifs du nuage, dont au moins 5 ans à un niveau d'architecte inter-équipes (architecte logiciel, développeur principal, Staff+ ou équivalent). Le titre est flexible; l'étendue de l'impact est le critère principal Expertise approfondie des services en nuage (de préférence AWS), de la conception d'API et de services, ainsi que des modèles de systèmes distribués (microservices, architecture orientée événements, résilience) Solides bases en modélisation de données et en conception de schémas - y compris les langages de définition de schémas (p. ex., JSON Schema), la gestion des versions, ainsi que la compatibilité ascendante et descendante et les stratégies d'évolution - telles qu'appliquées tant aux schémas de données autonomes qu'aux contrats d'API. Une spécialisation en architecture d'entrepôt de données ou d'analyse n'est pas requise Excellente connaissance de la conception logicielle et des modèles d'architecture Capacité démontrée à exercer une influence sans autorité hiérarchique et à favoriser la coordination entre les équipes ne relevant pas de la gestion directe du candidat Solides compétences en leadership et en mentorat, avec une expérience avérée dans l'encadrement et le développement d'équipes diversifiées et interfonctionnelles Maîtrise de la communication d'idées complexes de manière concise et convaincante, avec d'excellentes compétences verbales, écrites et de présentation auprès d'un large éventail de parties prenantes Capacité à collaborer avec une équipe internationale Qualifications Souhaitées Les qualifications souhaitées constituent un éventail de compétences plutôt qu'une liste de critères à cocher : une expertise approfondie dans quelques domaines clés importe davantage qu'une connaissance superficielle de l'ensemble d'entre eux. Les compétences émergentes en IA/apprentissage automatique (IA/ML) énumérées ci-dessous constituent un atout et peuvent être développées en cours d'emploi; elles ne sont pas des conditions préalables. Domaines clés Services en nuage : AWS et ses services clés (EC2, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS) Systèmes distribués : décomposition des services orientée domaine, modèles de cohérence des données (CQRS, event sourcing, sagas) et conception multi-locataires/multi-régions Conception d'API et de services : conception et évolution des API REST; GraphQL (y compris la fédération) Architecture de bases de données : relationnelles et NoSQL (p. ex., DynamoDB, PostgreSQL) Observabilité/SRE : OpenTelemetry, traçage distribué, métriques/SLO pour les services de données Bonus Technologies sémantiques : graphes de connaissances, RDF/OWL ou graphes de propriétés - particulièrement pertinents pour l'AECDM connecté/sémantique Expertise BIM : concepts de modélisation de l'information du bâtiment (BIM), familles Revit ou systèmes de modélisation paramétrique similaires Systèmes d'IA : RAG, agents/MCP, orchestration agentique (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), observabilité des grands modèles de langage (LLM), et gouvernance des données / sécurité de l'IA (renseignements personnels identifiables [PII], injection de prompts, filtrage de contenu) IA spécifique au domaine de l'AEC : extraction BIM/IFC, traitement CAO ou de nuages de points B Architectures orientées événements B : Kafka ou Kinesis; registres de schémas (Confluent, AWS Glue); traitement exactly-once Connaissance du secteur de l'AEC : Expérience dans le secteur de l'architecture, de l'ingénierie et de la construction; connaissance des normes de l'industrie (IFC, COBie, gbXML, CityGML, LandXML, UniFormat, OmniClass). Une formation d'intégration au secteur est offerte ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 25WD93193 Software Architect, AEC Platform Data Position Overview At Autodesk, we are pioneers in 3D design, engineering, and entertainment software, building tools that empower some of the most creative minds on the planet to solve real-world problems. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Glassdoor, and others as a top place to work, we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where innovation and creativity thrive. Autodesk's Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) Data organization is seeking an experienced Software Architect to join the AEC Data team and define the cloud-native services and distributed-systems architecture that power the AEC Data Model (AECDM) and the many services around it. Data is the domain, but the role is fundamentally one of cloud and services architecture - APIs, service contracts, integrations, distributed-systems design, and the connected data model that ties them together - spanning multiple teams. It is not a data-warehouse or analytics-specialist role. The AEC Data organization is building the foundational data infrastructure behind Autodesk's vision for connected construction: the platforms, services, and unified data models that span the entire built-asset lifecycle, from design and construction through operation and maintenance. This work enables the continuous flow of AEC data (3D models, 2D drawings, issue tracking, cost, sensor streams, and more) across Autodesk products and third-party integrations. The architect will help shape the next generation of capabilities for the Autodesk Forma Industry Cloud, collaborating with software architects, domain experts, and product teams across Revit, Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Autodesk Construction Cloud, and Autodesk Forma. This is a senior individual-contributor role on an established architecture track, reporting to the Distinguished Architect of the AEC Data team, who also serves as the Lead Software Architect. The primary responsibility is to shape how multiple teams design and build - through standards, reference architectures, ADRs, and design-review governance - rather than to own a single service. The exact focus flexes to the candidate's strengths and organizational need. Responsibilities API Design & Evolution : Design and evolve API surfaces across the AEC Data services - resource modeling, addressing, versioning and backward-compatible evolution, query APIs, and unifying overlapping surfaces into a single coherent contract System Architecture : Define and evolve cross-team, cloud-native architecture across the AEC Data services; design distributed systems including service contracts and event-driven flows Schema Design & Evolution : Design, document, and evolve data schemas for AEC domain entities (buildings, infrastructure, spaces, systems, components, relationships) - including semantic models, property sets, classification systems, and relationship hierarchies. Own versioning, backward/forward compatibility, deprecation, and migration; maintain the schema registry, validation rules, and quality checks Standards & Governance : Establish standards, reference architectures, and reusable components; author architecture proposals and decision records (ADRs) for review by a cross-org architecture council, and run cross-team design reviews Prototyping & Feasibility : Evaluate alternative architectural directions through modeling and prototyping, de-risking key decisions before broad adoption Mentorship & Technical Leadership : Mentor developers and fellow architects on emerging and established technologies and on architectural practice; grow technical depth across teams Reliability & Performance : Ensure reliability, security, and performance of systems; define SLOs and drive observability (metrics, tracing, logging) Communication : Communicate architecture with clear views and diagrams (e.g., C4) and executive-ready narratives; produce comprehensive documentation and onboarding materials Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent experience 10+ years designing cloud-native, distributed systems, including 5+ years at cross-team architect altitude (Software Architect, Principal Developer, Staff+, or equivalent). Title is flexible; scope of impact is the primary consideration Deep expertise in cloud services (ideally AWS), API/service design, and distributed-systems patterns (microservices, event-driven, resilience) Solid grounding in data modeling and schema design - including schema definition languages (e.g., JSON Schema), versioning, and backward/forward-compatibility and evolution strategies - as applied both to standalone data schemas and to API contracts. Specialist data-warehouse or analytics architecture is not required Excellent knowledge of software design and architecture patterns Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across teams outside the candidate's direct management Strong leadership and mentoring skills, with a track record of guiding and growing diverse, cross-functional teams Mastery of conveying complex ideas concisely and persuasively, with excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills across a range of stakeholders Ability to collaborate with a global team Preferred Qualifications Preferred qualifications are a menu rather than a checklist: depth in a few core areas matters more than breadth across all of them. The emerging AI/ML capabilities below are advantageous and can be developed on the job; they are not prerequisites. Core Cloud Services : AWS and its core services (EC2, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS) Distributed Systems : Domain-driven service decomposition, data consistency patterns (CQRS, event sourcing, sagas), and multi-tenant/multi-region design API & Service Design : REST API design and evolution; GraphQL (including federation) Database Architecture : Relational and NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB, PostgreSQL) Observability/SRE : OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, metrics/SLOs for data services Bonus Semantic Technologies : Knowledge graphs, RDF/OWL, or property graphs - particularly relevant to the connected/semantic AECDM BIM Expertise : Building Information Modeling concepts, Revit families, or similar parametric modeling systems AI Systems : RAG, agents/MCP, agentic orchestration (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), LLM observability, and data governance / AI safety (PII, prompt-injection, content filtering) Domain-Specific AI for AEC : BIM/IFC extraction, CAD or point-cloud processing Event-Driven Architectures : Kafka or Kinesis; schema registries (Confluent, AWS Glue); exactly-once processing AEC Domain Knowledge : Experience in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction industry; familiarity with industry standards (IFC, COBie, gbXML, CityGML, LandXML, UniFormat, OmniClass). items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote but only within Poland Who are we? We're Bee Talents, an IT recruitment agency that has been helping clients from all around the world in building their technical teams since 2015. Currently we have a great pleasure of working as an exclusive RPO provider for Gcore and we would like to invite you to participate in the recruitment process for Platform Product Analyst (PLG & Mixpanel Expert). Company Description This position is available only under an employment (labor) agreement. The world’s digital experiences run on something invisible: the infrastructure and software that keep them fast, reliable, and secure. At Gcore, you’ll help design and deliver that foundation for an AI-driven world. We’re a global provider of infrastructure and software solutions for AI, cloud, network, and security, powering everything from real-time communication and streaming to enterprise AI and secure web applications. With 210+ edge locations, 50+ cloud regions, and thousands of GPUs, your work here can reach users and businesses across the globe. You’ll collaborate with leading technology partners such as Intel, NVIDIA, Dell, and Equinix, and work on platforms that power digital products used around the world. Our vision is simple: to connect the world to AI, anywhere, anytime. Want to work on technology that goes beyond a single product or industry? Join a global team of 550+ professionals building infrastructure and software that supports the entire digital ecosystem. We are currently looking for a Platform Product Analyst (PLG & Mixpanel Expert) , a Data-Driven Growth Partner for our Platform team. Your focus is our Self-Service funnel. We have a powerful cloud platform where users can register, pay, and launch infrastructure on their own. Your job is to analyze their journey in Mixpanel, find friction points, and help us increase Activation and Revenue. Job description You will work in a cross-functional setup: Daily collaboration: You will work side-by-side with our Digital Director, as well as Backend and Frontend Developers, Product Managers and the UX/Design team, helping them prioritize features based on data. Reporting: You will be structurally part of our BI (Business Intelligence) team, ensuring you have professional support and access to our data infrastructure. However, you will be embedded in the Platform team, working directly with the Digital Director on a daily basis. What You'll Do: Self-Service Optimization: Deep dive into the registration → activation → payment flow. Identify where users drop off and propose A/B tests to fix it. Product Qualified Leads (PQL): Analyze usage patterns to identify high-potential customers (e.g., "This startup just spun up 50 GPUs") and signal our Sales team to engage them. Event Tracking Design: You are the owner of our tracking plan. You tell developers exactly which events and properties to track. "If we don't track the 'Error 500' on the billing page, we are flying blind." Dashboarding: Create clear, actionable dashboards in Mixpanel for Product Managers and Execs. Hypothesis Testing: Help PMs formulate and measure experiments. Did the new onboarding flow increase activation? You give the final verdict. Who You Are: You are a Mixpanel Ninja. You don't just look at standard dashboards. You build complex cohorts, retention curves, and funnel steps to understand exactly what users are doing. You are AI-Native. You use AI tools (Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude) to accelerate your analysis. Need a complex JQL query for Mixpanel? You prompt it. Need to summarize user feedback? You use an LLM. You have a Growth Mindset. You care about business metrics (Revenue, Conversion, Retention), not just vanity metrics (Pageviews). You are constantly looking for "Aha! moments" that turn visitors into paying customers. What We Are Looking For: Experience: 3+ years in Product Analytics, preferably in a SaaS / PLG (Product-Led Growth) company. Tooling: Mastery of Mixpanel (or Amplitude/Heap). Implementation from the ground up. You know how to clean data and debug events. AI Workflow: Active user of AI tools for data analysis and automation. Basic Technical Literacy: You can read a JSON event payload and understand SQL logic (even if you don't write complex ETLs). English: Professional proficiency (C1/C2). Nice to Have: Experience with B2B Cloud/Infrastructure products. Understanding of Product-Led Sales (PLS) mechanics. Experience with A/B testing tools. Why Gcore? You will have a direct impact on our Self-Service revenue. You will work with a modern stack (Mixpanel + AI tools) without legacy baggage. We value data over opinion. If your analysis shows we are wrong, we change course. Equal Opportunity Employer We provide equal opportunity to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected characteristics. Additional Information Benefits At Gcore, we want you to do your best work and enjoy the journey. Our benefits are designed to support your growth, well-being, and life beyond work: - Competitive compensation - Flexible working hours and hybrid or remote options, depending on your role - Work from anywhere in the world for up to 45 days per year - Private medical insurance for you and your family* - Extra paid vacation and sick leave days* - Support for life’s important moments and celebrations - Language courses to help you connect and grow - Modern, welcoming offices with snacks, drinks, and entertainment* - Team sports and social activities* *Benefits may vary depending on your location. Equal Opportunity Employer We provide equal opportunity to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected characteristics. The purposes of processing your personal data are: conducting the initial stage of recruitment, based on your consents, participation in future recruitment processes conducted for our clients, based on the consent, defense against potential claims of our Clients for whom we conduct recruitment, in particular regarding the non-compliance of the Candidate’s profile with the requirements specified by the Client – which is a legitimate interest of the Data Administrator pursuant to art. 6 section 1 pt. f) GDPR. Due to data processing you have the right to access your personal data, request a copy of it, retrificate it, delete or limit it and withdraw of consents at any time, make an objection to the processing of personal data and lodge a complaint to the President of the Personal Data Protection Office if it violate the GDPR rights. items.description: Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest. About the Risk & Analytics Team The Risk & Analytics (R&A) team makes crucial decisions that direct Affirm’s business strategy. We partner with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering, Capital Markets, and Commercial teams to grow Affirm responsibly by optimizing approval, conversion, losses, and profitability. Operating across the entire customer and merchant lifecycle, we tackle a diverse array of challenges, from optimizing checkout conversion and mitigating fraud risk to building scalable data foundations and enabling international growth. We analyze performance not just to report on it, but to determine where to invest resources for maximum impact through building tools, scalable data infrastructure, and analytical frameworks. We improve the analytics experience across Affirm by streamlining workflows and fostering a culture of learning and documentation. By taking ownership of the entire analytical lifecycle, from initial question to final business decision, we turn complex data and systems into clear, actionable signals that ensure Affirm grows efficiently and intelligently. One Role, Multiple Teams We are hiring multiple Analyst I roles across Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization through this single job posting. Rather than interviewing for one specific team, candidates will go through a shared interview process designed to assess the core skills we look for across R&A. If selected, we will work with you to determine the best team match based on your interests, experience, strengths, and current business needs. You will have the opportunity to learn more about our teams and share your preferences as you move through the process. Potential team placements include: Point of Sale (POS): Optimize merchant and checkout performance to improve conversion, approvals, and unit economics across the purchase funnel. Direct to Consumer (DTC) / Card: Drive engagement, repeat usage, and lifecycle health across Affirm's app, web, and card experiences. Fraud: Prevent and reduce fraud losses across the customer journey while maintaining a frictionless user experience. Core Analytics: Build the quantitative research, machine learning models, performance monitoring, and scalable data foundations that enable fast, economically sound decisions. Servicing: Enhance the post-origination customer experience by analyzing repayment behavior, collections strategies, and operational efficiency. International Expansion: Build the measurement and decision foundations needed to sustainably launch and scale Affirm in new global markets. About the Role As an Analyst I in Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization, you will join one of several analytical teams working across the customer and merchant lifecycle. While the specific problems you tackle will depend on your eventual team placement, all Analyst I roles share a common foundation: using data to understand business performance, identify opportunities, and help Affirm make better decisions. You will learn the fundamentals of consumer lending while executing scoped analytical work under the guidance of senior analysts and managers. You will leverage SQL, Python, and modern analytical tools to help optimize business strategies, monitor performance, and turn complex data into actionable insights. You are a thoughtful, driven individual eager to build a strong technical foundation, learn how to navigate exogenous market changes, and integrate modern AI tooling to solve hard problems efficiently. What You Will Do Derive Insights & Support Strategy: Leverage data analytics to uncover insights that help optimize product, risk, or growth strategies across geographies. Monitor Portfolio Health: Assist in tracking performance metrics, user behavior, and macroeconomic trends that impact business outcomes, flagging risks and anomalies to senior team members. Technical Execution: Write clean, working SQL and Python to build scalable reporting and partner with Engineering to support the deployment of machine learning and risk models. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Legal, and Compliance to understand evolving consumer lending regulations and market requirements, assisting in translating them into foundational data models and operational policies. Drive Launch Alignment: Support cross-functional discussions to ensure new product launches and market entries align with our operational capabilities and risk appetite. AI Fluency & Efficiency: Integrate AI tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and copilots into your daily workflows to accelerate data mining and routine tasks, while carefully verifying outputs. What We Look For 1–3 years of experience in an analytically driven role. Relevant internships or prior experience in consumer lending, fintech, or the broader financial services industry are highly valued. Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field. Solid working knowledge of SQL, Python, or other scripting languages. Familiarity with data mining, data visualization, and foundational statistical modeling. Basic understanding of, or deep curiosity about, consumer lending regulations, fair lending principles, and how machine learning techniques apply to real-world business problems. Exceptional communication skills, humility, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional peers. Pay Grade - I Equity Grade - 5 Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range . Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company). USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $115,000 - $165,000 USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $101,000 - $151,000 #LI-Remote Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company! The majority of our roles are remote and you can work almost anywhere within the country of employment. Affirmers in proximal roles have the flexibility to work remotely, but will occasionally be required to work out of their assigned Affirm office. A limited number of roles remain office-based due to the nature of their job responsibilities. We’re extremely proud to offer competitive benefits that are anchored to our core value of people come first. Some key highlights of our benefits package include: Health care coverage - Affirm covers all premiums for all levels of coverage for you and your dependents Flexible Spending Wallets - generous stipends for spending on Technology, Food, various Lifestyle needs, and family forming expenses Time off - competitive vacation and holiday schedules allowing you to take time off to rest and recharge ESPP - An employee stock purchase plan enabling you to buy shares of Affirm at a discount We believe It’s On Us to provide an inclusive interview experience for all, including people with disabilities. We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations to candidates in need of individualized support during the hiring process. [For U.S. positions that could be performed in Los Angeles or San Francisco] Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, Affirm will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and hereby freely and unambiguously give informed consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of your personal information as described therein.

items.description: About Lyra Health Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. About The Role Lyra Health’s Clinical Strategy team is seeking a seasoned Senior Operations Lead for a high-impact, 6-month contract engagement focused on driving our Joint Commission (TJC) Behavioral Health Care and Human Services (BHC) accreditation readiness. This role sits at the intersection of clinical strategy, regulatory execution, and cross-functional project management. Acting as the primary project lead, you will bridge the gap between Clinical Strategy, Clinical Operations, and key cross-functional teams to drive our accreditation roadmap. This role is ideal for a senior healthcare project manager who excels at translating complex regulatory mandates or compliance standards into actionable project plans. While familiarity with Joint Commission standards is preferred, we are primarily seeking an exceptional operational lead who can quickly get up to speed on TJC requirements, partner with clinical domain experts, and drive execution. You are a self-directed player-coach who is comfortable getting "in the weeds" with workstream leads to build compliance documentation while also zooming out to present a 30,000-foot risk assessment to leadership. What You’ll Do (6-Month Scope) As a senior contractor, you will hit the ground running and lead the execution of our TJC survey readiness roadmap: Roadmap & Work Plan Ownership: Refine, maintain, and drive the master Project Work Plan for TJC Behavioral Health and Telehealth accreditation readiness, establishing clear workstream milestones across clinical and operational teams. Gap Analysis & Risk Mitigation: Continuously identify gaps, compliance risks, and cross-functional dependencies; proactively update the roadmap and implement risk mitigation strategies. Workstream Facilitation: Partner directly with workstream leads to deep-dive into specific TJC standards. Develop supporting materials and process documentation as needed. Mock Survey & Readiness Execution: Organize and project manage internal mock audits, tracer activities, and readiness drills to ensure operational teams are fully prepared for survey execution. Governance & Cross-Functional Alignment: Establish clear communication cadences across stakeholders (live working groups, asynchronous updates, and project dashboards) to drive cross-functional accountability. Executive Visibility: Develop concise, data-driven written updates for senior leadership to highlight progress, key milestones, and critical risks. Requirements: 10+ years of healthcare project management, healthcare operations, or management consulting experience, preferably within high-growth health tech or clinical environments Demonstrated track record of leading complex, cross-functional regulatory, compliance, or accreditation readiness initiatives from gap analysis through execution Exceptional strategic and project management skills with the ability to influence cross-functional peers and senior leadership without direct authority Strong written and verbal communication skills; proven ability to distill complex clinical insights and regulatory requirements into actionable executive summaries A highly organized self-starter who thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments and can create structure out of ambiguity Deep passion for expanding access to high-quality, evidence-based mental health care Preferred Qualifications: Direct experience or familiarity with the accreditation process (e.g., The Joint Commission, CARF, NCQA, or other), specifically within Behavioral Health Care and Human Services (BHC) or virtual/telehealth models Compensation Additional Information "We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information or any other category protected by law. By applying for this position, you acknowledge that your personal information will be processed as per the Lyra Health Workforce Privacy Notice . Through this application, to the extent permitted by law, we will collect personal information from you including, but not limited to, your name, email address, gender identity, employment information, and phone number for the purposes of recruiting and assessing suitability, aptitude, skills, qualifications, and interests for employment with Lyra. If you are a California resident and would like to limit how we use this information, please use the Limit the Use of My Sensitive Personal Information form . Please note that Lyra does not “sell” or “share” personal information as defined by the CPRA. Outside of the United States, for example in the EU, Switzerland and the UK, you may have the right to request access to, or a copy of, your personal information, including in a portable format; request that we delete your information from our systems; object to or restrict processing of your information; or correct inaccurate or outdated personal information in our systems.
