items.description: Proudly voted a Great Place to Work®, we are a dynamic startup in the CPaaS (Communication Platform as a Service) space that is revolutionizing the way businesses communicate. Our team is made up of 400+ energetic and passionate Unifones who are dedicated to delivering the best possible experience to 5000+ customer-centric companies. We pride ourselves on our fun and collaborative work environment, where creativity and new ideas are constantly encouraged. As shareholders in the business, we’re so much more than a group of passionate communicators. We are Unifones. Join our team and be a part of something big! Meet the team! Our Engineering team is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the systems and technologies that drive Unifonic ’s solutions. We work closely with other departments to ensure our products and services meet the needs of our customers. If you are passionate about technology and are excited about working on cutting-edge communication and engagement solutions, we want you on our team. As a Product Operations Lead, you will partner closely with Product Leadership to translate product strategy into scalable operational practices that drive alignment, efficiency, and measurable business outcomes. You will establish and continuously improve product operating models, governance frameworks, and cross-functional processes that enable Product, Engineering, Commercial, Marketing, and Customer-facing teams to work effectively toward shared goals. Acting as a trusted partner to stakeholders across the organization, you will drive collaboration, facilitate informed decision-making through data and insights, and ensure clear communication of product priorities, roadmaps, and outcomes. You will lead product enablement initiatives, support successful product launches and adoption, develop performance metrics and reporting frameworks, and identify opportunities to streamline workflows through process optimization and automation. By championing operational excellence, customer-centricity, and continuous improvement, you will help create an environment where product teams can scale efficiently, deliver value consistently, and maximize the impact of the product portfolio. Help us shape the future of communication by: Leading and continuously improving product operations frameworks, governance, and ways of working across Product teams. Owning and optimizing product planning processes, roadmap reviews, prioritization workflows, and operational cadences. Establishing scalable operational practices that improve alignment, transparency, delivery predictability, and execution quality. Driving standardization of product reporting, KPIs, operational dashboards, and decision-support insights. Identifying operational inefficiencies and implementing process improvements to increase team effectiveness and focus. Promoting adoption of AI tools, automation, and operational best practices to improve workflows, reporting, documentation, and knowledge sharing. Partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Commercial, Customer Success, Support, Presales, and Marketing teams to ensure strong operational alignment. Acting as a central point of coordination between business and product organizations. Facilitating communication of product priorities, roadmap updates, launches, and operational initiatives across stakeholders. Supporting leadership teams with operational insights, strategic reporting, and executive-ready communications. Leading Product Enablement initiatives that help internal teams effectively position, support, and adopt product capabilities. Supporting product launches, feature rollouts, demos, and internal readiness activities. Translating complex product functionality into clear messaging, use cases, enablement materials, and customer value narratives. Partnering with Commercial and Marketing teams to improve product awareness, adoption, and customer engagement. Helping identify and remove adoption barriers impacting internal teams or customers. Synthesizing customer feedback, product analytics, sales insights, and market trends into actionable recommendations. Identifying product usage patterns, operational gaps, and growth opportunities that can influence product strategy and commercial outcomes. Supporting Product leadership in defining and tracking success metrics tied to product and operational performance. Contributing to strategic initiatives focused on scaling Product Operations maturity and organizational effectiveness. Requirements What you’ll bring: 5+ years of experience in Product Operations, Product Management, Product Enablement, Product Marketing, Presales, Solution Consulting, or related roles. Proven experience leading or scaling operational processes within Product or SaaS organizations. Strong understanding of product lifecycle management, product delivery processes, and cross-functional collaboration. Experience working closely with Product, Engineering, and Commercial teams in fast-paced environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to translate insights into actionable outcomes. Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills. Demonstrated ability to drive initiatives independently and influence cross-functional teams. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. Experience in SaaS or CPaaS environments is a strong advantage. Craft and Toolkit: Product Operations & Process Optimization Strategic Planning & Execution Cross-Functional Leadership Product Enablement & Adoption Operational Excellence & Governance Data Analysis & Insight Generation Communication & Executive Storytelling Stakeholder Management & Influence Solutioning & Product Demonstrations AI Tools & Workflow Automation Customer-Centric Mindset Proactive, ownership-driven approach Character Traits: Analytical thinking and problem-solving – approach problems clearly, use data, and find solutions. Ownership and accountability – take responsibility and follow projects through to completion. Communication – explain ideas clearly and listen to others across teams. Collaboration – work well with others and support team goals. Adaptability and learning – adjust to change and keep learning new skills or tools. Mentorship and knowledge sharing – help others grow and share what you know. Resilience – stay calm under pressure and handle setbacks constructively. Quality and attention to detail – do work carefully and strive for improvement. Advocacy and innovation – encourage best practices, efficiency, and new ideas As a Unifone you’ll receive a range of benefits: Competitive salary and bonus Unifonic share scheme (we are all owners!) 30 holiday days after the first anniversary Your Birthday off! Spend up to 25 days per year working from anywhere in the world! Paid leave for new parents Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: 🧩 Hitapps is a GameDev company specializing in Puzzle Games. We have several successful products in both categories with a combined total of over 150M+ downloads, and we are regularly featured in the top charts in the Games section. Our culture is built on transparency, we are results-oriented and respect the improvement. Currently, we are in search of a talented Level Designer to drive our new products. Your Role: Design and build levels for mobile games from initial concept to final in-engine implementation; Monitor and interpret level performance metrics; Tune difficulty curves to maintain engagement across player skill segments, balancing challenge with accessibility; Run and participate in playtests; collect, structure, and act on feedback from both internal sessions and real players; Participate in A/B tests on level content and mechanics, analyse results and apply learnings to future designs; Maintain up-to-date level design documentation, style guides, and design rationale for the team; Propose and prototype new challenge types, obstacles, and interactive elements that fit within the game's genre and monetization mode. What makes you a perfect fit? Relevant work experience in similar positions for at least 3 years in the game development industry; Solid understanding of game flow, difficulty progression, and player retention principles; Ability to read analytics dashboards, draw actionable conclusions, and translate them into design changes; Systems thinking: the ability to see a level as an interconnected set of mechanics, pacing beats, and player goals; A portfolio containing shipped levels, paper designs, or documented design rationale — required for consideration; Strong communication skills and comfort working in cross-functional teams with short iteration cycles. What we offer: 💳 Competitive compensation 🏝 100% recovering for vacations, sick leaves; 🚀 12 additional paid day offs per year; 🏆 Budget for personal education, language courses & sports activities; 🌍 Conference attendance: you can join top industry events; 🤝 Zero bureaucracy and a supportive, transparent culture. Let’s create hits together! Originally posted on Himalayas

Identify, integrate, and manage diverse intelligence sources. Expand monitoring and research capacity to increase coverage of competitors, market trends, and emerging signals in real time. Foster and promote environment of collaboration and timely insights by hosting cross-functional and department-specific forums to aggregate and share proprietary knowledge. Monitor external landscape, including macroeconomic, industry, and competitor Identify key opportunities, threats, and shifts in market dynamics. Role model & champion RxBenefits Values. Maintain high levels of communication and coordination, sustaining a strong culture of collaboration, accountability, and customer-orientation. Required Skills / Experience: Experience in pharmacy benefits management industry required. 10+ years’ experience insights or strategy required. Highly collaborative team player with the ability to work effectively across all departments to build successful relationships with stakeholders. Excellent communication (both oral and written), interpersonal and organizational skills. Ability to present complex information through clear, compelling storytelling tailored to the audience. Ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects simultaneously with excellent attention to detail. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Data and Analytics About Flexport: At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us. The Opportunity The 3PL Operations Customer Success Manager acts as the crucial operational bridge between Flexport's e-commerce and retail clients and our warehouse fulfillment teams. You ensure SLA compliance, manage onboarding, and drive client retention by translating complex supply chain metrics into actionable business value. It's a client-facing, cross-functional role, and you'll be a key voice in how Flexport delivers on its commitments to fulfillment clients. You will: Client Success & Operational Liaison: Be the client's day-to-day point of contact, connecting them with warehouse, inventory, and tech teams to resolve fulfillment issues. Partner Oversight & SLA Accountability: Serve as Flexport's primary POC for assigned 3PL/4PL partners, inspecting sites and holding them accountable for SLAs on receiving, shipping, inventory accuracy, and packing quality. Coach teams of 30 to 100 at partner facilities and drive corrective action when needed. Forecasting & Capacity Planning: Share SNOP forecasts with partners and confirm labor and capacity plans align to demand. Billing & Invoice Management: Review and approve 3PL/4PL invoices and resolve discrepancies with partner teams. Process & Systems Compliance: Ensure partners follow Flexport SOPs and use our WMS correctly; troubleshoot system issues on the ground and reinforce best practices through hands-on support and training. Client Onboarding: Guide new merchants through WMS and OMS integration for a smooth transition into Flexport's fulfillment network. Performance Reporting: Deliver client-facing reports on inventory turns, shipping volume, and logistics efficiency to guide business reviews. Escalation Management: Own high-pressure escalations involving inventory loss, delayed shipments, or compliance fines, resolving quickly and communicating transparently with clients. Retention & Growth: Build long-term client trust through consistent operational reliability. Build the Function: Document how Flexport works with 4PL partners, including processes, escalation paths, and performance standards. You Should Have: 3+ years of hands-on experience in a warehouse, fulfillment, or 3PL/4PL operations environment, with working knowledge of floor-level workflows. 2+ years managing or coaching a team in a fulfillment, warehouse, or 3PL setting. Experience in account management or client-facing operations, translating operational performance into business outcomes. Proven ability to hold external partners accountable to SLAs without direct authority over their staff. Comprehensive, practical knowledge of WMS operations: capable of identifying root causes, training staff, and resolving system complications rather than merely managing daily operations. Strong reporting and data analysis skills: experience building and interpreting KPI dashboards (Excel or BI tools) and turning data into clear recommendations. Polished client-facing communication skills: experience leading business reviews and presenting performance data to external stakeholders, including navigating difficult conversations. Experience building structure and process in fast-paced, evolving environments. Nice-to-Haves: Experience managing merchant onboarding or system integrations Familiarity with client business reviews (QBRs) or account growth conversations International logistics or supply chain experience Before You Apply: Availability: Client fulfillment issues can arise outside standard business hours; you'll need to be reachable and able to manage your own time to match. Travel: You will visit partner and client sites regularly, including some travel outside your home region. A valid passport is required. Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at Flexport, which also includes bonus, equity, and comprehensive benefit offerings such as medical, dental, and flexible time off. TogetherWork is looking for a Manager/Sr. Manager of Marketing Operations to help build, manage, and optimize the systems, processes, data, and technology that power marketing across our portfolio of 20+ software products. This role will serve as a key contributor in managing our enterprise HubSpot environment and work closely with the Director of Performance Operations and broader Marketing and Revenue Operations teams to build a scalable Marketing Operations foundation across the organization. You’ll help ensure our technology and processes effectively support integrated campaigns, lead management, attribution, reporting, nurture, outbound, and the broader buyer journey. We’re looking for someone who combines strong strategic Marketing Operations judgment with deep hands-on HubSpot expertise. This person should be comfortable moving between designing scalable processes and directly building workflows, troubleshooting integrations and data syncs, configuring automation, and solving platform issues. What You’ll Do HubSpot Administrator: Serve as a primary administrator and subject-matter expert for our enterprise HubSpot environment supporting 20+ products, including platform ownership, architecture, governance, automation, and integrations with Salesforce and other marketing technologies. Build Scalable Marketing Operations Processes: Partner with Marketing and Revenue Operations to establish and maintain the processes, standards, and infrastructure that support integrated campaigns, lifecycle management, lead routing, scoring, nurture, outbound, landing pages, forms, and other marketing programs. Deep, hands-on HubSpot expertise, with the ability to immediately build and troubleshoot complex workflows, automation, lifecycle processes, data synchronization, integrations, forms, lists, and reporting within a sophisticated enterprise environment. Strong understanding of B2B demand generation and revenue processes, including lifecycle management, lead management, scoring, routing, nurture, attribution, campaign operations, and Marketing-to-Sales handoffs. Experience working across an integrated marketing technology ecosystem, including HubSpot and Salesforce, as well as reporting, enrichment, advertising, or other connected platforms. Strong understanding of marketing data, attribution, and reporting, with the ability to translate business requirements into practical system and process solutions. Experience developing and maintaining governance, standards, and scalable operating processes within a complex organization. Ability to independently manage complex initiatives and work effectively across Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations, Analytics, and Technology stakeholders. A strong combination of strategic thinking and hands-on technical execution — comfortable recommending the right architecture and operating model, then getting directly into HubSpot to build, configure, test, troubleshoot, and optimize it. Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills with the ability to simplify complex operational and technical topics. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment managing highly critical projects and systems that are integral to successful Marketing programs and overall business performance Nice to Have Experience supporting a multi-product, multi-brand, or business-unit-based B2B organization. Experience with HubSpot Enterprise features, including Business Units, custom objects, advanced workflows, attribution, and Salesforce integrations. Experience with marketing analytics or BI platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker. Familiarity with ABM, intent, enrichment, outbound, or sales engagement platforms. Experience with CRM or Marketing Automation consolidation, migration, or transformation initiatives. What You’ll Get This is an opportunity to: Play a key role in building and maintaining the Marketing Operations infrastructure supporting 20+ software products. Work closely with Marketing and Revenue Operations leadership on high-impact go-to-market initiatives. Make significant contribution in HubSpot architecture, processes, automation, and governance. Help improve how Togetherwork measures marketing performance, manages the buyer journey, and scales campaign execution. items.summary: Join Telaid as a Collections Specialist! Who We Are: Telaid is a leader in technology deployment solutions for multi-site enterprises.
items.description: Join Telaid as a Collections Specialist! Who We Are: Telaid is a leader in technology deployment solutions for multi-site enterprises. For over 40 years, we have been the trusted partner for accelerating the adoption of innovative technologies that drive positive business outcomes. Our mission is to reduce the time, effort, risk, and cost associated with implementing cutting-edge technology. Position Overview: As a Collections Specialist , you will play a vital role in ensuring the company receives timely payments from clients. This role requires strong financial analysis skills, customer service excellence, and problem-solving abilities to maintain Telaid’s financial health. If you’re a detail-oriented, results-driven professional who thrives in a collaborative environment, this is the perfect opportunity for you! Key Responsibilities: Use accounting software to generate reports and review open accounts for past-due balances. Track invoices nearing due dates and send reminders to customers proactively. Identify overdue amounts based on customer payment terms. Contact customers via phone or email in a professional manner to resolve outstanding payments while maintaining positive client relationships. Collaborate with Project Accountants and Project Managers to address billing issues and delinquent accounts. Reconcile discrepancies between customer records and company accounts. Escalate unresolved past-due accounts to the Credit & Collections Manager as needed. Provide timely follow-up on payment arrangements. Assist with generating and submitting invoices across various software platforms. Apply payments to customer accounts and review credit reports to establish credit limits for new customers. Identify trends in account delinquency and propose solutions to management. Qualifications: High School Diploma or equivalent (Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred). At least 2 years of experience in billing and collections. Strong communication, problem-solving, and analytical skills. Ability to work independently and excel in a fast-paced, multitasking environment. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel. Experience with ERP systems and project accounting environments is a plus. Knowledge of Crystal Reports, Power BI, and SQL is desirable. Why Join Telaid? items.description: Vice President, Invoice to Cash The Vice President, Invoice to Cash (I2C) is a senior operating executive responsible for leading both the Accounts Receivable, Cash Applications, and Requestor Management teams. This combined department of ~50 staff are responsible for working with a wide range of medical record requestors (insurance companies, attorneys, and their retrieval agents) with a mix of high touch account management for the high-volume requestors and a long tail mass touch approach for long tail of low volume requestors. Key metrics and activities that this role will be responsible for include: measuring and tracking Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) by cohort, percent of request volume actively managed, enhancing the monthly billing and statement process, maintaining unapplied cash at a 3-day level, and bringing more automation/technology to this function. This role is intentionally hands-on and detail-oriented, requiring deep engagement in daily collections activity, aging trends, customer disputes, and cash forecasting. In a private-equity-backed environment, this leader is expected to operate as a player-coach who can personally diagnose issues, drive execution, and hold teams accountable for results. Duties & Responsibilities: Hands-On Accounts Receivable Leadership & DSO Ownership (Primary Mandate), with Cash Applications and Requestor Management as secondary mandates Own enterprise-wide accounts receivable (AR) performance with direct, personal accountability for DSO reduction, and past-due aging Engage directly in weekly aging reviews, top delinquent account analysis, and high-risk customer situations Design and enforce disciplined collections operating rhythms, including daily, weekly, and monthly execution cadences Define, track, and actively manage KPIs including DSO, aging mix, Collection Effectiveness Index (CEI), dispute cycle time, and billing accuracy Lead hands-on improvements across collections, billing accuracy, cash application, and dispute workflows. Ensure improvements are embedded into daily execution, not just documented in policy Expand and mature the requestor management/data integrity process and team including management of sales tax-exempt requestors Partner with R&D team to design AR/collections modules within our platform Oversee daily cash application activities for all payment channels, including ACH, wire transfers, lockbox, credit cards, checks, and electronic payment platforms Ensure timely and accurate posting of customer and requestor payments to accounts receivable. Establish and maintain strong internal controls for cash receipt processing Lead implementation and optimization of cash application technologies, including AI-driven cash application tools and/or robotic process automation (RPA) Collaborate as a peer to the Controller, SVP of Finance, and VP of FP&A as a leader in the finance organization Perform other duties, as assigned, to ensure effective operation of the department and the Company Live by and promote Verisma Core Values Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business, required 12-15+ years of progressive experience in Management of Order/Invoice to Cash, Accounts Receivable, Collections, or Finance CPA strongly preferred Proven ability to lead and develop large, multi-functional teams with a data driven mindset Experience in Release of Information, Revenue Cycle, Record Retrieval, or Healthcare, preferred Technically proficient with data analysis tools such as Advance Excel, Power BI, SQL, etc. Travel 5 to 10% of the time Originally posted on Himalayas

In this role, you will serve as a key operational bridge between our Operations, Research, and UX teams, helping to coordinate research activities, support project execution, and ensure that insights and deliverables move efficiently from research through to implementation. This position is ideal for an "all-around player" who understands the nuances of primary and secondary research, excels at data evaluation, and feels comfortable navigating CX and research platforms. You will manage daily research work streams, validate survey data, and ensure seamless cross-functional execution across projects. Key Responsibilities Operational Bridge: Serve as a central liaison connecting Operations, UX, and Research teams to align project goals and streamline workflows. items.description: About NRG NRG is a leading global insights and strategy firm at the confluence of content, culture, and technology. We stay ahead of what’s next, providing fresh insights to spark new ideas. We’re a trusted partner to our clients, working behind the scenes to bring imagination, depth, and clarity to their biggest challenges – in entertainment, technology, lifestyle, sports, and gaming. Together, we create with confidence. We’re proud of our company’s values – these values guide us as we navigate sunny days, gray skies and everything in between: Do what you love. With conviction. Where discovery lives. And impact drives. Celebrate difference. Cultivate belonging. Big thinking. Collectively inspired. Embrace the journey. Be human. The Opportunity Our product and engineering organization is evolving to support increasingly sophisticated AI-enabled, data-driven products used by internal teams and external clients. We’re hiring a Lead, Product Support & Customer Experience to help strengthen the quality, reliability, and responsiveness of support for our client-facing products. This role sits at the intersection of users, client-facing teams, product, data, and engineering. The Lead, Product Support & Customer Experience will assist the department manager in improving production support, technical triage, user issue resolution, support workflows, SLA tracking, tooling, documentation, and the feedback loop between support activity and product improvement. This is not a traditional helpdesk or ticket-routing role. The right person will bring technical curiosity, operational discipline, strong communication, and genuine empathy for the user experience. They will care not only about whether a ticket is closed, but whether users feel heard, supported, and confident in our products. As the support function matures, this person will help build the foundation for a more scalable, empathetic, technically credible, and operationally disciplined support organization. Your Impact Assist the department manager in strengthening the product support and customer experience operating model for client-facing products, including triage, escalation, communication, documentation, and issue resolution workflows. Support timely response and resolution of production issues by helping diagnose whether problems are related to product behavior, data quality, data pipelines, configuration, permissions, user workflow, system performance, or expected product limitations. Champion the user experience by bringing empathy, follow-through, and sound judgment to support interactions, especially during urgent, ambiguous, or high-pressure production issues. Help set the standard for support quality and communication, ensuring users and client-facing teams receive clear, calm, accurate, and appropriately tailored updates. Help maintain SLA frameworks across ticket categories and severity levels, tracking response times, resolution times, escalation patterns, backlog health, recurring issue themes, and exceptions. Partner with engineering, data, product, and client-facing teams to ensure issues are clearly defined, routed to the right owners, prioritized appropriately, and resolved with the right level of urgency. Build trust with client-facing teams and users by understanding their workflows, pain points, expectations, and recurring frustrations. Identify patterns across tickets, incidents, usability gaps, and feature requests, and help translate those patterns into product feedback, process improvements, documentation updates, training needs, or engineering follow-up. Support safe and disciplined production practices, including appropriate data handling, controlled operational workflows, and reduction of unsafe or ad hoc workarounds. Help improve support tooling and processes, including platforms such as Zendesk or equivalent systems, ticket categorization, routing rules, automation, reporting dashboards, escalation workflows, and documentation. Contribute to team capability by sharing knowledge, improving debugging and triage practices, documenting repeatable workflows, and helping onboard or train other team members. Assist the department manager in identifying process gaps, training needs, capacity constraints, and opportunities to improve the structure and effectiveness of the support function. Use AI and automation tools thoughtfully to improve issue diagnosis, ticket analysis, documentation quality, workflow efficiency, and proactive identification of recurring problems. Who We're Looking For Required Experience 7+ years of experience in product support, technical support, support operations, customer experience, product operations, technical account management, data operations, or a related function supporting software, data, analytics, or reporting products. Strong technical curiosity and demonstrated ability to diagnose complex issues across product, data, workflow, and system layers. Experience working with production systems, data-heavy environments, analytics platforms, reporting products, dashboards, or other client-facing technology environments. Ability to communicate clearly and calmly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, especially during urgent or ambiguous support situations. Demonstrated empathy for users and client-facing teams, with a strong desire to improve not only issue resolution, but the overall support experience. Experience working with engineering, product, data, client services, or business stakeholders to clarify issues, coordinate resolution, and improve processes. Familiarity with support platforms such as Zendesk, Jira Service Management, Freshdesk, or equivalent tools. Familiarity with support operations metrics such as first response time, resolution time, escalation rate, backlog health, SLA adherence, and repeat incident rate. Experience identifying recurring issue patterns and translating them into process improvements, documentation, training, product feedback, or technical follow-up. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment. Comfort experimenting with AI tools, copilots, or internal AI systems to improve debugging, documentation, workflow efficiency, and support insight. Preferred Experience Experience in market research, media, entertainment, analytics, data platforms, or reporting systems. Experience writing SQL or investigating data quality, data transformation, data pipeline, or reporting issues. Experience configuring support workflows, automations, escalation rules, dashboards, or ticket categorization models. Experience helping train team members, document workflows, or improve support team practices. Experience supporting AI-enabled products, analytics tools, dashboards, or data-driven applications. Position Type This is a full-time, exempt position. What We Offer We embrace the current era of work and what it means to be a best-in-class employer. We understand the flexibility that is required to recruit and retain incredible talent, whether it’s empowering you to do your best work from anywhere you desire or supporting you if you need to take a mental health day for self-care and rest. Below is a unique blend of benefits tailored to meeting the ever-changing professional landscape. Flexible/Remote work with optional usage of our great offices in Playa Vista or New York Unlimited PTO, volunteer days and a generous number of recharge days including a full office closure during the week of Christmas and New Year’s Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance Plans 401K with company match Generous paid Parental Leave Regular performance evaluations with opportunities for promotions and merit increases Educational and training reimbursement plan and other training and professional development opportunities Employee perks program (includes discounts on travel, hotels, cars, fitness, movie tickets and more) Resources available for mental health, inclusive care and family building NRGratitude – our company-wide employee recognition program Regular team/company events and activities including annual summer and holiday parties Pet friendly headquarters and pet insurance options Our Commitment Diversity, equity, and inclusion is at the center of all our practices to ensure that NRG is a place where people from all identities and backgrounds can thrive. NRG is committed to recruiting and retaining diverse talent by supporting their growth through learning programs, internal mobility, affinity group participation and leadership development. Our differences make us a stronger workforce and enhance our creativity and innovation. We are proud to be an inclusive workplace for all and are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by state, federal, or local law. Compensation In order to comply with equal pay and salary transparency laws in various locations, we believe the target range of base compensation in all locations within the United States for this role is $120,000-180,000. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.

items.description: Role: Global Business Development Manager Location: Remote (Applicable only for Global candidates) Who You Are You are a commercially focused business development professional with UK and global student recruitment expertise, strong agent networks, CRM experience, and a proven ability to lead teams and drive growth. About Us Regent College London is a leading independent higher education provider, offering flexible and inclusive learning across multiple London campuses. We are student-focused, digitally forward, and committed to academic excellence. The Role Lead UK and global student recruitment by managing agent partnerships, developing new business, improving conversion and compliance, and supporting teams to achieve growth targets. Key Responsibilities 1. Key Activities and Responsibilities Report management – ensuring that daily reports are up to date and sent out to all partners/agents daily or until the SLA set with partner. Manage between 12-18 agent/accounts and ensure they are meeting expectations and are providing the quality of learners that is expected. Identifying potential new agents/accounts/businesses to further develop UKBDL and UKDL student recruitment and any other global remit. Managing junior business development executives and supporting teams – Ensuring their activities support the objectives of student recruitment. Providing a smooth journey for both the agent/account and students, ensuring the application process is efficient to support improved conversion. This can include getting feedback from relevant parties to continuously improve processes. Have a detailed understanding of all systems used by both agents and students to ensure advice and guidance in this area is clear Ensuring KPI’s set by the Head of Business Development are met. This includes delivery of targets set via agents/account, onboarding new business, improving conversion rate from application to enrolment, and improving brand awareness in existing and new markets. Proactively support all colleagues in pursuit of the University’s central objectives and values within the business at all levels. Gathering intelligence and data to propose new initiative to further develop new and existing UK and global opportunities. This will include – interpreting of data, and articulating key messages, and publishing papers for relevant committees. Ensure that the University’s reputation is protected by getting all agents/accounts to adhere to the University’s processes and acting with integrity internally and externally. Part of this to ensure existing and new agents/businesses recommended have a good track record in HE Adhere to the universities admissions processes and regulations ensuring a clear audit trail for training and compliance purposes. Ensuring all students recruited through agent meets the required levels of progression/AU benchmark, this will include the continuous auditing of students referred via agents. 2. Analysis and Reporting Identify gaps or shortfalls in recruitment strategies and identifying how to solve these issues. Analyse data/statistics, interpreting and reporting patterns and trends and highlighting and prioritising any issues for further investigation to support informed decision making. Provide daily reports on student activity to agents and partners. Provide reports and updates to key commercial leads within the business. Analysing agent performance not only from a recruitment perceptive but from a student engagement perceptive as well. 3. Customer/Service Support Provide advice to peers and partners to respond and independently resolve a range of standard and unforeseen issues, within pre-determined operational limits. Support and lead Business development Executives, support teams, and other relevant departments. Advise and update the team on regulatory/compliance/product/process changes providing appropriate training as needed. Ensuring the partner/agent is receiving the best support and is being provide the best service to the standard the University requires. Diagnose and rectify any problems with sales processes and systems. Feedback to the agents/ Partners on performance of students. Planning and organising Plan and organise own activities to ensure that routine operations and ongoing KPI’s deadlines are continuously met. Support in the development of team structures. Prepare a plan agent/partner training both face to face and online. Ensuring SLA’s are met and that partners are happy with service being provided. Participate in or co-ordinate student recruitment projects or development activities. Make recommendations about resource planning. 5. Liaison Communicate and build working relationships with agents/partners to ensure they are happy with the service being provided and that they grow within the business. Attend meetings, as requested by manager, to support departmental activities and to report back on main discussion points. Liaising with key stakeholders, such as admissions, quality assurance and student support. Regular communication with the Business Development Team, providing feedback on Agent documents that are being submitted. 6. Continuous Improvement Advise on and propose changes in procedures, planning and systems to improve operational efficiency to improve quality of service in student recruitment. Keep skills up to date and develop depth or breadth of knowledge in student recruitment practice by learning from colleagues and exposure to a range of activities, training and networking opportunities. Continuing to improve conversion rate and enrolled numbers coming from each partner. Make recommendations on how to improve the University’s brand and make it more commercially attractive. Look at ways of improving current processes, especially when looking at growth within the team and recruitment numbers. 7. People Management Co-operate with other colleagues (either individually or in a team setting) to contribute to the achievement of departmental objectives. Train and develop junior staff members, and ensure direct reports are performing their duties and meeting their KPI’s. Managing the agent/partnership relationships, ensuring they are clear on all admissions procedures and are meeting their quality requirements. Show sensitivity and consideration and emotional support to other people’s/student’s needs and feelings, which often include dealing with signs of obvious distress. Dealing with culture differences, for example when dealing with overseas staff remember they may be used to a different working environment than we are in the UK or other global countries Deliver guidance and support in a calm, discreet, diplomatic and professional manner. Support agents/partners and provide referral and signposting pathways for students in crisis to internal and external support function and organisations. 8. Personal and Professional Development and Training Identify and address development needs to ensure continuing professional development. Communicate and share best practice. Proactively identify new opportunities and work with management to develop solutions. Work in accordance with the University’s Values Framework. Maintain strong empathy for the university's commitment to equality of opportunity and equality of treatment for colleagues and students. 9. Other Responsibilities Any other duties as appropriate to seniority and role. The post-holder will be required occasionally to travel to other locations for meetings or training. Attendance at appropriate internal working parties as required. To always ensure the University’s name and brand is never brought into doubt and that externally we are seen as professional and a pleasure to work with. Essential: Analyse market data and trends, to assist and advise faculties, departments and senior management within the University on the development of UK and global recruitment strategies, new programmes, or policies on UK activities where appropriate. Liaise and engage with key stakeholders and internal and external contractors to influence opinion, delivery and reputation of services. Influence and contribute to the scoping and resource planning across a range of activities at operational level to meet organisational objectives, including contributing to business plans and strategy documents where required. Implement processes to manage the integrity and security of all commercially and professionally sensitive and personal data. Analysis & problem-solving capability Well-developed written and verbal communication skills and interpersonal skills Ability to manage partners expectations and provide training sessions to ensure quality Ability to prioritise tasks and delegate tasks to direct reports. Represent the University at education expositions, Universities, schools, and colleges, as a University Influencing Senior Colleagues/external partners. Develop external relations, identify and develop opportunities for communities of practice, employers, alumni and donors via extra-curricular activities and increased levels of participation with a view to positively impact student recruitment. Build and sustain an influential network of contacts both internally and externally to influence and promote reputation, including relevant education institutions, Embassies, Consulates and sponsorship bodies. Keep well informed about the University in all relevant aspects of its work through engagement with relevant committees, attendance at workshops and events, and networking with University colleagues. This will include submit committee papers helping to aid UK recruitment. In collaboration with finance business partners create business cases to validate commercial opportunities for the university Contribute to operational leadership teams and decision making to shape the nature and level of support services. Provide expert professional subject and/or managerial expertise at an operational level to support UK/Domestic student recruitment, including achievement of UK/Domestic student application targets, increasing the quality of the student intake, increasing conversion rates from application to registration, and increasing diversity in terms of ethnicity, subject of study and recruitment from under represented community groups. Experience of working with complex sales processes and CRM software Experience of working/responding independently and dealing with unforeseen problems and circumstances Comprehensive knowledge of the work practices, processes, and procedures relevant to the role. Clear understanding of the standards and regulations set for the conduct and output for the role. Understanding of the activities of other areas of the University relevant to the student recruitment function. Experience in successfully managing partners/ agents. Experience pulling reports and providing them to key stakeholders. Ability to analyse reports and sales figures to identify trends within the agent market, and share/articulate intelligence to drive change. Desirable: Extensive UK and global network including agents, institutions (i.e. British Council, QS, local education ministries, etc) Post Grad/PhD (or candidature), Previous account management experience. Working Hours & Flexibility 40 hours per week 100% Remote - Working from any other country apart from UK Compliance Statement Successful applicants will be required to complete pre-employment checks, including a criminal records check, two references, ID and Right to Work verification, and education confirmation. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity and inclusion, selection for employment is based solely on an individual’s skills, qualifications, and experience relevant to the role. items.summary: Are you a dreamer, innovator, thinker and a do-er who believes in contributing to something that makes difference?
items.description: Are you a dreamer, innovator, thinker and a do-er who believes in contributing to something that makes difference? Make an impact. Join PMI. How will you make a difference to PMI? The External Communications Strategist III is an execution-first, senior individual contributor responsible for driving earned media opportunities and narrative enablement in support of PMI’s corporate reputation, thought leadership, and strategic priorities. This role sits within the PR + Communications team and operates with a high degree of autonomy, judgment, and ownership. As a Level III individual contributor, this role is expected to operate as a trusted advisor within Communications—anticipating opportunities, identifying risks, and independently driving work forward while ensuring alignment to broader narrative and reputational priorities. You will provide strategic counsel to senior stakeholders on external narrative direction, message discipline, and reputational considerations, and recommend narrative adjustments based on trends, current events, and performance insights. What you’ll bring to the role: Earned Media Strategy & Agency Partnership Collaborate with PR agency to identify story opportunities and develop timely, compelling pitch angles aligned to priority narrative beats for both B2B and consumer audiences. Maximize PR agency performance helping to sharpen briefs, challenge thinking, and ensure proactive, high-quality execution against PMI’s strategic communications goals. Partner with PR agency (and consult with internal stakeholders, including regional and functional leads) on developing strategy and positioning for global media house moments. Partner with the broader Marketing organization to source appropriate community or executive spokespeople; vet, prepare, and align them for earned media pitching and engagements. Use media intelligence and performance insights (e.g., message pull-through, tier-1 quality, topic traction) to identify narrative opportunities and gaps, and to refine story angles and pitching strategy. Shape earned media strategies that strengthen PMI’s discoverability and influence in search and AI-driven answer environments, ensuring coverage reinforces desired brand perception, priority narratives, and authoritative topic associations. Earned & Sponsored External Opportunities Independently or collaboratively identify and execute strategic earned opportunities for PMI executives or community spokespeople to reach unaware or new audiences (e.g., third-party events, podcasts, partner activations, key account–adjacent moments). Partner with PR agency and relevant internal teams to evaluate, secure, and execute selective sponsored opportunities (e.g., panels, conferences, tentpole events) that advance PMI’s narratives and reputational goals. Assess external opportunities for narrative fit, audience value, and reputational considerations; recommend go/no-go decisions and execute approved engagements end-to-end. Identify and shape thought leadership platforms (e.g., executive bylines, strategic reports, high-impact forums, and selective partnerships) that reinforce priority narratives and differentiate PMI’s point of view. Narrative Ownership & Enablement Lead efforts for defined corporate message houses, including maintenance of current proof points, examples, and data, ensuring they reflect evolving business priorities and external context. Own external narrative governance for assigned topics (message architecture, claims/proof points, and executive-ready guidance), ensuring consistency across earned media, executive platforms, and thought leadership moments. Define what is included in narrative-specific enablement kits (e.g., message houses, executive-ready slides, talk tracks, FAQs, supporting materials) and proactively distribute to internal stakeholders and executives ahead of external opportunities. Maintain and refresh enablement kits on a regular cadence; communicate updates clearly and ensure adoption across PR, Marketing, and regional teams. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Judgment Work closely with Director of PR & Communications, Marketing, regional teams, and agency partners to ensure narrative consistency and executional excellence across external touchpoints. Influence senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners to align on narrative, timing, and external positioning—often without direct authority—and deliver clear recommendations (including go/no-go) in ambiguous, high-visibility situations. Maintain issues readiness for assigned narratives, including rapid response positioning, Q&A, and escalation recommendations in reputationally sensitive moments. Navigate nuanced, high-visibility topics with maturity and discretion; identify risks early (misalignment, gaps, timing, tone) and recommend solutions. Independently manage multiple workstreams and deadlines; maintain clear tracking of opportunities, deliverables, approvals, and outcomes. Role Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, Public Relations, or related field (or equivalent experience). 8-10+ years of experience in corporate communications, PR, or earned media–focused roles. Demonstrated experience partnering with and managing PR agencies to drive earned media outcomes. Proven track record of developing and executing proactive earned media or external engagement strategies tied to corporate narratives. Experience operating with senior-level autonomy and judgment in complex, matrixed organizations. Strong earned media instincts with the ability to translate narrative strategy into executable story angles. Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to distill complex topics into clear, compelling messages. High judgment and discretion; comfortable operating in reputationally sensitive areas. Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills. Highly organized, self-directed operator with strong prioritization and follow-through. Ability to anticipate needs, proactively identify opportunities, and execute with minimal oversight. Stakeholder management is paramount; ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment on narrative direction and recommendations. Strategic, analytical mindset with the ability to use insights and reporting to optimize external communications strategy and outcomes. Proficiency in the business language for PMI (English). Possible travel up to 5% What you can expect from us We value and nurture an environment of inclusivity and diversity, and a culture of communication and collaboration. Apply today! items.description: About Us Mighty Networks helps people and brands build communities, online courses, memberships, challenges, and events. Because of this novel approach and member-centered experience, Mighty has produced the most $1M communities and helped its Hosts earn over $500M. The Role As a Community Strategist, you’ll work with our premium Mighty Pro customers to help them create deeply engaging community experiences that lead to powerful outcomes. You will lead workshops, co-create launch strategies, and shape the early member experience for some of the world’s boldest and most influential Hosts. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in both structured systems and creative problem-solving, and is excited to model excellence, mentor peers, and scale success through repeatable frameworks. What You'll Do Serve as a strategic partner to new Mighty Pro Hosts during their onboarding phase as they set up their Network in the way that leads to maximum member adoption, engagement, and retention. Facilitate impactful workshops with Hosts and their teams that establish strong foundations in community design, content cadence, and engagement strategy. Deliver targeted training on feature utilization, member onboarding flows, and tactical programming to drive adoption, activation, and retention. Provide creative input and feedback on brand elements like landing pages, welcome experiences, email sequences, and network messaging to ensure a cohesive and compelling member journey. Own the development and delivery of strategic Community Design Plans—including network architecture, monthly themes, onboarding flows, and launch programming calendars. Collaborate closely with Launch Specialists and Implementation teams, providing timely information and handling lightweight setup tasks directly where appropriate. Ensure clarity, consistency, and excellence in the execution of space configuration, access structure, and end-to-end member experience. Maintain regular updates to internal stakeholders on Host performance, needs, risks, and outcomes—contributing to visibility and cross-functional alignment. Contribute to shared knowledge across the Customer Success team by capturing and scaling best practices, identifying emerging trends, and improving playbooks. What We're Looking For 6+ years of client-facing experience, ideally working with strategic accounts or supporting 5–6 figure engagements in a SaaS, media, or creator-focused business. 2+ years experience in a consulting, business coaching, or agency role. Strategic thinker and tactical executor—you can map out long-term plans, define metrics for success, and follow through on details to deliver. Deep understanding of community-building and digital member experiences; you’re passionate about helping others create belonging at scale. Excellent communicator and facilitator, with confidence in guiding executive teams through planning, decision-making, and feedback cycles. Master of meetings—you show up with a plan, gather input with nuance, read the room, and close with clear decisions and next steps. Adaptable and proactive, energized by growth and ambiguity, and always seeking ways to streamline and improve. Highly collaborative and cross-functional, thriving when working across CS, Implementation, Product, and Strategy to elevate outcomes. Radically curious, with a growth mindset and drive to keep learning about Hosts, their businesses, and how digital communities are evolving. What We Offer A dynamic, remote-first work culture that values creativity, autonomy, and bold thinking. Comprehensive benefits, including health, vision, dental, and generous paid time off. items.description: Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role. Consensys is the leading blockchain and web3 software company. Founded by Joe Lubin, CEO of Consensys and Co-Founder of Ethereum in 2014, Consensys has been at the forefront of innovation, pioneering technological developments within the web3 ecosystem. The financial system is being rebuilt on open, programmable infrastructure, and Consensys is helping power that transition. From MetaMask, the platform trusted by tens of millions of users worldwide, to Linea, the only 100% proven zkEVM rollup and an emerging home for institutional ETH capital, Consensys builds products and infrastructure that enable users, developers, and institutions to participate in the next generation of the internet. Our mission is to unlock the collaborative power of communities by making the decentralized web universally easy to access, use, and build on. Joining Consensys means working with a fully remote, globally distributed team of technologists, designers, cryptographers, product thinkers, and researchers who are building the next layer of the internet. You'll be exposed to new ideas, emerging technologies, and complex challenges that push you to stay at the top of your game while helping scale products and infrastructure used by tens of millions of users and thousands of developers across the web3 ecosystem. You'll join a network of builders that reaches the edge of our ecosystem. Consensys alumni have moved on to become tech entrepreneurs, CEOs, and team leads at tech companies. About Metamask MetaMask aims to create a thriving engineering organization that supports the well-being of our engineers while empowering them to do work they are proud of and enjoy. We strive for an environment that gives our people high trust and autonomy, while also facilitating collaboration, communication and camaraderie among teams and teammates. We aspire to build a diverse engineering team, inclusive to people from all backgrounds and demographics. It is also of great importance to us that working at MetaMask is an experience that catalyzes career growth and learning. What you'll do As a Senior Engineer, you will: Contribute to MetaMask's social expansion and multi-chain user experiences. Unify, enhance and transform our experiences across MetaMask Portfolio, Browser Extension, and Mobile platforms to support social experiences Coordinate and communicate with other experience teams to complete complex projects Mentor more junior team members and broadly elevate the level of engineers around you Requirements: 6+ years working with web and mobile-based technologies Hands-on experience with React and React Native Extensive experience with modern Javascript (ES6/TypeScript/etc.) Experience with blockchain fundamentals across multiple blockchain architectures Strong working knowledge developing cross platform/browser compatibility Experience working in an agile development team Experience developing medium to large-scale applications across the entire stack with minimal tech debt through sensible abstractions, testing, linting, and adherence to coding/web standards Experience consuming APIs A demonstrable understanding of Continuous Integration Strong understanding of web-based security threats and prevention techniques Bonus Points: Working knowledge of multiple blockchain protocols (EVM and non-EVM) Experience with cross-chain bridges, transaction lifecycle and/or interoperability solutions Demonstrated passion for and knowledge of blockchain technologies Experience working in a decentralized, distributed team Previous experience working in Web3 Product knowledge about the Web3 wallet space Mobile experience (React Native, Objective C, Swift) Other skills to demonstrate: Excellent verbal and written communication in English Teamwork, flexibility, initiative, communication and organization Willingness to constantly learn & improve, challenging yourself to stay at the top of your game Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role. It is a requirement of employment in this position that applicants will be required to submit to background checks including but not limited to employment, education and criminal record checks. Further details will be provided to applicants that successfully meet the criteria for the position as determined by the company in its sole discretion. By submitting an application for employment, you are acknowledging and consenting to this requirement. Other - NOT USA $130,000—$190,000 USD In the rapidly evolving Web3 space, we believe that everyone is a builder. This expansive paradigm requires a range of backgrounds, talents, skills, and experiences to influence and shape the future. At Consensys , this diversity fuels our ability to shift control and redefine the realm of possibility. We are committed to ensuring that our technology empowers people and communities with economic and political agency through decentralized technologies. We welcome the range of perspectives and differences and celebrate them. We're excited to see how your unique skills as a builder can contribute to our vision, drive innovation, and help us shape a more inclusive Web3. Consensys is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. At LooseGrip, we're a boutique digital consultancy that transforms brands through data-inspired storytelling and performance marketing. We're looking for a Junior Designer to support our digital marketing campaigns-someone with a strong eye, a curious mind, and the hustle to turn briefs into beautifully executed visuals. This is a part-time contract role with flexible hours and real opportunities to grow alongside a tight-knit team. What You'll Do Design for the scroll. Create on-brand social graphics, paid ad creative, email assets, and landing page visuals for a range of digital marketing campaigns. Bring briefs to life. Translate creative direction and campaign goals into clean, compelling design that drives engagement and performance. Stay on brand. Work within established brand systems, applying guidelines consistently across formats, channels, and clients. Iterate fast. Take feedback in stride, refine quickly, and produce multiple variations to support A/B testing and campaign optimization. Collaborate seamlessly. Partner with strategists, copywriters, and client experience managers to ensure every asset hits the mark. What You Bring A solid portfolio. You have 1-3 years of design experience (internships and freelance count) with samples that show range across digital marketing formats. Design tool fluency. You're at home in Figma and the Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), including motion basics (After Effects, Premiere Pro). Bonus points for familiarity with email design tools. AI curiosity and comfort. You're proficient in AI tools for ideation and efficiency (and know when to reach for them), but your instincts as a designer are always in the driver's seat. A digital-first eye. You understand how design works in feeds, inboxes, and ad placements and you design with the end platform in mind. Attention to detail. Typography, alignment, color, export specs-you sweat the small stuff because you know it adds up. A self-starter mindset. You're a grown-ass adult who manages your time well, asks smart questions, moves work forward independently, and communicates well asynchronously and virtually with teammates through tools like ClickUp, Figma reviews, and Slack chats. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/loosegrip-junior-designer-part-time-contract

items.summary: Company Description It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. items.description: Company Description It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We’re building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we’re just getting started. Join us to put AI to work for people. Job Description Role and team: We are looking for an experienced Senior Auditor to support planning and lead execution of global and/or regional operational and integrated audits spanning business operational controls, IT general controls and application controls. This remote position will be reporting to Director, Internal Audit Management. We have a tight team environment where support, loyalty, and honest feedback are the currency. ServiceNow employees are expected to be self-starting, proactive, and thrive in a fast-paced environment. What you get to do in this role: Support planning and scoping of operational and integrated audits across business and IT operations. Complete assignments efficiently and timely. Conduct walkthroughs, evaluate process design, and perform controls testing across both business processes and IT systems, consistently delivering quality audit work papers that support and substantiate audit observations. Continuously explore and adopt AI tools creatively and responsibly through the audit lifecycle to accelerate fieldwork and elevate analytical depth. We expect our auditors to experiment, share what works, and help evolve how Internal Audit delivers value. Utilize data analytics and AI to identify control gaps, quantify risk exposure, and deliver data-driven insights to management. Assist in producing high-quality Internal Audit reports by clearly drafting audit issues and developing valid conclusions resulting in process and internal control improvements, while considering implementation requirements, cost, and stakeholder feedback. Timely and effective communication with audit leads on audit status, escalations, issues, and reporting. Perform action tracking follow-up with management for Audit Committee reporting purposes. Participate in major business initiatives and proactively advise and assist the business on key risks, control environment, and change initiatives. Contribute to the evolution of Internal Audit methodology, automation, and reporting, including ServiceNow IRM to scale audit coverage and quality. Responsible for internal stakeholder engagement, including the development of working relationships with key stakeholders and proudly representing the Internal Audit function. Qualifications To be successful in this role, you have: A passion for Internal Audit and strong desire to be part of a stellar IA team! Minimum 4-year degree (or US equivalent) from an accredited university; degree in Management Information Systems, Finance and Accounting strongly preferred. Minimum of 5 years’ work experience, with 3 years at a public accounting firm (Big 4 or national consulting firm preferred), including experience in internal auditing, external auditing, SOX, operations and process improvement. Demonstrated experience auditing both IT general controls and application controls, and business operational processes. Comfort moving fluidly between technology and business-process audits, including within the same integrated engagement. Understanding of data governance and privacy compliance, and the ability to apply system architecture knowledge to the processes being reviewed. Understanding of risks and controls in modern technology environments. Awareness of AI/GenAI governance and model risk considerations. Good understanding of business and operations, strong analytical and project management skills. Proficiency in Excel and process mapping tools. Hands-on experience with data analytics tools such as Power BI. Experience with SAP preferred. Strong critical thinking and analytical skills; ability to identify and conduct root cause analysis. Excellent verbal, written, oral communication, and presentation skills. Ability to work both independently and as a team member. Ability to manage multiple tasks concurrently, efficiently and effectively with minimal oversight. Familiarity with the ServiceNow platform, including IRM modules, a strong plus (Preferred) At least one of the following certifications: CISA, CISM, CIA, CPA Prefer candidates with exposure to a high growth and/or rapidly changing technology enterprise. We provide competitive compensation, generous benefits, and a professional atmosphere. This is a very collaborative and inclusive work environment where individuals strong in aptitude and attitude will have an opportunity to grow their professional careers through working with some of the most advanced technology and talented developers in the business. Additional Information Work Personas We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service. Equal Opportunity Employer ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements. Accommodations We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact [email protected] for assistance. Export Control Regulations For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities. From Fortune. ©2026 Fortune Media IP Limited. All rights reserved. Used under license.
