items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Canada - Remote Description de l'entreprise Workleap est une entreprise tech basée à Montréal avec comme mission de rendre le travail plus simple. Depuis 2006, on bâtit des produits innovants qui aident les équipes RH et TI à relever leurs plus grands défis. Workleap offre deux lignes de produits distinctes : La plateforme Workleap , une solution RH propulsée par l’IA qui élève la performance des équipes et stimule l’engagement des employés. ShareGate , le leader incontesté en migration et gouvernance Microsoft 365, reconnu par les professionnels TI du monde entier pour sa grande simplicité. Aujourd’hui, c’est plus de 20 000 entreprises partout dans le monde qui comptent sur les produits Workleap pour croître, évoluer et opérer. On est des bâtisseurs dans l’âme et ce qui nous passionne est clair : créer les produits les plus simples qui amènent de la valeur exceptionnelle à nos clients, un point c’est tout. Description du poste Concrètement à quoi va ressembler ton poste ? En tant que Senior Designer de Produit sur ShareGate Migrate , tu travailleras au sein d’un trio produit étroitement collaboratif (PM, Tech Lead, Designer) pour façonner l’expérience d’un produit utilisé dans des projets à fort impact et à forte sensibilité opérationnelle. Tu concevras des solutions qui aident les administrateurs TI à naviguer dans des scénarios de migration complexes avec clarté et confiance. Ton travail couvre à la fois la stratégie et l’exécution : définition des problématiques, conception des parcours et des interactions, affinage des détails d’interface, et itérations rapides basées sur les apprentissages. Tu exploreras de manière réfléchie comment l’ IA peut enrichir l’expérience, que ce soit pour simplifier la planification, faire émerger des insights pertinents ou guider les équipes dans leurs décisions techniques. C’est une occasion de travailler sur des enjeux concrets ayant un impact réel sur l’évolution des environnements numériques des organisations. Tu t’épanouiras dans ce rôle si tu aimes la complexité, collabores naturellement avec les ingénieurs et les PM, et accordes une grande importance à la création d’expériences utilisateur fiables, réfléchies et capables de passer à l’échelle. Responsabilités : Piloter le design de bout en bout au sein de ton équipe produit, de la définition des problèmes jusqu’au raffinement des interactions finales ; Transformer des parcours ambigus ou techniques en expériences intuitives et utiles pour des professionnels TI ; Concevoir des parcours, interfaces et interactions qui simplifient les scénarios de migration Microsoft 365 et cloud ; Collaborer étroitement avec les PM, les ingénieurs et les experts métier pour clarifier le périmètre et aligner la stratégie ; Prototyper, tester et itérer rapidement afin de valider les hypothèses et renforcer les solutions ; Utiliser les données, les retours clients et les insights produit pour guider les décisions et améliorer les résultats ; Explorer des opportunités liées à l’IA pour rendre les flux de migration et de gouvernance plus efficaces, prédictifs et fiables ; Contribuer à l’amélioration des pratiques design à l’aide de nouveaux outils, d’innovations et de nouvelles méthodologies ; Participer à l’évolution du design system et veiller à la cohérence de l’expérience à travers ShareGate. Une semaine typique? Tu évolueras naturellement entre exploration stratégique, design concret et collaboration étroite. Concrètement, tu pourras : Contribuer à la direction produit lors des activités de planification et de découverte en trio ; Traduire les besoins clients et les opportunités business en parcours clairs, wireframes et prototypes ; Travailler avec l’ingénierie pour affiner le périmètre, comprendre les contraintes et maintenir un haut niveau de qualité design tout au long du développement ; Présenter des travaux en cours aux équipes et aux parties prenantes lors de critiques ou de revues asynchrones ; Analyser les données de migration, les tendances de support et les comportements utilisateurs pour éclairer les décisions ; Raffiner les détails d’interaction et assurer des hand-offs clairs et cohérents ; Documenter les décisions et communiquer efficacement le raisonnement derrière les choix effectués ; Utiliser des outils d’IA pour mieux comprendre nos utilisateurs et augmenter ton efficacité ; Prototyper régulièrement avec des outils de prototypage assistés par l’IA pour communiquer, tester et valider les solutions. Tu bénéficieras d’autonomie, de responsabilité, et d’une équipe qui valorise l’exécution réfléchie et l’apprentissage continu. Qui est l’équipe que tu vas rejoindre ? Tu rejoindras une équipe multidisciplinaire où les designers sont impliqués tôt, influencent la direction produit et collaborent étroitement avec l’ingénierie et la gestion de produit. Le design chez Workleap est collaboratif, riche en feedback, et engagé à constamment élever le niveau, autant dans les processus que dans la qualité du craft. Quels sont les prochains défis qui attendent ton équipe ? ShareGate évolue rapidement, et les défis design à venir demandent à la fois créativité et rigueur. Tu contribueras notamment à : Des scénarios de migration à l’échelle entreprise, où la clarté, la prévisibilité et l’efficacité sont essentielles ; La modernisation des expériences clés de ShareGate Migrate et de l’écosystème plus large ; L’évolution d’un design system en croissance, soutenant de nouveaux patterns, l’accessibilité et la cohérence multi-produits ; Des expériences de planification et de guidance AI-native pour aider les équipes TI à anticiper les risques et prendre des décisions éclairées. C’est un rôle où tu peux influencer non seulement le fonctionnement du produit aujourd’hui, mais aussi son évolution sur les prochaines années. items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Canada Rockstar is recruiting for a digital product studio that specializes in turning ideas into extraordinary digital experiences. This client is a dynamic, remote-first team of savvy professionals known for pushing creative boundaries and delivering high-quality, user-centered products through a collaborative and lean approach. This client is building a bench of talented product designers for upcoming client work. They are looking for mid-to-senior-level freelance designers who can bring strong UX thinking, sharp visual design skills, and a collaborative spirit to the team. What they're looking for If you're a seasoned product designer with a passion for digital excellence, this opportunity is for you. You’ve honed your craft over the years, with a deep understanding of UX design, visual storytelling, and collaborative product development. You’re equally comfortable working independently and alongside a cross-functional team. You manage your time well, take ownership of your work, and make confident decisions with minimal oversight. You’re fluent in tools like Figma and Adobe Suite, and you bring a user-first mindset to everything you do — whether designing mobile apps or contributing to product strategy. If you're the type of designer who pushes creative boundaries, communicates clearly, and still knows how to have a little fun in the process — they’d love to hear from you. The Details As a Product Design Contractor, you’ll contribute to a range of client-facing projects, collaborating with the Chief Creative Officer and team across the following areas: - Digital Product Design (Web & App): Shape intuitive experiences by applying research, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs that elevate functionality and user engagement. - User Research & Discovery: Conduct qualitative and quantitative research to inform feature planning and prioritization. Help build products grounded in real user needs and business goals. - User Experience (UX): Apply UX methodologies like journey mapping, user flows, and usability testing to define products beyond UI — ensuring seamless and strategic user experiences. - Visual Design: Lead visual direction on select projects, producing compelling layouts and assets that translate beautifully across platforms — from product to marketing. - Presentation Collateral: Design high-impact presentation decks and visuals that bring ideas to life for clients and stakeholders. - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with engineering and product teams by providing annotated designs, QA support, and input during handoff and development. - Additional Design Support: Contribute to project-related needs like case studies, marketing assets, and content design for social media or internal documentation. Qualifications - 4–6 years of experience in product and visual design, with a strong focus on digital experiences across web and/or mobile - Solid understanding of UX principles, including user research, usability testing, and translating insights into design decisions - Demonstrated ability to own features or tracks of work with minimal oversight — from wireframes to high-fidelity execution - Comfortable leading or contributing to discovery phases and helping define product direction in collaboration with strategy and engineering - Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite, with experience working in a Mac environment - Familiarity with remote collaboration tools such as Google Suite, Slack, Zoom, Jira, and Harvest - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a team-first mindset and the ability to clearly articulate design rationale - Organized, proactive, and able to manage your own time in a fast-paced, remote work environment - Bonus: experience working in client-facing or agency settings where flexibility, autonomy, and cross-functional teamwork are key What to Expect from the Process This is a contract-based role and part of an ongoing effort to build relationships with experienced designers for future client projects. Interviews are being conducted on a rolling basis, and while there may not be immediate openings, strong candidates will be added to the contractor roster and considered as new work becomes available. Hiring timelines are directly tied to the sales pipeline, so project start dates vary. The team is committed to matching the right designer to the right project — and they will reach out when there’s a fit. About the Client This client is a digital product studio that brings together design, technology, and creativity to build meaningful experiences. They believe in pushing boundaries, working collaboratively, and delivering high-quality products that they are proud of. The remote-first culture values autonomy, trust, and open communication. The team is always exploring new ideas, evolving their process, and building products that move the needle for their clients. This position is remote and open to all candidates, but applicants based in New York City are prioritized for potential in-person collaboration. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/rockstar-product-designer

The company's global footprint spans over 35 countries, monitoring over 200 million records daily. About the role As BDR, you will be responsible to make the first contact of prospects via outbound and inbound and generate quality opportunities for the sales force. You will have the chance to focus your attention and efforts on customer acquisition, lead generation, and prospect management, as this role will gather and meet with potential clients. The business development representative will also be responsible to research client business referrals, network, and web leads; provide prospective customers/clients with all services offered and additional presentations as needed, and work with clients to create solutions for their needs and consult throughout the sales process. Identify gaps between prospecting inputs and outputs. ● Effectively execute high-impact trials, meet SLA requirements, and leverage territory heat maps and buyer’s journey to triage target accounts with ABM strategy. ● Understand Simetrik use-cases, relevant workflows/processes, and ways that Simetrik can deliver value. Requirements About you: ● At least 3-4 years of Sales or Sales Development experience. ● Familiarity with sales tools such as Salesforce, Outreach, ZoomInfo, and LinkedIn Navigator to network with potential customers and manage your book of business. ● Demonstrated success in driving outbound prospecting strategy and process to high-level personas and decision-makers to achieve pipeline goals. ● Passion for a career in technology and an ability to speak knowledgeably about the industry. ● Excellent writing and verbal communication skills, with a focus on persuasive messaging and the ability to tailor your communication style to different audiences. ● Strong collaboration skills, particularly in working with Account Executives and cross-functional teams to drive business outcomes. ● Clear communication, a deep sense of empathy, and a commitment to integrity. ● Demonstrated curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making Benefits Benefits ● Competitive compensation packages ● Ample career growth opportunities as we continue rapidly grow ● Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits, creating and collaborating is everyday business. ● Open communication with management and company leadership. ● Small, dynamic teams = massive impact. ● $500 a year for you to invest in learning. ● Unlimited PTO ● 12 holidays Simetrik considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, gender, age, color, religion, national origin, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, protected military/veteran status, or any other legally protected factor. Everyone is welcome! To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/walter-business-development-representative

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote (Within 3 hours of EST timezone preferred) What excites you You want to be early. You like being close to the product, the customer, and the messiness of figuring things out. You enjoy turning sharp customer insight into positioning that actually changes behavior. You care about story-telling. You want to build narratives from launches and words to be thoughtful and useful, not generic or AI slop. You’re energized by hospitality. Hotels are complex, human, and operationally intense. That makes the work interesting, particularly in an age of AI. You want real ownership. If something ships poorly, you fix it. If something lands well, you know exactly why. What excites us You’ve spent 5–7 years in product marketing at a high-growth company, ideally B2B SaaS or complex marketplaces. You can explain technical or operational products in a way that feels simple and grounded. You’ve owned messaging and positioning end to end in close partnership with product, sales, and leadership. You’ve rewritten it when it didn’t work. You’ve led go-to-market for real products, not just features. You know how to scope a launch, make tradeoffs, and ship. You care to measure impact post-launch. You’re not precious about what “typical” PMMs look like. You like wearing different hats and can go beyond product marketing to engage contractors for events planning, or work with an agency to test some ads, when needed. You’re comfortable going deep. Customer calls, sales calls, demos, win-loss. You look for signal, not anecdotes. You’re hands-on. You write the first draft. You build the deck. You partner with design, but you don’t wait on them. Bonus if you’ve worked in hospitality, travel, fintech, or vertical SaaS. Bigger bonus if you genuinely like hotels. Working at Folio We're a remote-first company. Three times a year, we travel to work together in-person and stay with one of our hotel partners. We love experimenting with new tools. For the most part, we rely on Google Meet, Linear, Notion, and Slack to make decisions and get things done day-to-day. You will have the opportunity to travel frequently and meet our customers in person at conferences and events, which you will be helping plan for. We're a small team who work collaboratively and meet daily for stand up What we value Craft . We take pride in our work, find joy in execution, and believe that the best companies are built at a steady yet resilient pace. Optimism . We believe in ourselves and each other and know anything is possible with the right amount of hustle and grit. Ownership . We love making things better and have a strong sense of shared responsibility over everything we create together. Hospitality. The industry we’re building for has a culture of service to others, and we bring that energy to how we work together each day. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/folio-product-marketing-manager

items.description: Design Headquarters: worldwide URL: http://www.brfood.us Senior Remote Team Leader — Accounting, Data & Operations Food Services Inc. — Wholesale meat and restaurant supply distributor based in Los Angeles, California Remote Contractor Position Compensation Starting base compensation: $2,500 USD per month This position includes opportunities for: * Performance bonuses * Responsibility-based increases * Leadership increases * Additional compensation for taking ownership of major business functions A strong performer can grow the base compensation to approximately $3,000 per month within the first year, in addition to applicable performance bonuses. Compensation growth will be based on measurable responsibility, performance, accuracy, leadership, and the ability to independently manage important areas of the business. About the Role: We are looking for a senior-level Accounting & Operations Team Leader who can take ownership of daily workflows, work independently, review the work of others, and turn business data into clear actions and decisions. This is not a basic data-entry position. We are looking for someone who can operate at a top 10% performance level — someone who can analyze, review, identify problems, follow up, and help improve the way the team works. The right person should be comfortable managing both people and data in a fast-moving business environment. Key Responsibilities You will be responsible for helping lead and review daily accounting and operational workflows, including: * Reviewing and analyzing large amounts of business and financial data * Identifying errors, discrepancies, trends, and opportunities * Reviewing team members’ work for accuracy and completion * Purchase Order vs. Vendor Bill analysis * Vendor pricing and quantity discrepancy review * Accounts receivable and customer aging * Vendor aging and accounts payable * Inventory analysis and reconciliation * Price updates and vendor price-list comparisons * Creating and improving Excel reports and tracking systems * Following up on unresolved issues until they are completed * Helping organize team priorities and daily workflow * Communicating clearly with management and team members * Using AI and automation to reduce repetitive work and improve accuracy * Developing better processes, controls, and reporting systems We want someone who does more than complete a task. We expect you to understand the task, review the results, identify what is wrong, and recommend the next action. Required Experience Strong candidates should have professional experience with: * QuickBooks * Microsoft Excel — advanced level * Financial data reconciliation * Data analysis and reporting * Purchase orders and vendor bills * Accounts payable and/or accounts receivable * Reviewing and auditing work for accuracy * Managing multiple priorities * Team leadership or senior-level responsibility * Strong written and spoken English You must also be comfortable working daily with: * Zoom * ClickUp * QuickBooks * Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets * Remote desktop and cloud-based systems AI & Automation Experience We are especially interested in candidates who already understand how to use modern technology to improve their work. Experience with any of the following is highly valued: * ChatGPT or other AI tools * AI-assisted data analysis * Workflow automation * Excel automation * Macros * Automated reporting * Process improvement * Building repeatable systems and procedures You do not need to be a programmer, but you should understand how AI and automation can help a business work faster, more accurately, and with fewer manual steps. Leadership Expectations This is a Team Leader role. You should be able to: * Take ownership without waiting for constant instructions * Review other team members’ work * Identify mistakes before they become larger problems * Prioritize tasks based on business importance * Communicate problems clearly * Follow up until issues are resolved * Train and guide junior team members * Keep management updated with meaningful information * Separate urgent issues from routine tasks * Look for opportunities to improve existing processes We are looking for someone who asks: “What does this data tell us, what is the problem, and what action should we take?” —not simply: “What task should I do next?” Work Schedule Monday through Saturday 8-hour shift per day The position operates according to Pacific Time (Los Angeles), and candidates must be able to work consistently within the assigned schedule. Because this is a remote leadership position, reliability, attendance, responsiveness, and availability during working hours are extremely important. Equipment Requirements You must have a professional remote-work setup capable of supporting all-day Zoom, QuickBooks, remote-hosted environments, Excel, ClickUp, and other business applications simultaneously. Required: * Business-class laptop or desktop * Intel Core i7 / AMD Ryzen 7 or equivalent * 32GB RAM minimum * 1TB NVMe SSD preferred * Dual monitors * Reliable high-speed internet * Wired Ethernet strongly preferred * Quiet and professional workspace Candidate Assessment Before moving forward, qualified candidates will complete a practical assessment. The workbook contains: Sheet 1 — Purchase Order Sheet 2 — Vendor Bill Your assignment is to analyze the two documents and identify the differences, discrepancies, and anything else you believe management should know. Assessment workbook: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1H2UFgxxF1DbBJvoYJFNCnyGY_WsRKqvU/edit?gid=1320818024#gid=1320818024 Assessment Rules 1. Do not delete or modify the original sheets. 2. Preserve all original sheets for audit purposes. 3. Do not convert formulas to values. 4. Your workbook must remain fully auditable. 5. Show your analysis, calculations, and logic inside the Excel file. 6. Do not simply identify differences — demonstrate how you think about the business impact and what should be reviewed or followed up on. How to Apply Email your completed assessment workbook in .xlsx format to: assessments.brfoodus@gmail.com Subject: Assessment Attach the completed Excel file. We are looking for candidates who can demonstrate accuracy, analytical thinking, ownership, leadership, and strong business judgment through their work. Food Services Inc. Los Angeles, California https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1H2UFgxxF1DbBJvoYJFNCnyGY_WsRKqvU/edit?gid=1320818024#gid=1320818024 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/food-service-specialties-back-office-support-1

items.summary: Headquarters: Dire Dawa, Ethiopia URL: http://iisd.org Background The Scaling Urban Nature-based Solutions (NbS) for Climate Adaptation in Sub-Saharan Africa (SUNCASA) is a 3-year project aiming at enhancing climate resilience and promoting gender equality, social inclusion, and biodiversity protection across three cities: Dire Dawa (Ethiopia), Kig
items.description: Design Headquarters: Dire Dawa, Ethiopia URL: http://iisd.org Background The Scaling Urban Nature-based Solutions (NbS) for Climate Adaptation in Sub-Saharan Africa (SUNCASA) is a 3-year project aiming at enhancing climate resilience and promoting gender equality, social inclusion, and biodiversity protection across three cities: Dire Dawa (Ethiopia), Kigali (Rwanda) and Johannesburg (South Africa). Led by the International Institute for Sustainable Development and the World Resources Institute, and implemented in partnership with local organizations and communities, SUNCASA seeks to address climate change impacts—such as floods, landslides, and soil erosion—through gender-responsive and socially inclusive NbS. These include afforestation, reforestation, agroforestry, urban greening, the removal of invasive alien species, and the creation of vegetated buffer zones in flood-prone areas. Entering its third and final year of the current implementation phase, SUNCASA is already achieving significant results, generating measurable adaptation outcomes and strengthening the resilience of communities and landscapes across its project sites. To sustain these achievements beyond the project time frame, SUNCASA is investing in building local ownership and stewardship, with a particular emphasis on engaging children and youth as future custodians of their environments. For more information, visit www.suncasa.org . As part of this effort, SUNCASA is developing a series of four animated videos, with stories and scripts co-created alongside local partners to ensure they reflect community realities, priorities, and cultural contexts. Through engaging storytelling and accessible messages, the animations will encourage young audiences to understand the importance of protecting local ecosystems and livelihoods, recognize their role in sustaining climate adaptation efforts, and contribute to building more resilient and sustainable communities. Purpose of the Consultancy Within the framework of SUNCASA’s Communications Strategy, IISD is seeking an experienced animator or animation studio to conceptualize, design, and produce a series of three animated videos showcasing the project's NbS impacts and highlighting the role of local youth in sustaining these achievements across SUNCASA's three project cities. A fourth animation will focus on promoting the project's gender equality and social inclusion (GESI) approach. Working closely with SUNCASA's Communications team and representatives from the project's local partners, the consultant will be responsible for translating existing scripts into engaging visual narratives through the development of high-quality animations of approximately 2–2.5 minutes each. The videos should communicate the project's approach, results, and impact in a way that is compelling, accessible, and suitable for diverse audiences, with a particular focus on young people. Animations and supporting illustrations must be designed on Adobe Creative Cloud software—After Effects, Illustrator, and InDesign. SUNCASA will provide relevant reference materials—including photographs, videos, project documentation, and brand assets—to inform the visual concept, character design, and storytelling. The animations will be based on scripts co-created with local partners to ensure they authentically reflect the social, cultural, and environmental contexts of each project location. The consultant will be expected to develop a distinctive visual style that resonates with local audiences while maintaining consistency across the animation series. The animations are expected to be developed primarily in English. The SUNCASA Communications team will provide all voiceover and dialogue recordings, including versions in local languages such as Amharic, Afaan Oromo, and Kinyarwanda, which the consultant will integrate into the final productions. The assignment covers the full animation production process, including visual concept development, character and environment design, storyboarding, illustration, animation, editing, and post-production. Final deliverables will include landscape and portrait versions of each animation, optimized for web, social media, and mobile platforms. The consultant will also provide all editable source files—including artwork, illustrations, animation assets, and project files—to allow future adaptation and reuse by the SUNCASA Communications team. The completed animations will support educational and awareness-raising activities led by SUNCASA’s local partners, particularly among children and youth. They will also be disseminated through community WhatsApp and Telegram groups and promoted through SUNCASA’s and partners’ websites and social media channels, helping to expand outreach, strengthen engagement, and reinforce the long-term sustainability of project outcomes. Objectives of the Consultancy General Objective The overall objective of this consultancy is to design and produce a series of four short, animated videos that communicate the achievements and impacts of the SUNCASA project in an engaging and accessible way. This includes three animations highlighting the project’s NbS interventions and their contribution to community and ecosystem resilience across three cities, while one will focus on SUNCASA’s GESI approach. The animations aim to strengthen local ownership and long-term sustainability of project results by engaging children and youth as key audiences. Through culturally relevant storytelling co-developed with local partners, the animations should inspire behavioural change and reinforce the role of youth as key agents of resilience and environmental stewardship. The final products will serve as adaptable communication tools for community outreach, education, and broader dissemination through digital platforms and partner networks. Specific Objectives To design and produce four high-quality animated videos (approximately 2–2.5 minutes each) that communicate SUNCASA’s results, impacts, and approaches in an engaging, accessible, and visually compelling format, particularly to younger audiences. To develop three animations showcasing SUNCASA’s NbS interventions and their contribution to strengthening the resilience of communities and ecosystems across the project’s three cities. To produce one animation highlighting SUNCASA’s GESI approach and its role in promoting inclusive and equitable climate adaptation outcomes. To lead the full animation production process, including visual concept development, character and environment design, storyboarding, illustration, animation, editing, and post-production, in close collaboration with SUNCASA’s Communications team and local partners. To deliver final outputs in both landscape and portrait formats, as well as short versions of each video optimized for social media, along with all editable source files (including artwork, illustrations, animation assets, and project files) to enable future adaptation and reuse by the SUNCASA Communications team. Tasks and Deliverables The consultant will be responsible for leading the full animation production process as outlined below: Activity 1: Inception and Creative Development Review all aesthetics and visual reference materials provided by SUNCASA. Participate in a kickoff meeting with the SUNCASA Communications teams and representatives of the local partner organizations. Develop a creative concept and visual approach aligned with SUNCASA branding and the visual references provided. Prepare a detailed production plan and timeline, including at least three rounds of feedback and the platform on which concepts and drafts will be shared for review. Deliverable 1 : Detailed work plan, including time frame; Creative concept with animation style and visual approach. Activity 2: Storyboards - Based on the co-created scripts provided by the SUNCASA Communications team and informed by the approved creative concept, the consultant will design individual storyboards for each animation. Deliverable 2 : Individual storyboards for each video, with a detailed description of each sequence and scene. Activity 3 : Initial Video Drafts - Following the scripts provided by the SUNCASA Comms team and the approved storyboard, the consultant will develop initial versions of all four animations with no audio and submit them for review. Based on feedback, the updated versions will be created and submitted for approval. - Drafts should include motion graphics, character animations, as well as maps and geographic visualization where applicable. Deliverable 3 : The initial and updated cut of each video animation draft with no audio, including the feedback provided by the team. Activity 4: Final versions of all four animated videos in English and integration of voiceover, dialogues in local languages, as well as soundtrack; create cut-down social media cuts - The consultant will use the approved versions to integrate the voiceover, dialogues, and soundtrack into each animation. - In addition to English, one animation will have a version in Kinyarwanda; and one will have versions in Amharic and Afaan Oromo—translations to be provided by the SUNCASA Communications team. - An additional round of feedback will be required at this stage before approval of the final versions. - In addition to the full animations, the consultant will deliver a cut-down version (30 to 45 seconds) of each video, optimized for social media. Deliverable 4 : A final version of each animation in English with voiceover, dialogues, and soundtrack in local languages, as applicable. A cut-down version of each animation for social media. Activity 5: Submit all editable source files (including artwork, illustrations, animation assets, and project files) - Organize, name, and share all working files, including artwork, illustrations, animation assets, and project files. Deliverable 5 : A folder with all required assets to be shared with the SUNCASA Communications team. Read the full Terms of Reference here for Reporting, Evaluation and Selection Criteria. Consultancy for the Design and Production of Four Animated Videos Showcasing SUNCASA’s Achievements and Inspiring Youth Engagement in Sustaining Project Results Application deadline: August 3, 2026 Application Process All applications must be submitted in English. To apply for this consultancy, please send: Cover Letter outlining relevant professional experience of proposed consultant(s). Please include the name and contact details of the primary contact person. Detailed resume of proposed consultant(s) highlighting relevant experience in all stages of animation production, from creative concept to post-production. Technical Proposal outlining understanding of the assignment and how the consultant(s) plan to undertake the project, including a proposed work plan and timeline. The proposed work plan must align with the deliverables and timeline set out in Sections 4 and 5. Portfolio with at least three examples of relevant animation videos. Please indicate the links to the videos in the technical proposal. Financial Proposal that includes the consultant’s daily rate and any additional costs associated with this assignment, with all costs clearly broken down and aligned to each deliverable and key activities outlined in the Scope of Work. Financial proposals must be aligned with the scope described in Section 5 of this RFP. At least two (2) references from previous related projects. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/iisd-consultancy-for-the-design-and-production-of-four-animated-videos-showcasing-suncasa-s-achievements-and

Our mission is to reinvent the financial services value chain providing technology based mutualized services for financial institutions for non-differentiating services. Our 3 offerings are: Managed Services Consulting & Solutions Technology To know more about Delta Capita and our culture click here: Working at DC - Delta Capita.

items.description: WHY DEPT®? We are pioneers at heart. What this means, is that we are always leaning forward, thinking of what we can create tomorrow that does not exist today. We were born digital and we are a new model of agency, with a deep skillset in tech and marketing. That’s why we hire curious, self-driven, talented people who never stop innovating. Our culture is big enough to cope and small enough to care. Meaning, that with people across 20+ countries, we’re big enough to provide you with the best tools, global opportunities, and benefits that help you thrive. While acting small by investing in you, your growth, your team, and giving you the autonomy to solve our clients’ problems, no matter where you are in the world. ABOUT YOU The Group Director, Client Partnerships — Growth & Media is a senior client and commercial leader at DEPT®, responsible for building consequential relationships, growing our clients’ businesses, and bringing the right combination of media, creative, data and technology together around their biggest opportunities. This is not a traditional account-management role. We’re looking for someone who has helped high-growth businesses go from uncertainty to signal to scale — someone who understands what it means to build a growth system when the audience, message, channel mix and even category may still be taking shape. The immediate opportunity includes partnering with one of the most ambitious emerging companies in consumer AI, where success will require moving rapidly from early market learning through scaled acquisition and launch. More broadly, you will help shape DEPT®’s growing portfolio of commerce and technology clients. Ideal candidates will be: Proven leaders in startup, scale-up or high-growth consumer businesses, with meaningful experience in technology, AI, hardware, marketplaces, DTC or adjacent categories. Deeply fluent in modern growth media across paid social, search, programmatic/video, creators and emerging channels. Comfortable building a growth engine from the ground up — measurement, audiences, experimentation, creative learning, acquisition and scale. Commercial thinkers who understand CAC, LTV, conversion, attribution, incrementality, and how media ultimately connects to enterprise value. Equally comfortable discussing brand building and performance, and able to help clients understand how the two reinforce one another. Strong executive partners who can operate effectively with founders, CMOs, growth leaders and senior investors/stakeholders. Naturally curious about technology and consumer behavior, including the rapidly evolving impact of AI on discovery, media and marketing. Able to move quickly with incomplete information without becoming reckless or superficial. Collaborative leaders who know when to lead, when to challenge and when to bring specialist expertise into the room. What you’ll do: Own senior client relationships and overall commercial success across a portfolio of high-growth accounts. Serve as a strategic business partner, helping clients decide where and how to invest rather than simply managing an agreed scope. Lead clients from early testing and market learning through scaled acquisition and full-funnel growth. Partner with media, creative, strategy, data and technology leaders to build integrated growth systems. Ensure measurement and learning agendas are built into the work from the beginning. Connect media performance to broader business outcomes, including customer acquisition, retention, revenue and lifetime value. Identify and shape organic growth opportunities before they become formal briefs. Lead commercial planning including scopes, staffing models, forecasting, profitability and account investment decisions. Create clarity across fast-moving multidisciplinary teams and ensure DEPT® feels like one integrated partner to the client. Contribute actively to new business, especially opportunities involving growth, emerging technology and consumer transformation. Mentor Client Partners and Directors across the organization and help evolve DEPT®’s standard for modern client leadership. What you’ll bring: 10+ years of relevant agency, consultancy, startup or client-side experience. Significant experience leading large or strategically important client relationships. Demonstrated success growing early-stage or rapidly scaling businesses through media and marketing. Strong understanding of performance marketing, measurement, experimentation and full-funnel growth. Experience working across meaningful media budgets and scaling investment based on demonstrated signal. Proven commercial ownership including scoping, negotiation, forecasting and account growth. Exceptional communication, presentation and executive storytelling skills. A track record of building trust quickly in complex, high-pressure environments. Meaningful contribution to organic growth and/or new business. The ability to understand specialist disciplines deeply enough to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions and connect them around a business problem. WHAT DO WE OFFER? We are a collaborative, open-door, best-idea-wins environment that fosters personal and company growth and has fun doing it. Here is a snapshot of our benefits package: Healthcare, Dental, and Vision coverage 401k plan, plus matching PTO Paid Company Holidays Parental Leave WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU: DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s identity, background, beliefs, lifestyle or disabilities. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step. DEPT® participates in E-Verify, meaning your Form I-9 information will be sent to the federal government to confirm you are authorized to work in the U.S. We are a B Corp-certified company passionate about purpose-driven work. Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place. DEPT® is a pioneering technology and marketing services company that creates integrated end-to-end digital experiences for brands such as Google, KFC, Philips, Audi, Twitch, Patagonia, eBay and more. Its team of 2,500+ digital specialists across 30+ locations on 5 continents delivers pioneering work on a global scale with a boutique culture. Learn more about DEPT® DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives. Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine. We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us. Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts here . #LI-Remote The anticipated salary range for this position is listed below. Salary is based on a range of factors that include relevant experience, expertise, physical location , and organizational impact. This is based on a 40-hour workweek and leveling. Keep in mind, we’re flexible. US Remote Range $150,000—$195,000 USD

items.description: Company Description About us: Passion for food. Hunger for tech. We make METRO digital. Today technology is driving the world. And at METRO.digital we are driving the technology for one of the leading international wholesalers specializing in food - METRO. From e-commerce to checkout, to delivery software, we work on a wide range of products to make each day a success for our customers and colleagues. With passion and ownership, we build the future of wholesale. You are driving to create smart solutions for customers around the globe? You want to grow in a flexible environment? Let the right career opportunity find you and join us! How you will make an impact? We are looking for an AI Business Consultant to serve as a strategic bridge between business and technology, driving the adoption and successful integration of AI and automation solutions across our organization. In this role, you will act as the key translator between AI & Automation strategy and business needs, ensuring that solutions are aligned with METRO’s overall vision. You will engage with stakeholders to identify, assess, and prioritize high-impact AI and automation use cases using data-driven ROI metrics and consult them to unlock the potential of AI and automation. Develop clear requirements, user stories, and value cases that adhere to AI Platform standards and strategic priorities. Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including Research, Tech, and Business—to design user-centric, data-driven solutions and guide their implementation. This position offers a dynamic opportunity to shape the future of wholesale by leveraging your expertise to deliver measurable business value through intelligent automation. Job Description Your Responsibilities: Being the translator of AI & Automation Strategy to business and back to the AIA Platform and consult the organization to unlock the potential of AI & Automation; Engage with business stakeholders to identify and prioritize potential AI and Automation use cases based on ROI metrics; Facilitate workshops, interviews, and data-driven assessments across METRO organization, to define value propositions and feasibility for the use cases; Translate business needs into actionable requirements, user stories, and value cases aligned with platform standards; Ensure alignment of identified opportunities with strategic AI themes and portfolio priorities in line with AI Strategy; Partner the Squad Lead on roadmap planning, backlog prioritization, and sprint readiness; support agile delivery and stakeholder management; Partner with AIA Platform leadership team, to ensure consistency from ideation to benefit tracking. Support KPI definition, value measurement, and quarterly reporting (QBRs); Act as a local AI ambassador within the squad’s domain, promoting adoption and responsible use of AI solutions; Support rollout, training, and communication of new AI and automation products. Qualifications Required key competencies and qualifications: Subject Matter Expertise: Understands well its area of responsibility (AI & Automation), all related systems, processes and products; Discovery : Conducts qualitative and quantitative research with the support of the Research team. Applies the right methodologies to find out relevant information about the user and their problems and needs; Data Driven Decision making : Number driven business opportunities identification, be able to set up value measurement concepts and interpret results from econometrically point of view; Consultancy : Understands the demands of the internal client, selects and explains the right solution. With the proactive behavior, being always a helping hand to solve with cutting-edge technology and bring new ideas to the stakeholder: One more thing mindset; Business Requirements Analysis: Analyses the business requirements and transforms them into AI & Automation opportunities; Communication : Conveys or shares ideas, feelings and information effectively using the most appropriate methods, tools and channels for the respective audience. Good verbal, written and inter-personal communication skills. Very good fluency in English (written and verbal); Process Architecture: Understands the big picture of AI & Automation product portfolio, how it first in METRO´s solution landscape and knows how it supports METRO’s strategy, objectives and their measurement. Additional Information What we offer at METRO.digital? Hybrid and agile work: thrive in a flexible, multicultural environment. At METRO.digital, we promote work-life balance through a hybrid working model. You’ll be part of self-organizing, multicultural teams that collaborate in an agile setup. People development: when you grow so do we! We want you to become the best version of yourself with individual and company-wide programs and trainings for people development. Focused among other on development, leadership, appreciation … it´s time to upskill your career. Support with individual solutions: we are people-caring! We offer support whenever you need it - at every stage of your professional journey. Want to know more about all our benefits? Discover more here. Let´s connect soon. Apply for the role now! Position grade within our career framework: AI Consultant (Md7).

items.summary: Lead Stylist (m/f/x) The role As Lead Stylist at HelloFresh, you will play a key leadership role in shaping the visual identity of our food content across recipe photography, brand campaigns, and multimedia channels. You’ll lead a team of talented food and set stylists, fostering a collaborative, high-performing studio environment that balances cre
items.description: Lead Stylist (m/f/x) The role As Lead Stylist at HelloFresh, you will play a key leadership role in shaping the visual identity of our food content across recipe photography, brand campaigns, and multimedia channels. You’ll lead a team of talented food and set stylists, fostering a collaborative, high-performing studio environment that balances creativity, quality, and efficiency. This is both a strategic and people-focused role. You’ll be responsible for managing the day-to-day operations of the styling team, mentoring individuals in their growth, and driving forward the creative vision and standards of the studio in close partnership with Art Direction, Photography teams and Production. Your focus will be on empowering your team and ensuring our content remains visually compelling and consistently on-brand. At HelloFresh, we value diverse experiences and encourage candidates from a range of creative backgrounds to apply — even if you don’t meet every listed requirement. What you’ll do Lead, manage, and develop a team of stylists, providing regular feedback, coaching, and clear growth pathways Oversee the styling function across all studio productions, ensuring team resourcing, performance, and creative standards are aligned with business needs Own and evolve the studio’s styling vision, processes, and best practices, ensuring consistency and innovation across all content formats and platforms Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams — including Art Directors, photographers, culinary teams, and producers — to deliver exceptional, on-brand content Balance hands-on involvement with strategic leadership, stepping into high-visibility shoots when needed and guiding the team on complex or evolving projects Lead trend research and visual ideation, helping to drive the creative direction of our food styling while staying ahead of industry movements Ensure team performance against creative, operational, and delivery targets, while fostering a positive, inclusive, and solutions-oriented studio culture What You’ll Bring 7+ years of professional experience in food styling, creative direction, or studio production — with at least 2+ years in a leadership or people management role A proven track record of leading styling teams and delivering high-quality, brand-aligned content in a fast-paced creative or production environment A strong portfolio showcasing high-level styling skills, conceptual thinking, and an ability to elevate content through design and detail Deep expertise in food styling techniques, with a strong understanding of composition, texture, and color in visual storytelling Excellent people management and leadership skills, with experience in mentoring, conflict resolution, and team development A collaborative, calm, and proactive approach — with strong communication and project management skills Passion for food, photography, seasonal trends, and brand-building through visual identity A mindset focused on scaling teams and workflows sustainably, while continuously improving creative quality and studio output What we offer Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe’s fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion. Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities. Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model. Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals. Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy. Plus, we’ve got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24 ⁄ 7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it’s a lifestyle of perks and possibilities! About HelloFresh HelloFresh is on a mission to change the way people eat, forever! Since our 2011 founding in Europe’s vibrant tech hub, Berlin, we’ve become the world’s leading meal kit provider, delivering to over 4.2 million households worldwide in 15 countries across 3 continents. We will encourage you to make an immediate impact in your area of work as well as empower you to grow your career with us.

This position is a remote, work-from-home, full-time role. We've written this as a junior-to-mid-level job description because that's where most great people start on our team. But if you're more seasoned — comfortable in identity, MDM, or security work — don't scroll past. We'd be delighted to find someone who can step in higher up the ladder, and we'll happily talk about a more senior scope and comp if that's you. What the actual job??? Unlike many IT shops, we believe that the technology is the tactic. The actual job is making people feel taken care of. One of our core values is “49% tech support, 51% human support.” You'll succeed by configuring devices, resetting access, untangling email, and chasing down the gremlin that's been haunting someone's conference room. But you'll know you succeeded when a client exhales and says, “Thank goodness you're on it!” That Warm Fuzzy Feeling™ is the actual product. The green lights on the dashboard are just how we get there. In a typical week, you might: Onboard a new hire at a fast-growing startup: provision their Mac, set up their Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 accounts, enroll the device in MDM, and make sure day one feels effortless. Offboard a departing employee cleanly — recover the laptop, revoke access, and close the loop so nothing's left dangling. All boxes checked, ticket notated and closed, client followed up with. Field a "my email stopped working" ticket that turns out to be a DNS thing, a phishing-filter thing, or a "they changed their password on their phone three weeks ago" thing. Help a family office or RIA get a touchy Zoom Room or conference-room AV setup behaving before a meeting — over the phone. Triage the queue so phones get answered fast, emails don't rot, and nobody feels forgotten — even when the honest answer is, “We're on it, but here's the realistic timeline." ⠀ You'll be the front line: helping with what you can, researching what you can't, and pinging the rest of the team when you're genuinely stuck. That last part is a skill, not a weakness — knowing when to ask is half the job. About ignitionit.com We're one of the oldest Apple Technical Partners on the planet, and one of the only certified Apple Premier Partners — that’s kinda like getting knighted by the ghost of Steve Jobs. We started where you’d expect to find Macs (creative agencies, non-profits, education) but our primary clients today are cutting-edge, venture-backed AI SaaS startups, VC and private equity firms, registered investment advisors — many of them operating under stringent compliance expectations (SOC 2, SEC). That means we hold ourselves to a higher standard than the scrappy shop we started as. Polished, reliable, security-minded work is the baseline now — but always with a smile! What hasn't changed: relationships are still our most valuable currency — with clients, with vendors, and with each other. We're a tight, supportive team. We teach each other what we know, cover for each other when life throws a punch, and care a little too much about doing things the right way. We're still a bit weird, and our clients seem to like us that way. We move fast, priorities shift, it’s not always documented (whatever it is), our tool set and list of supported platforms is sprawling, and some days the to-do list is longer than you'd like. If you can stay warm under pressure, create order out of chaos, learn new stuff fast because you love it, and speak up when you need help, you'll thrive here. If you need a rigid, fully-documented, never-changes environment where nobody trusts you with admin access, where you will be micro-managed so you never have to wonder whether or not you’re doing the right thing, this isn't it. You’ll have a ton of independence on our team, and freedom to use your best judgment to get the ball over the finish line, but that also means we expect you to be naturally responsible, honest, and highly accountable — to yourself, your teammates, and the clients. As they say, the price of freedom is eternal vigilance. The tech you'll work with (and grow into) Day one, you'll be living in: Apple at the core — macOS, iOS, Apple Business Manager, and MDM (Jamf / Iru / Intune / Workspace ONE / and more) Yes, PCs too — about one-third of our users are driving Windows Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 admin consoles Identity and access — SSO, MFA, and security keys (Okta, Entra ID, Yubikey, and friends) Lots of other security tools — our stack is constantly evolving and may vary from client to client The everyday productivity stack — Slack, Zoom, conference-room AV, networking basics (Meraki), and endpoint tooling ⠀ You don't need to know all of this. You need to be the kind of person who wants to. As you grow, there's a clear path into infrastructure administration, project architecture and implementation, and — for the right person — security and compliance work (phishing simulations, endpoint detection, SOC 2 / CIS / SEC readiness, due diligence questionnaire support, etc.). That's where our most senior people live, and it's wide open. Who we hope you are The hard requirements — we won't move forward unless you: Can work standard business hours in Eastern or Pacific time zones (we currently need both) Have a quiet home workspace and reliable broadband Have proven Apple aptitude — you actually use and like the Apple ecosystem Have at least 2 years of IT support experience on the job. Go-getters who are just getting started and can prove they have a deep, demonstrable history of teaching themselves technology for the sheer joy of it might also make the cut. ⠀ Everything else — and this is the longer list, on purpose. We figure technical skills are teachable; character takes a lot longer. So we're looking for someone who: Genuinely cares — about clients, teammates, and doing right by people Loves to learn, and proves it in how they spend their time Reads, and writes clearly — clear writing is clear thinking, and you'll do a lot of it Stays calm and kind with a frustrated person on the other end of the line Can tell the difference between good customer service and fantastic customer service, and refuses to settle for the former Notices when something's being done inefficiently and fixes it (you may boast about it later, that’s fine) Proofreads their own work (yes, we noticed whether you proofread your application) Has a sense of humor, and doesn't take themselves too seriously Regarding AI Our company founder/CEO is headquartered in the Bay Area. We work with innovative, ambitious companies developing AI products. Our team members hold a range of opinions about whether AI is “good or bad” for humans, but at the end of the day, we embrace the plain fact that it is here, we must embrace it to evolve, and our clients increasingly depend on us to help them embrace it, too, to help them evolve and stay competitive. Our CEO's opinion: AI will not replace human labor any time soon; rather, AI is a new opportunity to either (a) get things done faster, or (b) get a much higher quality of output than before. If you’re an AI tinkerer, great! We want to hear how you’re using it and see your latest vibe project. If you’re allergic to AI or have no interest in learning new habits to work effectively with it, this is not the place for you. Compensation & logistics Base salary: For applicants closer to the junior side who are located in the USA, $50,000–$65,000/yr, depending on experience level and your local geographical price index. With experience, comp goes up from there. Genuinely experienced, more senior candidates can be slotted higher — let's talk. Applicants outside the USA will be compensated according to your local employment market. Type & location: Full-time, work from home, fully remote. Eastern or Pacific time zones. Benefits: Medical / dental / vision for the employee, 401(k) with employer contribution, 2 weeks of PTO annually to start, and a stipend for your home internet. How to apply The first step is really easy and only takes 10 minutes — no resume, no cover letter, no essays. Here's how: Take this online Culture Index assessment (about 10 minutes): We use it to screen for people whose natural wiring fits how our team works. If your profile lines up with what we're looking for, we'll reach out and ask you to complete a 60-minute TestGorilla assessment for critical thinking skills, send us your resume, and maybe a couple of other items. From there, we conduct between 2-4 video interviews. One of these might be a live technical assessment. If the Culture Index step feels like a strange way to start a job application — that's kind of the point. Remember the phrase Think Different? Ignition is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and will consider all qualified applicants. Good luck in your search — and may the Force be with you! To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ignition-inc-mac-msp-help-desk-guru-work-from-home

We help companies of all sizes build intelligent applications by combining expertise in data, cloud, and AI . Our talented AI developers are trusted to deliver Top AI Development services in Generative AI , intelligent automation, and custom machine learning solutions. At Azumo , we believe in professional and personal growth. As a recognized AI Development company , we support our engineers in mastering the latest technologies and delivering Top AI Development services worldwide. Our culture emphasizes collaboration, continuous learning, and solving complex problems with modern AI solutions. We believe in giving back to our community and will volunteer our time to philanthropy, open-source initiatives and sharing our knowledge. If you are qualified for the opportunity and looking for a challenge please apply online at Azumo/join-our-team or connect with us at people@azumo.co To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/azumo-data-engineer-latin-america

items.summary: Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale. With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to…
items.description: Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale. With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions. Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost. We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. The Opportunity: At Grafana Labs, we’re redefining what post-sales technical partnership looks like—and it starts with the Observability Architect . This is a role for deeply technical experts who are ready to step into strategic leadership with our most important customers. If you thrive at the intersection of systems thinking, architecture design, and customer impact—this is your stage. As an Observability Architect, you will be the technical owner of long-term customer success. You’ll architect and guide the implementation of complex observability solutions across a wide range of modern infrastructure and application environments. You’ll build strategic relationships with engineers, SREs, and architects—ensuring Grafana’s technology is not just deployed, but deeply embedded into mission-critical systems. Working hand-in-hand with our Engagement Managers, you’ll lead technical discovery, design, onboarding, and enablement—all with a focus on delivering tangible outcomes. You’ll spot patterns, solve hard problems, and guide customers through their observability maturity curve with authority and clarity. You’ll also represent the technical voice of our customers internally—shaping product feedback and roadmap priorities by working closely with Engineering and Product Management. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for those who want to go deep, stay technical, and directly influence customer success at scale. Join us and become part of the most respected observability team in the industry. What You'll Be Doing: Serve as the primary technical point of contact for a portfolio of Grafana customers. Design the observability maturity journey of customers and assist them on that path. Provide expert-level troubleshooting and guidance to drive adoption. Conduct regular technical reviews and health checks to ensure client success. Assist in RCA to understand issues that affect customer satisfaction, retention, and overall product experience. Advise clients on best practices and strategies for leveraging our technology to achieve their business goals Collaborate with clients to develop and execute technical roadmaps. Identify opportunities for clients to optimize their cost, expand their use of our solutions and drive adoption of new products and features. Develop and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key stakeholders. With the support of our Engagement Managers and Onboarding Solutions Architects, own customer lifecycle. Drive the adoption and effective use of our product suite within your customer portfolio to maximize their value from our platform and ensure a strong return on investment. Act as the voice of the customer within the company, advocating for their needs, priorities and feature requests. Conduct training sessions and workshops to educate clients on our technology. Develop and deliver technical documentation, guides, and tutorials. Work alongside account teams to participate in and/or conduct regular reviews with customers to identify areas for improvement, calculate ROI, assess their satisfaction, and discuss upcoming needs and projects. Prepare and present reports on client metrics, achievements, and areas of focus. What Makes You a Great Fit: Located on the West Coast Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Math or a related field (or equivalent experience). Experience deploying and operating Kubernetes. 5+ years of experience in a technical support, technical account management, consulting, SE or Professional Services role within the technology industry. Strong understanding of observability solutions. Grafana, Prometheus, and Loki a plus. Proven ability to manage multiple clients and projects simultaneously. Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills. Experience with relevant tools and technologies, e.g., CRM software, ticketing systems, specific programming languages. Ability to travel as needed to meet with clients (up to 25%). Identify and provide timely workarounds and solutions to meet a customer’s business needs. You have some observability expertise, preferably architect level First class written and oral communication skills to collaborate with our remote-first internal teams and with our worldwide customers. Ability to articulate our value proposition and the technical advantages of our products You will love solving technical challenges and thrive on bringing creative solutions to our customers Bonus Points For: 2+ years of technical sales, TAM or other post sales technical experience, ideally with open source technologies, or in the observability space. Great at connecting product usage to value (ROI). Great at managing customer lifecycle. You will be creative in solving customer adoption challenges. You can proactively assist customers with technical issues that may arise and assist in the troubleshooting and root cause analysis. You should have a technical mindset and a desire to grow technically. Great candidates may be a recent grad of a coding bootcamp or have previous post-sales or engineering experience–we are excited to see what unique experiences and skill sets you bring to the table! In the US, the OTE compensation range for this role is $139,000 - $167,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow. Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings. #LI-Remote For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy .

items.title: 1224SA - 377TEL | Project Accounting Specialist
items.summary: Telaid has been delivering technology deployment solutions to multi-site companies for over 37 years.
items.description: Telaid has been delivering technology deployment solutions to multi-site companies for over 37 years. We are a growing, privately held company looking for a dedicated Project Accounting Specialist to join our team. If you’re a detail-oriented finance professional who thrives in collaborative environments, loves improving processes, and is passionate about achieving financial goals, this opportunity is for you! Position Overview: As a Project Accounting Specialist , you will play a critical role in managing project finances, ensuring accuracy in billing and reporting, and supporting internal teams and external clients. This role is integral to Telaid’s commitment to reducing the time, task, risk, and cost of technology deployments. Key Responsibilities: Collaborate with Project Managers to gather timely and accurate information for monthly billings. Input project budgets and billing information into financial systems proactively. Generate invoices using various software and resolve billing-related issues with customers. Apply payments to customer accounts and reconcile discrepancies. Review credit reports for new customers to establish credit limits. Prepare periodic reports using accounting software. Participate in regular project review meetings to analyze financial performance and trends. Research and respond to inquiries from the Project Management Team regarding project costs and revenues. Develop project financial templates and support client onboarding to ensure smooth submission processes. Perform client submission verifications and address issues related to aging balances, escalating when necessary. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve billing and account-related discrepancies. Qualifications: High School Diploma or equivalent (Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred). Minimum of 2 years of experience in billing and collections. Strong communication, problem-solving, and analytical skills. Detail-oriented with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, multitasking environment. Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel. Experience with Crystal Reports and Microsoft Power BI is a plus. Familiarity with ERP systems and project accounting environments is desirable. Why Join Telaid? Be part of a company that values collaboration, innovation, and process improvement. Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely while contributing to impactful technology deployment projects. Work with a supportive team and develop your skills in a dynamic, growth-oriented environment. If you’re ready to make a difference and grow your career with Telaid, we’d love to hear from you! Apply today to join our mission of delivering excellence in technology deployments. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Media Buyer TG
items.summary: Our client is an international product-based IT company specializing in the iGaming industry, with its own affiliate program and in-house products in online casino, betting, and poker.
items.description: Our client is an international product-based IT company specializing in the iGaming industry, with its own affiliate program and in-house products in online casino, betting, and poker. The company has been successfully operating for more than 12 years, building strong positions in the CIS market while continuing global growth and expansion. We are currently looking for an Media Buyer TG. 📋 Key responsibilities and your contribution: Build and develop the Telegram Ads traffic source from scratch; Launch, test, optimize, and scale profitable advertising campaigns; Research and validate new approaches, creatives, funnels, and traffic strategies; Analyze campaign performance and continuously improve key metrics; Work closely with product, analytics, design, and marketing teams; Manage advertising budgets efficiently while maintaining profitability; Build a knowledge base of successful approaches and continuously optimize workflows; Monitor Telegram Ads updates, market trends, and competitor activities; Play a key role in growing the new direction with the opportunity to become a Team Lead as the team expands. 📚 Your qualifications: 3+ years of experience in media buying, including at least 1 year of hands-on experience with Telegram Ads; Proven experience in Gambling/iGaming traffic acquisition; Strong understanding of the Telegram Ads ecosystem, traffic sources, and campaign optimization; Experience launching, testing, and scaling campaigns from scratch; Ability to analyze key performance metrics (ROI, CPA, CR, CTR, CPM, PnL) and make data-driven decisions; Experience working with analytics and tracking tools (Keitaro, Binom, Voluum, Google Sheets, Power BI, etc.); Experience managing monthly advertising budgets starting from $50K; Understanding of affiliate offers, agency accounts, and Telegram Ads infrastructure; Strong analytical mindset and willingness to experiment with new approaches; Ability to work independently, take ownership, and build processes from the ground up. ➕ Nice to have: Experience working with CIS GEOs; Experience building Telegram funnels using bots, mini apps, or custom landing flows;
