items.title: STAQ Director
items.summary: At EQT, you won't just do a job—you'll help shape our future.
items.description: At EQT, you won't just do a job—you'll help shape our future. Through Transparent Leadership, you'll work alongside leaders who value collaboration and ensure every voice is heard. Through Connected Impact, you'll see how your work influences critical business decisions and drives value across our operations. Through Supported Growth, you'll have opportunities to expand your skills through cross-functional collaboration, development opportunities, and career advancement. Join our Qrew! Position Objective The Director, STAQ leads the team responsible for EQT’s Special Project Case (SPC) pipeline — the “Innovation Engine” that turns business ideas into delivered technology and process improvements. The role owns intake, prioritization, scoping, solution-architecture governance, and value realization across a portfolio that serves every EQT business department. The ideal candidate is a delivery-minded leader who is comfortable with technical projects and oil & gas business applications, sets clear priorities against finite capacity, and builds a high-performing team and a culture of continuous improvement. Essential Duties Strategy & portfolio: Develop and maintain the STAQ strategy — project prioritization frameworks, value-realization tracking, and portfolio management — so EQT focuses on its highest-value initiatives. Pipeline ownership: Own the SPC pipeline end to end — intake, triage, scoping, prioritization, development hand-off to IT delivery teams, documentation, and post-implementation lookback. Cross-functional governance: Lead recurring cross-functional Special Project Reviews with business departments and internal team standups and architecture-collaboration sessions to align priorities and unblock delivery. Architecture & quality: Govern solution architecture and data-quality standards so the pipeline stays reliable, fast, supported, valuable, and clean (the Innovation Engine scorecard). People leadership: Lead, coach, and develop the STAQ team (Business Process Operations Manager and Business Process Engineers); foster a culture of innovation, experimentation, and continuous improvement. Budget & capacity: Develop and manage the STAQ budget and capacity plan; balance incoming demand against the standing backlog and available staffing. Stakeholder alignment: Communicate with executive and cross-functional stakeholders to align department portfolios, delivery priorities, and enterprise strategy; steward STAQ’s knowledge base and operating standards. Continuous improvement: Research and evaluate emerging technologies (automation, analytics) for business applicability and pursue continuous improvement of the pipeline and its supporting infrastructure. Minimum Qualifications 8+ years of combined experience in technology delivery, business operations, and/or process improvement, including team leadership Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a technical or quantitative field (e.g., Engineering, Computer/Data Science, Information Systems, or Business). An engineering degree is beneficial but not required. Experience delivering technology programs or products from inception through delivery to post-launch. Demonstrated ability to gather requirements, define project scope, and translate business needs into technical solutions. Demonstrated understanding of data structures, analytics, and solution architecture (conceptual fluency required; hands-on engineering not required). Proven ability to coordinate, organize, lead, and develop teams, and to manage competing priorities across many stakeholders. Comfort working on technical projects and with oil & gas business applications, with a strong understanding of how the business works. Strong executive communication and stakeholder-management skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience developing or leading Salesforce-based business processes and custom solutions. Experience with data tools, pipelines, and analytics platforms (e.g., Power BI, Databricks). Engineering and/or operational experience in the oil & gas industry (beneficial, not required). Experience leading a portfolio, delivery, or business-process function. Familiarity with EQT’s “Way We Work” operating model (Programs, Utilities, Insights, Sessions, and Knowledge). Selected incumbent will be placed into the position that best suits their abilities and experience level. EQT Corporation and its subsidiaries is an Equal Opportunity Employer -- Disabilities/Veterans. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Company Description Our client is a media and marketing agency currently transitioning the media business for a national, multi-location home services brand with more than 40 local markets and an established, sizable media investment. Duration: ~2 month project Location: Remote Hours/wk: 25-30 hours/week Hourly Rate: $80-90/hr Job Description We need a senior, hands-on media strategist to audit the inherited plan and recommend the right local, regional, and national architecture, centered on video and measurable business outcomes. This person will embed as part of the client team, personally conduct the analysis, lead client conversations, and turn the findings into an executable transition plan without disrupting current sales. Responsibilities Audit the existing plan by market and channel, identifying where investment, lead volume, appointments, cost of acquisition, and sales are misaligned. Design the appropriate local, regional, and national structure across linear TV, CTV/OTT and video, paid search, and Meta, including where pooled buying improves or obscures local performance. Evaluate market-level video pressure through GRPs, reach and frequency, flighting, inventory quality, premium and direct-response placements, and targeted heavy-ups. Reconcile quarterly MMM; weekly branch-and-channel outcomes; daily lead and call-center signals; last-click reporting; Google Analytics; Meta; and Switch Growth conversion data. Build a staged test-and-transition roadmap that protects lead flow and sales, clearly separating immediate changes from longer-term optimization. Lead decision-oriented discussions for analytical marketing leaders and founder/franchise operators, while working constructively with incumbent and activation partners. Qualifications Platforms + Measurement Products Preferred: Google Analytics; Google Ads/paid search; Meta; Switch Growth or similar conversion feedback; MMM; and TV attribution. Candidates should connect these signals to leads, appointments, acquisition cost, and sales by market. Qualifications Deep local broadcast and video planning experience , paired with strong working knowledge of paid search and paid social. Experience with multi-location, franchise, dealer, or branch-based businesses where media must deliver market-level outcomes. Experience with high-consideration, appointment-driven or offline sales journeys; home improvement or home services is valuable but not required. A track record of inheriting a live plan, testing changes in stages, and improving the strategy without putting near-term revenue at risk. Comfort personally conducting the analysis, building the recommendation, and guiding both analytically sophisticated marketers and commercially focused operators. Key Characteristics Pedigree: Senior local broadcast and video media strategy background, ideally agency side, with experience inheriting and improving live media plans for multi-location businesses. Passion: Energized by digging into a live, complex plan and turning ambiguity into a clear, defensible strategy. Potential: Can operate independently as a true embedded strategist, credible with both analytically sophisticated marketers and commercially focused franchise or branch operators. Play: Low-ego and hands-on, comfortable presenting hard truths about an inherited plan while working constructively with incumbent partners. Successful Delivery of the Scope A decision-ready market and channel diagnostic, recommended media architecture, and prioritized test-and-transition roadmap that improves local accountability, preserves lead and sales continuity, and gives activation teams a clear path forward. Additional Information We Are Rosie provides strategic consulting and talent solutions for the marketing industry. We partner with more than 200 of the world’s biggest brands and agencies to help them solve unique marketing challenges with the best people, swiftly and at scale. Founded by former advertising executive Stephanie Nadi Olson in 2018, We Are Rosie is on a mission to redefine how marketing works, with an inclusive, human-centric approach that’s better for business and better for marketers. Our company has been recognized as an industry trailblazer and earned many accolades, including being named to the 2023 Global Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces, the Inc. 5000 2022, and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Agencies in 2021. We Are Rosie is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical​​​ condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or ​expression, veteran status, marital status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

items.summary: Job Title: Medical Director, Clinical Program Design Job Location (Remote): Remote, USA About the Company Wheel is evolving the traditional care ecosystem by equipping the nation's most innovative companies with a premier platform to deliver high-quality virtual care at scale. We offer proven strategies and cutting-edge technologies to foster consumer engagement, build brand loyalty, and…
items.description: Job Title: Medical Director, Clinical Program Design Job Location (Remote): Remote, USA About the Company Wheel is evolving the traditional care ecosystem by equipping the nation's most innovative companies with a premier platform to deliver high-quality virtual care at scale. We offer proven strategies and cutting-edge technologies to foster consumer engagement, build brand loyalty, and maximize return on investment. Wheel solutions include configurable virtual care programs, an intuitive consumer interface, and access to a nationwide network of board-certified clinicians. Discover how Wheel is transforming the future of healthcare by visiting www.wheel.com . About the Role We're hiring a Medical Director to own the protocols driving our virtual on-demand, urgent, and convenience care lines. You'll also lead and scale the QA program that measures their success. It's fast-moving work inside a practice built with modern, AI-powered tools. What You’ll Do Care protocols. Write, update, and refine the clinical protocols behind Wheel's care programs. Integrate them across all our partners, scale them effectively, and translate them into the logic our platform runs on. Quality Assurance. Lead Wheel's clinical QA program. Integrate AI to enable further scale, and turn its findings into feedback the network can act on. Outcomes and iteration. Develop the frameworks and procedures that track patient and clinical outcomes across these care programs, and use that data to improve care over time. Patient safety. Manage clinical patient-safety escalation protocols and active escalations, keeping Wheel's clinical standards consistent and on target. Who You Are MD or DO from an accredited institution, board-certified in Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, or Emergency Medicine. Primary care experience preferred. Substantial clinical practice experience, including virtual care or telemedicine. Prior clinical leadership experience managing teams directly in telehealth, digital health, or a high-volume virtual practice. Hands-on experience with clinical quality assurance — building, running, or auditing a QA program. Experience authoring and maintaining clinical protocols. Basic proficiency with AI tools & software You're energized by where medicine is heading — new evidence, new modalities, new models of care — and you want to help build the next version of it. You want to work closely with product and engineering as clinical tooling gets built. You reach for the data. You're at home reasoning from dashboards, cohorts, and outcomes, and you'd rather measure than guess. Active medical license in good standing in one or more states. Able to pass NCQA credentialing and Wheel's standardized background checks. Nice to have Don't let these stand in your way—they’re just added bonuses! If you meet most of the core requirements, we encourage you to apply. Experience integrating AI or automation into clinical quality or protocol workflows. Comfort with EHR configuration, clinical decision support, or point-of-care tooling. Multi-state licensure. ABOM Certification or expertise in cardio-metabolic conditions. Salary and Perks Pay Range: $250,000 - $290,000 plus a 15% bonus. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations. Wheel is unable to consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position. As an employee of Wheel, you’ll enjoy our Total Rewards Program to help secure your financial future and preserve your health and well-being, including: Medical, Dental and Vision Ancillary: Life, Short and Long Term Disability 401K match Flexible PTO Parental Leave Stock options Additional programs and perks Wheel is committed to equal employment opportunities for all team members. Every decision we make regarding employment is solely based on merit, competence, and performance. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Research shows that underrepresented groups typically apply only if they meet 100% of the criteria listed. At Wheel, we encourage women, people of color, and LGBTQ+ job seekers to apply for positions even if they don’t check every box for the role.

items.description: CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 40,000 students from 1,000+ universities, and our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. We've spent nearly a decade training the next generation of technical talent, and we just launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic, building one of the most ambitious AI workforce programs in the world. We're now expanding into new markets and scaling our team so we can move at the speed AI is transforming the workforce. People joining CodePath now will have the opportunity to help architect the next frontier of our work. We believe technical skill is the fastest way to turn raw talent into real opportunity. We train the engineers the AI era runs on, building toward millions of learners, hundreds of millions in revenue, and billions in economic impact. If you want to own something and be part of a 0-to-1 journey at an organization moving at the speed of AI, this is the place to build it. About the Role Location: Remote, United States Role-Type: Full-Time, W2 Employee Reports To: Senior Director, AI Programs Compensation: $130,000 to $148,000 per year Start Date: September 21st, ahead of the October 19th cohort launch Together with Anthropic, CodePath launched Claude Corps in June 2026, a national fellowship program with a $150 million commitment to place 1,000 AI-trained fellows at nonprofits across America. The mentorship model works, but we need experienced professionals to coach and guide those mentors, as well as be responsible for the success of our mentor’s performance and our curriculum delivered to the Fellows. A CodePath Mentor coaches about 20 fellows, so a thousand fellows means more than forty mentors, and someone has to own whether all of them actually deliver. That someone is the Senior Manager of AI Practice. You manage a team of mentors and you own the delivery outcome for their fellows: at full scale, about ten mentors and 200 fellows, fewer while the program ramps. You are accountable for whether fellows are actually learning, pod by pod and mentor by mentor. When a mentor's pods stall, when a fellow's work drifts off track, when the same problem shows up across three pods at once, it is yours to catch and yours to fix. Curriculum will be developed, with your influence, at scale, you own the delivery layer: seeing where it lands across your pods and where it doesn't. You keep Commons central to how your mentors and fellows work, and you close the loop back to the curriculum team so the next version is sharper than the last. This is a hands-on, operational role, and it grows with the program. You start by running the first cohort's small mentor team directly and build the delivery systems that let quality hold as the program climbs from 100 fellows to 1,000. A real part of the craft is reading when a lesson should come from a mentor inside a pod and when the whole group needs to hear it from you in real time. It is built for someone who has run delivery for a team before and would rather raise ten people's game than do all the work themselves. Key Responsibilities Manage the mentor team Manage a team of mentors, about ten at full scale and fewer during the ramp: hire, onboard, coach, and hold the bar on the quality of their coaching Run your team's operating cadence: weekly syncs, 1:1s, and the escalation path when a mentor or a fellow needs help Make sure the day-to-day the model depends on actually happens across your team: pull requests reviewed on time, milestone reviews run, host managers engaged Own delivery for your fellows Own the delivery outcome for your portfolio, roughly 200 fellows at full scale: whether instruction lands, not whether mentors look busy Own the agenda-based instructional time for your whole portfolio: set the agenda, and decide each session whether to teach it yourself, live and to everyone at once, or hand it to your mentors to run in their pods. Either way, whether it lands is on you Hold the quality framework for mentorship: what good coaching looks like, how it gets reviewed, and what happens when it misses the bar Own the milestone-review roll-up across your fellows, and step in on the ones whose work is at risk Replace hand-tracking with delivery systems that hold at volume; the model ran on spreadsheets at 100 fellows and won't at 1,000 Own the CodePath-to-Commons layer Partner with the Claude Corps strategic partners as their counterpart in the field: you see what is landing across your mentors and fellows, and you bring it back as structured signal Own how your team uses Commons: the curriculum ships through the platform, and you own whether it is used the way it was designed Turn what you see in the field into curriculum change requests the curriculum team can act on, and close the loop when they ship Key Success Metrics 100% of your mentors are running their weekly cadence on schedule and you can pull that from your dashboard, not from what mentors report in standup You can name where each mentor is strong and where they need help, and your weakest spot has a concrete plan implemented within 30 days You've surfaced your top 3-5 delivery patterns across your fellows to the Claude Corps leadership team, and at least 1 has shipped as a curriculum change You have a single delivery view that shows the state of your portfolio at a glance, in place of whatever was hand-tracked before you Qualifications Required You have managed people and can point to specific ways you raised a team's performance, ideally technical or coaching staff 3-5 years of technical program management, engineering management, or other program management experience where you directly led cross-functional teams to drive measurable outcomes. You don't have to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable working with technical and non-technical stakeholders to drive programmatic success You can hold a room, teaching a live session and keeping it sharp, because some weeks you are the one in front of the group You have owned a delivery or operations outcome at volume, personally on the hook for its quality You have replaced manual, hand-run processes with systems that held up as the work scaled You have shipped real work using AI-assisted development tools and can describe specifically how your workflow changed; you have to hold your mentors and fellows to that bar Strong written communication: feedback, roll-ups, escalations, and change requests, in a remote and mostly asynchronous org Comfortable with remote, synchronous obligations across US time zones and about two evenings a month for cohort sessions and milestone reviews Preferred You have managed coaches, instructors, or other managers in a bootcamp, fellowship, residency, or other cohort-based program You have scaled a delivery team through fast headcount growth without letting quality slip Comfort with a platform- or LMS-delivered learning model, and reading delivery data to find risk before it surfaces Compensation CodePath has standardized salaries based on the position's level, no matter where you live. For this role, we're hiring at an annual salary of $130,000 to $148,000. Salary is determined based on your relevant experience and skills as evaluated through our interview process. Full-Time Employee Benefits This is a 100% remote position—work from anywhere in the U.S.! CodePath prioritizes employee well-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance. Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance (90% employer-covered for employees and dependents), employer-funded healthcare reimbursement, FSAs, and Employee Assistance Program Financial Security: 401(k), employer-paid life & disability insurance, and identity theft protection Work-Life Balance: Generous PTO, paid holidays, 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and an annual year-end company closure (Dec 24 – Jan 2) Professional Growth: $1,000 annual professional development stipend and home office setup support ​​Student Loan Forgiveness: CodePath is a qualifying employer for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), helping employees manage student loan debt Additional Perks: Pet wellness plans, legal services, home/auto insurance discounts, and exclusive marketplace savings Pay range $130,000—$148,000 USD

items.description: What Makes Cloudbeds Unique At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started. How You’ll Make an Impact: As the Manager, Global Talent Acquisition , you will be responsible for defining and executing Cloudbeds’ global talent acquisition strategy while elevating the quality, consistency, and effectiveness of hiring across the organization. This is far more than a traditional recruiting leadership role. You will serve as a strategic partner to executive leadership, helping shape workforce planning decisions, hiring strategies, talent market positioning, executive recruiting initiatives, hiring governance, and recruiting operations. You will lead a globally distributed Talent Acquisition team while partnering closely with leaders across Customer Success, Onboarding, GTM, Product, Engineering, Finance, and Staff & Corporate functions. This role will directly impact Cloudbeds’ ability to attract exceptional talent, improve quality of hire, strengthen leadership pipelines, and support the company’s next phase of growth. In this role, you will also be responsible for driving recruiting analytics, workforce planning initiatives, hiring process optimization, executive recruiting programs, and talent intelligence efforts globally. You will leverage data and market insights to influence hiring decisions, identify opportunities, and support organizational growth. Given the strategic nature of the role, this position requires strong business acumen, executive presence, operational excellence, and the ability to influence stakeholders across all levels of the organization. Our People Team: We’re a globally distributed, multicultural People Team spanning NORAM, LATAM, EMEA, and APAC, and that global footprint isn’t just a fact; it’s a strength we fully embrace. Our team brings together a diverse mix of perspectives, experiences, and expertise that help us build thoughtful, scalable, and people-centered solutions across the organization. We partner closely with leaders at every level to help Cloudbeds grow intentionally, build strong teams, strengthen leadership capability, and create exceptional team member experiences. We believe the People Team should be strategic business partners, not simply administrators. We use data, business insight, operational excellence, and strong relationships to influence decisions and drive outcomes. The Manager, Global Talent Acquisition, reports to the Global Director of People and plays a critical leadership role within the People organization, helping shape the future of hiring at Cloudbeds. What You’ll Bring to the Team: Global Talent Acquisition Strategy Develop, execute, and continuously evolve Cloudbeds’ global Talent Acquisition strategy in alignment with business priorities and long-term organizational growth. Partner with executive leadership to anticipate future hiring needs and translate business objectives into scalable talent acquisition strategies. Build recruiting programs that enable sustainable growth while maintaining a strong focus on hiring quality, speed, and consistency. Continuously evaluate market trends, talent availability, and competitive intelligence to ensure Cloudbeds remains positioned to attract exceptional talent globally. Hiring Excellence & Quality of Hire Champion hiring excellence across the organization by continuously raising the quality, consistency, and effectiveness of hiring decisions. Design and implement structured interviewing frameworks, assessment methodologies, and hiring governance processes that improve long-term hiring success. Partner with leaders to calibrate hiring expectations, strengthen interview practices, and reduce bias throughout the selection process. Establish quality-of-hire metrics and continuously evaluate hiring outcomes to improve recruiting effectiveness and long-term organizational performance. Promote an exceptional candidate experience while maintaining rigorous hiring standards and a high hiring bar. Executive Search & Leadership Hiring Lead executive and senior leadership searches across multiple functions globally. Develop proactive talent mapping strategies and build long-term relationships with high-caliber leadership talent. Partner with executive search firms when appropriate while ensuring an outstanding candidate experience throughout the executive hiring process. Serve as a trusted advisor to executives throughout complex leadership hiring decisions. Workforce Planning & Talent Intelligence Partner closely with Finance, People, and business leaders to develop workforce plans aligned with company growth objectives. Provide data-driven recommendations regarding hiring locations, organizational design, market availability, compensation trends, and talent competitiveness. Leverage recruiting analytics, talent intelligence, and market insights to influence executive decision-making and support long-term business planning. Build executive dashboards and reporting that provide visibility into recruiting performance, talent risks, and future hiring opportunities. Recruiting Operations & Process Excellence Continuously improve recruiting operations, workflows, systems, reporting, and recruiting technology to ensure scalability and operational excellence. Identify opportunities to simplify processes, eliminate bottlenecks, and improve efficiency without compromising hiring quality. Ensure recruiting processes remain globally consistent while balancing regional requirements and business needs. Drive operational excellence through clear metrics, accountability, and continuous improvement initiatives. Leadership & Team Development Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing, globally distributed Talent Acquisition team. Foster a culture of collaboration, ownership, innovation, continuous learning, and accountability. Support career development through regular coaching, feedback, mentoring, and succession planning. Create an environment where recruiters operate as strategic business partners rather than transactional recruiters. Executive Partnership & Business Influence Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to executives and senior leaders across the organization. Influence workforce planning, organizational growth, leadership hiring, and talent strategy through strong business acumen and data-driven recommendations. Challenge hiring assumptions when appropriate, providing thoughtful guidance that balances business needs, talent availability, and long-term organizational success. Build strong cross-functional partnerships that position Talent Acquisition as a trusted business partner and a key driver of organizational growth. What Sets You Up for Success: 8+ years of progressive Talent Acquisition experience. 5+ years of recruiting leadership experience. Significant SaaS or high-growth technology recruiting experience. Strong recruiting expertise, including GTM, Customer Success, Technology, and Revenue organizations. Executive recruiting experience. Experience implementing structured hiring assessments and hiring governance frameworks. Workforce planning and talent intelligence expertise. Experience leading globally distributed recruiting teams. Strong analytical, operational, and strategic planning capabilities. Excellent communication and executive stakeholder management skills. Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and drive business outcomes. Experience working in a fast-paced, high-growth, remote-first environment. Experience with ATS platforms, recruiting analytics, and workforce planning tools. Professional working proficiency in English (written and spoken). Compensation: Depending on your skills and experience, you can expect your annual compensation to be between $180 000 and $195 000 USD (t he salary is only for US-based candidates). #LI-PD1 What to Expect - Your Journey with Us Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team of redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ employees across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary. Learn more online at cloudbeds.com Company Awards : Best All-In-One Hotel Management System | HotelTechAwards (2025) Overall 10 Best Places to Work | HotelTechAwards (2025) Most Loved Workplace® Certified (2024) Top 10 People’s Choice (2024) Deloitte Technology Fast 500 (2024) Discover our Benefits: Remote First, Remote Always PTO in accordance with local labor requirements Monthly Wellness Fridays - enjoy an extra-long weekend every month Fully Paid Parental Leave Home office stipend based on country of residency Professional development courses in Cloudbeds University Access to professional development, including manager training, upskilling and knowledge transfer Everyone is Welcome - A Culture of Inclusion Cloudbeds is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer that celebrates the diversity in our global team! items.description: GT was founded in 2019 by a former Apple, Nest, and Google executive. GT’s mission is to connect the world’s best talent with product careers offered by high-growth companies in the UK, USA, Canada, Germany, and the Netherlands. On behalf of Feeld , GT is looking for a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join a fast-growing consumer mobile product in the online dating space. Their mission is to elevate the human experience of sexuality and relationships and create a world where everyone is more intimately connected to each other and themselves. items.description: Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day. Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu , founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences. Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta. About the Role As Finance Manager, you'll be the operational engine of our FP&A function — owning financial planning, headcount management, and reporting while partnering with RevOps on GTM capacity planning and supporting Deal Desk on pricing. You'll work directly with our Sr. Director of FP&A with high visibility into company leadership. High-ownership, high-impact, and broad in scope. What You'll Do Financial Modeling & Headcount Planning Maintain the company financial model with a focus on headcount planning across departments. Manage the HC request and approval process with HR, Recruiting, and department leads. Own budget tracking and proactively flag variances. GTM & RevOps Partnership Own sales and pipeline generation capacity planning models with RevOps. Support Deal Desk with ad-hoc pricing analysis and own the deal desk pricing and cost model. Close Reporting Prepare month-end and quarter-end close reporting packages. Build KPI dashboards and surface insights for leadership in clear, accessible narratives. Financial Software Tool Implementation Partner with the Sr. Director of FP&A to implement a modern Financial Planning solution, migrating our planning processes off Excel. Qualifications We're looking for someone who actively explores and applies AI tools — including Claude — to automate workflows, improve analysis, and work smarter. Curiosity and initiative matter more than prior experience with any specific tool. 4–7 years of FP&A experience, ideally at a high-growth SaaS or technology company Strong financial modeling skills in Excel with eagerness to move into a modern EPM platform Experience with headcount planning and cross-functional budget management Comfortable working with GTM data and partnering with RevOps or Sales Finance Highly organized, detail-oriented, and an effective communicator with non-finance stakeholders Self-starter who thrives with ownership in a fast-paced environment Nice to Have Exposure to Deal Desk, pricing analysis, or sales capacity modeling Prior experience at a Series B–D startup Benefits Competitive compensation & equity, aligned with experience and market benchmarks Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance Remote-first culture with opportunities for in-person collaboration Professional development budget for courses, conferences, and ongoing learning Generous PTO and holidays Inclusive culture committed to diverse backgrounds and perspectives Compensation at Cresta: Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table. The posted base salary range represents what we expect to pay for this role in a given location. Final offers are shaped by factors like experience, skills, education, and geography. In addition to base pay, total compensation includes equity and a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family. Salary Range : $140,000 - $170,000 + Equity We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta.ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Cresta employee, reach out to recruiting@cresta.ai

items.summary: We're looking for a Senior PPC Specialist to lead paid acquisition efforts across Meta, Google, and other digital advertising platforms.
items.description: We're looking for a Senior PPC Specialist to lead paid acquisition efforts across Meta, Google, and other digital advertising platforms. This is a hands-on role for someone who understands that successful paid media isn't just about launching campaigns; it's about maximizing profitability. You'll be responsible for optimizing the entire acquisition funnel, analyzing campaign performance, improving conversion rates, and making strategic decisions that drive sustainable growth. The ideal candidate is analytical, data-driven, and comfortable balancing campaign execution with performance strategy. Requirements Key Responsibilities Plan, launch, and optimize paid media campaigns across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and other advertising platforms. Monitor and improve key performance metrics, including ROAS, CPA, CAC, CTR, Conversion Rate, and LTV. Identify profitability issues and optimize the entire conversion funnel. Conduct A/B testing for audiences, creatives, landing pages, and offers. Analyze campaign performance and provide actionable insights through dashboards and reports. Manage advertising budgets and scale high-performing campaigns. Collaborate with creative and marketing teams to improve campaign results. Implement and maintain tracking using GA4, Google Tag Manager, and advertising platforms. Stay up to date with industry trends, AI tools, and platform updates. Requirements Resume in English. Native or near-native English proficiency (spoken and written). 4+ years of experience managing Meta and Google Ads campaigns. Proven experience optimizing campaigns based on ROAS, CPA, CAC, and profitability. Strong understanding of conversion funnels and conversion rate optimization (CRO). Experience with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and reporting dashboards. Experience managing six-figure monthly advertising budgets is a plus. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Experience with eCommerce, SaaS, Lead Generation, or Performance Marketing campaigns. Ability to translate data into actionable optimization strategies. By applying to this position, we'll create your Simera Professional Key (SPK) — a unique key that helps you connect with employers, stand out, and secure the right match. items.title: Chief Financial Officer
items.summary: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!
items.description: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process! About the role The CFO’s mission is to continue building upon Grüns ' already strong finance and data function — evolving it into a best-in-class engine that empowers the entire organization to make faster, smarter decisions. Leading a team of three strong leaders, this role is about leading the strong teams below them to democratize financial intelligence across the Grüns organization: self-serve dashboards, on-demand reporting, and real-time visibility that puts decision-making power in the hands of every team member. The CFO is a relentless, collaborative business partner, never satisfied with where the business is on revenue scale or profitability, always pushing for the next point of EBITDA margin improvement across all functions and driving efficiency to fuel continued revenue growth. They will ensure Grüns scales with confidence while meeting all external requirements seamlessly in the background. This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL. What success looks like: If we look ahead a year from now, the right person in this role would have: Leveraged what we’ve built so far, found areas for improvement, and fully operationalized a goal accountability framework that keeps business initiatives tied to financial outcomes, ensuring the leadership team is consistently tracking toward revenue and profitability targets. Driven meaningful EBITDA margin improvement across all functions and improved LTV:CAC efficiency to fuel continued revenue growth. Delivered self-serve dashboards, templatized reporting, and real-time P&L visibility across functions so every team has the data access they need without relying on ad-hoc requests. Business decisions are democratized and exponentially quicker. Created the conditions for a high-performing, motivated team empowering vs. micromanaging, actively developing leaders, and driving strong results and performance without burnout. Built the systems and processes to meet all external reporting and compliance requirements seamlessly, keeping the team focused on growth. We're looking for someone with: Relentless Growth Mindset: Always asking what it takes to get to the next level, whether that's another point of margin, better efficiency, or a faster path to revenue growth - a genuine internal drive to make the business the best it can be. Finding new opportunities across the business and proposing these opportunities to the CEO and functional leads. Integrity and Business-First Thinking: Prioritizes the truth over “looking good”. Navigates competing stakeholder interests honestly and thoroughly rather than taking the path of least resistance. Empowering Leadership: Leads by giving people the tools, clarity, and confidence to make great decisions vs. controlling the work directly. Actively develops their functional leaders, makes their team better than they were before. Drives sustainable high performance. Paper Wall Pusher: Treats perceived constraints as hypotheses, not facts. When told something takes six weeks or "this is how it's done," they ask why and push for faster, smarter, or different. Actively hunts for process bloat and inherited ways of working to find improvements. AI-Native Operator: Uses AI natively in their own workflow and actively builds AI fluency into the team's operating model. Sees AI as a core lever for scaling the function's impact without scaling headcount. Direct, but kind: Direct and honest in every conversation, saying what needs to be said, even when it's uncomfortable. Deeply committed to the business and the people in it. Experience: 10+ years leadership experience in a high-growth, profitable businesses; some level of physical inventory experience (CPG, retail, e-commerce, or similar) is a must Experience leading the functions in scope - finance, accounting, data, and BizOps functions Experience within a high-growth company that is adapting to public company practices Compensation & Benefits: At Grüns , we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary is $350,000 + incentive compensation, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team. A bit about us... At Grüns , we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you. Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all. So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious. What we care about... Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation. Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners. Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most. Compensation & Perks: For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth. Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns subscriptions, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about! Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Sr. Clinical Operations Manager
items.summary: About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life.
items.description: About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide. Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at . The Opportunity 🚀 This role serves as the operational backbone of the Global Clinical Operations (GCO) team, developing a deep understanding of GCO's day-to-day workings in order to help operationalize its running. You'll coordinate new projects, identify the right stakeholders, and partner closely with the GCO team, including GCO clinical leadership, to keep programs running smoothly. This is a hands-on operations role where success is measured by reliable execution, clean reporting, and strong cross-functional coordination. You'll be the connective tissue between GCO sub-teams and partners across product, commercial, GTM, and customer success, giving you visibility into how clinical operations decisions ripple across the business. What You’ll Own 💼 In this role, you will: Serve as the operations point person across GCO sub-teams, keeping frameworks, timelines, and ways of working consistent. Coordinate the GCO components of new projects end-to-end: identify stakeholders, track deliverables, and keep work moving across global clinical operations, product, and other partner teams. Track spend against program budgets, flagging variances to leadership. Spot and help close gaps or silos between GCO sub-teams by maintaining regular alignment touchpoints. Build and maintain dashboards and reporting infrastructure that give leadership real-time visibility into program status, trends, and open decisions. Pull together monthly operational updates, synthesizing data from Jira, Zendesk, Airtable, Salesforce, BI tools, and other program analytics into clear, actionable summaries. Help connect operational metrics to clinical and business outcomes so leadership has a clear line of sight from day-to-day activity to impact. Serve as a connector between GCO and commercial, GTM, and customer success teams, ensuring the right subject-matter expert is looped into RFPs, RFIs, and retention/expansion conversations. Ensure feedback from client-facing teams is incorporated into GCO program planning and prioritization. Identify opportunities to use AI tools, automation, and workflow improvements to save the team time and reduce manual work. Support team members in getting up to speed on new tools and best practices as they're introduced. What Success Looks Like 📈 In your first 12–18 months, you will have: Created and rolled out dashboards and reporting infrastructure that are adopted by GCO leadership.Improved operational efficiency across GCO, including reduced redundant meetings and streamlined recurring processes.Established a strong working rhythm with key GCO leadership and cross-functional partners. Successfully managed multiple projects concurrently, hitting key milestones and deadlines, with consistent reporting/status updates so stakeholders always know where each project stands. About You ✨ You likely have: A Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business, public health, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience in clinical/healthcare operations. Demonstrated, hands-on experience in scheduling, budgets, and cross-functional coordination within clinical operations. Strong program and process-design skills, shown through a program management certification or 2+ years of project management experience, including building/maintaining SOPs, governance documentation, and decision-informing reporting. High comfort level with modern productivity and data tools (Google Workspace, Slack, Jira, Salesforce, Airtable, BI dashboards) and the ability to quickly learn new systems, including AI-enabled tools. A demonstrated ability to operate across multiple fast-moving workstreams simultaneously without losing track of details. Strong documentation skills, with the ability to create and maintain clear, reusable, well-organized documentation. Extreme organization, with the ability to manage and maintain large databases and datasets accurately. The ability to establish a process and cadence for audits, ensuring data and documentation stay accurate and current over time. Nice to Have ⭐ While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring: Experience in reproductive and/or hormonal health (fertility, pregnancy, menopause, low testosterone, gender-affirming care) and related coverage/benefit policies. A track record of using data to drive decisions — defining KPIs, building dashboards, running monthly/quarterly operational reviews. Comfortable operating in high-growth, ambiguous environments with a bias toward scalable systems and automation. Why This Role Matters 🧡 This role sits at the center of Carrot's Global Clinical Operations function, translating day-to-day execution into the reporting and coordination that leadership relies on to make decisions. By keeping GCO's sub-teams aligned and connecting clinical operations to commercial and customer-facing teams, this person directly shapes how reliably Carrot delivers on its clinical programs — and how clearly that impact gets communicated across the business. Why Candidates Join Carrot 🌍 Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission. Highlights include: A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally. A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact. Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits. Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge. Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits. A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture. The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide. Compensation 💰 Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from$128,000.00 - $150,000.00. Actual compensation may vary from the posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience. Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: A Note on AI At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves. Why Carrot? Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: About CookUnity:Food has lost its soul to modern convenience.
items.description: About CookUnity : Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul. Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world. If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting. About the Team: We are looking for a Real Time Analyst to work with the WFM Analyst. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in maintaining service level agreements (SLAs), improving workforce allocation, and providing actionable insights to stakeholders in real time. The role: As a Real-Time Operations Analyst at CookUnity , you’ll play a key role in ensuring smooth daily operations across our CX teams. You’ll manage real-time data, support frontline teams, and help ensure we hit key performance targets. You don’t need to come in knowing everything about WFM—we’re ready to train the right person—but you do need to be analytical, action-oriented, and curious. If you love digging into data, thrive in fast-paced environments, and are excited to support both people and processes, we’d love to meet you. Note: You will be assigned a schedule that may include evenings, weekends, or holidays. These schedules will be adjusted periodically to meet the needs of our business. Responsibilities: Monitor real‑time metrics (e.g. service level, average speed of answer, schedule adherence, occupancy, handle time) and identify deviations from targets. Monitor queue conditions, agent states, workload distribution, and available capacity throughout the assigned shift. Adjust resource allocation on the fly: reassign agents, manage breaks, redistribute workload, even skill our team dynamically to maintain performance. Collaborate with WFM Analyst and CX Leadership teams to ensure shift coverage and service targets. Maintain detailed logs of interventions, staffing changes, and performance shifts to support post-event analysis and process optimization. Provide KPI reporting and crisis management during outages or spikes, and maintain detailed logs for performance review. Participate in continuous improvement initiatives—help build dashboards, refine real‑time monitoring tools, and share best practices across teams What You Bring Understanding of customer support or contact center operational metrics, including service level, average speed of answer, occupancy, adherence, average handle time, abandonment, and backlog. Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, including filtering, pivot tables, lookup functions, conditional formulas, and data formatting. Ability to interpret live operational metrics and make logical, timely decisions. Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities. Clear written and verbal communication skills. Ability to escalate issues appropriately and communicate with stakeholders at different levels. Ability to remain calm and organized in a fast-paced environment. Proactive problem-solving skills and willingness to act within established guidelines. 3+ months of experience in workforce management roles . 6+ months of experience in a call center or customer support environment . Nice-to-Haves Familiarity with Zendesk, Slack, Google Sheets, or similar operational tools. Experience with Workforce Management platforms such as NICE IEX, Verint, Calabrio, or similar systems. Experience using Real-Time dashboards, alerts, or operational reporting. Prior exposure to incident communication or escalation processes. Experience supporting multichannel Customer Experience operations. Certifications in Workforce Management, analytics, Lean, Six Sigma, COPC, or related disciplines. Preferred Requirements: Logical thinking: You back decisions with data, not just instincts. Time management: You can juggle tasks and adapt quickly. Communication: You provide crisp, timely updates—especially when things change. Problem solving: You don’t wait for direction—you act when something’s off. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Fully remote URL: https://www.testgorilla.com/ We’re looking for a hands-on Sales Manager to lead a dynamic team of 6–8 SMB Account Executives, who own the full sales cycle from the initial outreach to close. You’ll own the SMB number, build a high-performance culture where the best sellers thrive. This is a true player-coach role : the antithesis of a hands-off, dashboard-only manager job! You’ll be on calls with your team every day, jumping in to help them close, modelling the behaviours and standards you expect, and turning every deal into a coaching moment. When a deal is stuck, you get on the call. When a rep is struggling with a stage, you show them how it's done. You don't wait for things to go wrong - you're out ahead of it, making your team and the company better. You'll use Gong and HubSpot deeply to inspect pipeline, coach reps, and continuously raise the bar. If you love being in the trenches with reps, getting on live calls, and showing people exactly how to close, this role is the one for you. Responsibilities Lead a global team of 6-8 SMB Account Executives, owning their ramp, performance, career growth, and creating a team culture people want to be part of and recommend to others. Carry the team SMB quota, owning forecasting, pipeline health, and weekly, monthly, and quarterly results, using HubSpot deeply for pipeline inspection, sequence performance, and reporting. Run high-impact 1:1s, deal reviews, and pipeline reviews focused on specific behaviors, using Gong daily to identify coaching opportunities, codify what great looks like, and accelerate ramp. Be on a high-volume of live sales calls every week, joining discoveries, demos, and negotiations to support reps, model best practices, and step in to close when it matters. Think and deliver in an AI-first way, using tools like Claude and n8n to reduce admin, improve rep performance, and help the team adopt AI effectively. Build, maintain, and continuously improve the SMB sales playbook, including discovery frameworks, demo structure, objection handling, and closing motions. Partner with VP Sales, Marketing, GTM Operations, and Customer Success to drive consistent SMB pipeline and customer outcomes, train the team, and surface front-line insights back to Product and Leadership. What you’ll bring We're looking for someone who: Is passionate about TestGorilla's mission to help one billion people find their dream jobs. Has strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Thrives in a non-corporate, async-first, remote environment. Has experience managing SMB SaaS sales teams with a clear track record of hitting and exceeding quota, and a background as a top-performing closer before moving into management. Is a genuine player-coach: you actively want to be on live calls, jump into deals, and demonstrate how to close. Operates in a high-accountability environment: holding high standards for themselves and their team. Has deep, hands-on proficiency with Gong and HubSpot, including pipeline management, forecasting, deal stage discipline, call coaching, and reporting. Has strong coaching skills and a repeatable framework for developing reps with radical candor, plus experience hiring and ramping SMB closers in a high-velocity environment. Is very comfortable using AI tools, including Claude and n8n, and keen to help the team adopt them effectively. While we hire for skills over specific years of experience, we would generally expect that someone with the above skills has 3-5 years of Sales management experience. This is not a first-time manager role! We seek diversity and encourage applications from everyone. Studies show that women and underrepresented groups can be hesitant to apply unless they meet every requirement. If you're interested in this role but your experience doesn't perfectly match the description, please still apply. Bonus skills While this isn’t a requirement, we’d be very interested to hear from you if you have experience: Selling and managing teams in HR tech, ATS, recruitment, talent assessment, or recruiting software. Leading SMB teams in a product-led, PLG-influenced, or self-serve-to-sales motion. What’s in it for you? Please note: Some specifics, particularly around leave, may vary depending on your country of residence. This will be discussed during the hiring process. Global Team: Join a fully remote, mission-driven team from around the world Competitive compensation: Receive competitive pay (Total OTE of €120,000-€151,000 on a 50/50 base/variable split) and Share Appreciation Rights (SARs) Remote & flexible work: Work from almost anywhere*. Enjoy flexible hours and asynchronous work to balance work and life. * Check out the Countries we currently hire from here Remote work budget: €1,000 available each year or up to €2,000 from day 1 if you're buying a laptop! Growth & development: Invest in yourself and your career with a 3.5% L&D budget and clear growth opportunities Parent/Caregiver support: We provide a caregiver-friendly work environment with paid 8-16 week parental leave and tailored return-to-work approaches Work-life balance: Our unlimited and flexible time off policy empowers you to take the time you need to recharge and maintain your well-being To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/testgorilla-manager-smb-sales

This is a highly creative, execution-focused role. You’ll take product requirements, user needs, business objectives, and early concepts and turn them into thoughtful u
items.description: The Role We’re hiring a talented, hands-on UI/UX Designer to create intuitive, polished, and engaging digital experiences across AllCare’s products, websites, and digital platforms. This is a highly creative, execution-focused role. You’ll take product requirements, user needs, business objectives, and early concepts and turn them into thoughtful user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and polished interfaces that are both visually strong and easy to use. We’re looking for someone with a strong visual eye and deep understanding of user experience who can take ownership of the design process from initial concept through developer handoff and final implementation — not simply create individual screens. What You’ll Own UI/UX Design: Design intuitive, modern, and polished interfaces for AllCare’s digital products, websites, landing pages, and other digital experiences. User Flows & Wireframes: Translate product requirements and user needs into clear user journeys, information architecture, wireframes, and interaction flows. High-Fidelity Design & Prototyping: Create detailed responsive designs and interactive prototypes in Figma that clearly communicate functionality and intended user experience. Design Systems: Build and maintain scalable design systems, reusable components, typography, icons, spacing standards, and UI patterns to ensure consistency across products. Responsive Design: Design experiences that work seamlessly across desktop, tablet, and mobile, with a strong understanding of responsive and mobile-first design principles. Developer Collaboration: Work closely with front-end developers to ensure designs are technically feasible, clearly documented, and accurately implemented. Design QA: Review implemented interfaces, identify inconsistencies or usability issues, and collaborate with developers through final production. UX Optimization: Use user feedback, analytics, and behavioral insights to identify friction points and continuously improve usability and conversion. Web & Digital Design: Support the ongoing design and improvement of websites, landing pages, and other digital experiences while maintaining a consistent brand identity. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product, engineering, marketing, creative, and leadership to understand objectives and translate them into thoughtful digital experiences. What We’re Looking For Above all: someone with an exceptional portfolio who can demonstrate both strong visual design instincts and a thoughtful approach to user experience. We’re looking for a designer who can take ownership of a product or experience from initial problem through final implementation rather than simply execute individual screens. Proven Experience: 4–5+ years of professional experience in UI/UX design, product design, web design, or a closely related role. Strong Portfolio: A portfolio demonstrating polished web, SaaS, product, or application design with clear examples of both UI and UX thinking. Figma Expertise: Advanced proficiency in Figma, including components, auto layout, design systems, prototyping, and developer handoff. UX Fundamentals: Strong understanding of user flows, information architecture, interaction design, usability, and user-centered design principles. Visual Fundamentals: Excellent understanding of typography, hierarchy, spacing, composition, color, and visual consistency. Responsive Design: Strong understanding of responsive and mobile-first design across desktop, tablet, and mobile experiences. Design Systems: Experience creating, maintaining, and working within scalable component libraries and design systems. Developer Collaboration: Experience working directly with front-end developers and understanding how designs translate into production. Front-End Understanding: Familiarity with modern front-end technologies and workflows, including HTML/CSS, JavaScript, React, and Next.js. Concept-to-Execution: Ability to take a product requirement, user problem, or rough concept and independently develop it into a polished, production-ready experience. Speed & Ownership: Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment, managing multiple projects, incorporating feedback quickly, and taking ownership from concept through implementation. Communication: Excellent written and verbal English. Nice to Have Experience designing products for technology, healthcare, SaaS, or AI companies. Experience designing complex platforms, dashboards, workflows, or data-heavy applications. Experience using analytics or behavioral tools such as Google Analytics, Hotjar, or similar platforms to inform design decisions. Experience with Webflow or WordPress. Experience working with React/Next.js development teams. Familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop and Illustrator. Experience working with US-based product, engineering, or marketing teams. Experience in a startup or high-growth environment where designers are expected to move quickly and work independently Compensation & Benefits: Competitive package of USD $1,200–$1,400 per month (including performance bonus) , commensurate with experience, portfolio, and technical skill. Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM PST Location: Remote (Egypt-based candidates only) US holiday calendar — you’re off when your US-based team is off (Thanksgiving, Christmas, Memorial Day, Labor Day, and more). Health benefits and paid time off.

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Sarasota, FL URL: https://www.simpletiger.com/ SimpleTiger is seeking a strategic, data-driven Senior PPC Manager to lead paid media strategy and execution for our B2B SaaS clients. This role is ideal for a seasoned performance marketer with 5+ years of hands-on experience building, managing, and optimizing multi-channel paid advertising campaigns. The Senior PPC Manager will own campaign performance across Google Ads, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram; translate client growth objectives into effective paid media strategies; and deliver clear, proactive communication and recommendations. You will work closely with our SEO, content, design, sales, and product teams to maximize qualified pipeline, customer acquisition, and return on ad spend for a portfolio of SaaS clients. Key Responsibilities Develop and lead comprehensive paid media strategies tailored to each client’s growth stage, business model, target audience, sales cycle, and revenue goals. Independently build, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram. Own campaign setup from end to end, including keyword research, audience strategy, account and campaign structure, ad group development, bid strategies, conversion tracking, budget allocation, and ad creative direction. Monitor and optimize campaigns against core performance metrics, including CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA, conversion rate, pipeline contribution, ROAS, and ROI. Develop and manage testing roadmaps for ad copy, creative, landing pages, offers, audiences, bidding strategies, and campaign structures. Analyze performance data to identify trends, diagnose issues, uncover growth opportunities, and provide actionable recommendations. Partner with content and design teams to develop high-performing ad creative and messaging that resonates with B2B SaaS buyers. Collaborate with the SEO team to ensure PPC strategies complement broader organic search, content, and demand-generation initiatives. Manage paid media budgets responsibly, making informed recommendations on spend allocation, scaling opportunities, and efficiency improvements. Work directly with clients to communicate performance, explain strategy, set expectations, and provide timely, proactive updates and recommendations. Lead client-facing reporting and performance discussions, turning complex campaign data into clear business insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Partner with sales and product stakeholders to align campaign targeting, messaging, and conversion goals with customer insights and business priorities. Build and maintain strong relationships with platform representatives to access platform support, strategic guidance, beta opportunities, and new features. Stay current on paid media platform updates, privacy and tracking changes, B2B SaaS advertising trends, and emerging best practices. Contribute to the continued improvement of SimpleTiger’s PPC processes, reporting frameworks, account standards, and strategic playbooks. Provide mentorship, strategic guidance, and quality assurance support to junior team members as the PPC function grows. Requirements 5+ years of hands-on experience managing and optimizing PPC or paid social campaigns, preferably in a B2B SaaS, agency, or high-growth technology environment. Demonstrable experience managing meaningful advertising budgets across Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads; experience with Facebook and Instagram Ads is also required. A strong record of improving paid media performance through structured testing, optimization, and strategic budget management. Deep understanding of Google Ads, including Search, Display, remarketing, YouTube, Performance Max, conversion tracking, and bidding strategies. Strong working knowledge of LinkedIn Ads, Facebook Ads Manager, audience development, retargeting, lead-generation campaigns, and full-funnel B2B campaign strategy. Experience building campaigns from scratch and taking ownership of paid media accounts from audit through execution and ongoing optimization. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret performance data, identify meaningful trends, and make sound strategic recommendations. Proficiency with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, and/or comparable analytics, attribution, and reporting tools. Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms, particularly HubSpot or similar systems, is strongly preferred. Familiarity with B2B SaaS funnel metrics, including lead quality, MQLs, SQLs, pipeline, CAC, LTV, and revenue attribution. Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex performance insights clearly to clients and internal stakeholders. Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to prioritize effectively and manage multiple client accounts simultaneously.
